jobs.title: Servicetechnieker
jobs.description:
Onze klant is toegewijd aan het leveren van hoogwaardige apparatuur en oplossingen in alle segmenten waar voedselbereiding een uitdaging vormt. Onze toestellen staan bekend om hun precisie, veelzijdigheid en innovatieve technologieën, waarmee koks een breed scala aan kookprocessen kunnen beheersen, van braden en stomen tot bakken en grillen.

Met jarenlange ervaring en een focus op cullinaire excellentie spelen wij een belangrijke rol in de gastronomische wereld van België. Ons streven naar efficiëntie en creativiteit in professionele keukens wordt ondersteund door het ontdekken, benutten en beheersen van opportuniteiten. Dit wordt versterkt door een gedegen groeimodel in alle segmenten waar voedselbereiding plaatsvindt, met een mensgerichte aanpak voor zowel klanten als medewerkers.

In onze harmonieuze organisatie streven we ernaar dat iedereen zich veilig, gesteund en volwaardig kan voelen. Dit bevordert optimale resultaten voor de organisatie en stimuleert de persoonlijke ontwikkeling van onze medewerkers.


Jobomschrijving

Wil jij werken bij een innovatieve marktleider in kookapparatuur? Wij zoeken een enthousiaste service technieker!

Jouw taken:

  • Plaatsen en aansluiten van toestellen
  • Opbouw van beurzen.
  • Intstalleer nieuwe kookapparatuur bij klanten op een professionele en efficiënte manier
  • Zorg ervoor dat de apparatuur correct is aangesloten en operationeel is volgens de specificaties.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Profiel:

  • Passie voor techniek (alle technische profielen),met een sterk verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en probleemoplossend vermogen.
  • Nauwkeurigheid en zorgvuldigheid bij het plaatsen van apparatuur.
  • Zelfstandig kunnen werken en efficiënt problemen kunnen diagnosticeren en oplossen.
  • Hands-on mentaliteit met een focus op praktische oplossingen.
  • Commercieel bewustzijn met prioriteit voor het belang van het eerste klantencontact

jobs.title: Hersteller huishoudtoestellen
jobs.description:
Je gaat aan de slag als hersteller van wit- en bruingoed bij één van de bekendste elektro- en multimediawinkels in België, die deel uitmaakt van een grote groep. Deze groep focust zich vooral op de verdeling en verkoop van elektro- en multimediaproducten. Met meer dan 70 winkels verspreid over het hele land, zijn ze één van de grootste spelers op de Belgische markt. Maar liefst 1200 mensen geven elke dag het beste van zichzelf om klanten zo goed mogelijk te helpen.

Het bedrijf staat bekend voor zijn uitstekende service, klantvriendelijkheid en grote aandacht voor het welzijn van de medewerkers. Respect, samenwerking en groei zijn belangrijke waarden. Iedereen wordt gewaardeerd voor zijn inzet en krijgt kansen om bij te leren en zich verder te ontwikkelen, bijvoorbeeld via opleidingen over nieuwe technologieën.

Klanten kunnen bij onze klant terecht voor een ruim aanbod aan toestellen zoals televisies, smartphones, laptops, huishoudtoestellen en accessoires. Service na verkoop (zoals installatie, herstellingen en advies) is erg belangrijk en vormt samen met klantgerichtheid het DNA van het bedrijf.

Bij onze klant werken betekent deel uitmaken van een groot, enthousiast team waar samen werken, respect, innovatie en welzijn centraal staan. Je mag rekenen op werkplezier, stabiliteit, waardering en groeikansen in een mensgerichte omgeving.


Jobomschrijving

Als hersteller huishoudtoestellen, bestaat jouw job uit onderstaande:

  • Je repareert huishoudtoestellen zoals bijvoorbeeld wasmachines en koelkasten bij mensen thuis
  • Je zoekt ter plaatse wat er stuk is en probeert het meteen te herstellen
  • Je bestelt nieuwe onderdelen als dat nodig is
  • Je maakt een kort verslag voor je teamleider na elke reparatie
  • Je werkt minimum 2 zaterdagen per maand, elke zaterdag werken is ook mogelijk

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Voor de vacature van service technieker huishoudtoestellen herken jij jezelf in onderstaande:

  • Je hebt een goeie kennis elektriciteit en kan werken met elektrisch gereedschap zoals bijvoorbeeld een multimeter
  • Je weet hoe je foutmeldingen moet lezen, storingen kan opsporen én oplossen
  • Je bent vriendelijk en legt uit aan klanten wat je doet
  • Je hebt een rijbewijs B en werkt graag in je eigen buurt, of wisselt soms van locatie
  • Je kan goed Nederlands spreken en schrijven en bent bereid een opleiding te volgen in Willebroek

jobs.title: Grondwerker
jobs.description:
Dit bouwbedrijf met de vacature van grondwerker regio Bonheiden is actief in de bouw en het onderhoud van vervoersinfrastructuren. Het bedrijf werkt aan oplossingen voor mobiliteit, urbanisatie en milieu-uitdagingen waar lokale overheden mee te maken krijgen. De kernactiviteiten zijn de bouw en het onderhoud van wegen, spoorwegen, luchthaven- en haveninfrastructuur, en industriële en logistieke sites. In België heeft deze grote speler vestigingen in Antwerpen, Brussel, Limburg, Luik en Henegouwen, met samen meer dan 1000 medewerkers. Ze maken deel uit van een internationale bouwgroep en focussen op wegenwerken en infrastructuurprojecten zoals (snel)wegen, tramlijnen, luchthavenbanen, havenplatformen en parkings.


Jobomschrijving

Als grondwerker in regio Bonheiden draag je bij aan kwalitatieve infrastructuur zoals wegenaanleg en -onderhoud op verschillende werven.

  • Huisaansluitingen op de riolering plaatsen en correct aansluiten.
  • Waterslikkers plaatsen en aansluiten op het rioleringsnet.
  • Boordstenen plaatsen en afwerken volgens plan.
  • Grondwerken ondersteunen: uitgravingen opvolgen en meten bij de graafkraan (grondkoffers).
  • Funderingen aanleggen voor rijwegen, voetpaden en andere verhardingen.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Voor deze vacature als grondwerker regio Bonheiden zoeken we iemand die zich kan herkennen in volgende punten:

  • Je hebt ervaring in de grondwerken of wegenwerken.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd om fysiek zwaar werk uit te voeren en je werkt graag buiten.
  • Je bent flexibel naar werkuren en inzetbaar op verschillende werven en taken binnen grondwerken.
  • Je werkt veilig en volgt werf- en veiligheidsvoorschriften strikt op.
  • Je levert nauwkeurig en kwaliteitsvol werk.
  • Je bent collegiaal en leergierig: je helpt het team vooruit en staat open om nieuwe technieken en werkwijzen aan te leren.
  • Je kan vlot samenwerken en communiceren in een team op de werf.
De ideale collega is...
  • Iemand die graag buiten werkt.
  • Iemand die flexibel is naar werkuren toe en vlot schakelt tussen verschillende opdrachten op de werf.
  • Iemand die veilig en nauwkeurig werkt: je volgt werf- en veiligheidsvoorschriften strikt en levert kwaliteitsvol werk af.
  • Iemand die vlot communiceert, zodat je goed kan afstemmen met collega’s en ploegbaas op de werf.
  • Iemand met een hands-on mentaliteit, die collegiaal samenwerkt en open staat om nieuwe technieken aan te leren via opleiding en begeleiding.

jobs.title: Rioolarbeider
jobs.description:
Deze aannemer met de vacature van rioolarbeider te Walshoutem is actief in de wegenbouw, rioleringsaanleg, milieusanering en de aanleg van publieke ruimtes. Hun projecten omvatten zowel publieke als private opdrachtgevers in Vlaanderen en Brussel. Het bedrijf behoort tot de top 3 spelers op de Belgische infrastructuurmarkt. Vanuit verschillende vestigingen beschikken ze over eigen betonsites, recyclagesites en asfaltproductie-installaties. De bedrijfscultuur is open en samenwerkend: collega’s ondersteunen elkaar om veilig en kwalitatief werk te leveren. Kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid staan centraal, met aandacht voor planning, correcte uitvoering en ruimte om te leren en te groeien.


Jobomschrijving

Als rioolarbeider regio Walshoutem werk je samen met je ploeg op verschillende werven en voer je onderstaand takenpakket uit:

  • Je vertrekt met je team vanaf een afgesproken opstapplaats aan de E40 autostrade regio Walshoutem naar de werf en stemt ter plaatse de dagplanning af met de ploegbaas en werfleiding.
  • Je voert rioleringswerken uit, zoals het maken van huisaansluitingen, het plaatsen van rioleringsbuizen en putten, en het ophogen of vrijmaken van putdeksels.
  • Je plaatst en werkt weginfrastructuur af, waaronder funderingen, kolken, boordstenen, goten en straat- of klinkerwerken.
  • Je gebruikt klein bouwmaterieel en gereedschap voor grond- en wegenwerken, zoals trilplaten, slijpschijven en (kleine) graafmachines.
  • Je houdt de werf ordelijk en veilig, controleert hoogtes en uitzettingen waar nodig, en helpt mee om de uitvoering volgens planning te laten verlopen.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Hieronder wat je nodig hebt om op te starten als rioolarbeider voor deze job regio Walshoutem:

  • Je raakt iedere ochtend vlot tot een ophaalpunt aan de E40 autostrade regio Walshoutem.
  • Je hebt al (een eerste) ervaring als grondwerker, arbeider rioleringswerken of wegenwerker.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd om te starten als rioolarbeider en je wil fysiek werken in weer en wind.
  • Je hebt een geldig rijbewijs B of bent er concreet mee aan de slag (praktijklessen en/of praktijkexamen ingepland).
  • Je hecht belang aan veilig en vlot communiceren op de werf.
  • Je kan vroeg starten en je bent flexibel naar werkuren, overuren en werven op verschillende locaties.
De ideale collega is iemand...
  • Iemand die graag werkt in teamverband, vlot afstemt met ploegbaas en collega’s en mee helpt waar nodig om samen vooruitgang te maken.
  • Iemand die veiligheid en orde op de werf serieus neemt: je volgt afspraken, gebruikt materiaal correct en spreekt risico’s tijdig aan.
  • Iemand die flexibel is in werkritme en planning, met bereidheid om vroeg te starten en in overleg extra uren te doen wanneer de werfplanning dat vraagt.
  • Iemand die houdt van buitenwerk en fysiek werk, ook bij wisselende weersomstandigheden: je blijft doorzetten tot het werk klaar is.
  • Iemand die graag slimmer wordt via opleiding en begeleiding on the job.
  • Iemand die nieuwe werkwijzen en technieken snel toepast in de praktijk.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Growth Associate (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bei Eneto machen wir moderne Klimaanlagen- und Heizlösungen schnell, einfach und bezahlbar zugänglich. Mit hochwertigen Markenprodukten, klaren Prozessen und transparenten Festpreisen kommen Kunden ohne Aufwand zur optimalen Lösung. Über 70.000 Kundenerfahrungen aus früheren Energieprojekten bilden unsere Basis. Unser Marketingteam ist klein, bewegt aber viel – und genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der nicht wartet, bis ihm etwas gesagt wird, sondern selbst denkt, anpackt und mitgestaltet. Wer Verantwortung übernehmen will, bekommt sie bei uns.

Aufgaben

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern an strategischen und operativen Themen, die gerade anstehen – von Produkt über Business Development bis Marketing.
  • Du übernimmst eigene Projekte entlang der Wachstumshebel: neue Vertriebskanäle aufbauen, Partnerschaften anbahnen, Prozesse aufsetzen, Angebote schärfen.
  • Du analysierst, wo wir Hebel haben, leitest Hypothesen ab und testest sie – ob im Funnel, im Produkt oder im Vertrieb.
  • Du recherchierst Märkte, Wettbewerber und Kooperationsmöglichkeiten und bereitest Entscheidungen vor.
  • Du springst dort ein, wo es brennt – im jungen Unternehmen heißt das: heute Partnergespräche vorbereiten, morgen eine Landingpage konzipieren, übermorgen einen Prozess aufsetzen.
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein – und siehst, was daraus wird.

Qualifikation

  • Du bist immatrikuliert (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Marketing o. Ä.) und hast 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit.
  • Erste Erfahrungen im Unternehmensumfeld – ob durch Praktika, eigene Projekte, Studenteninitiativen oder Nebenjobs.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du verstehst schnell, worauf es ankommt, und priorisierst nach Wirkung.
  • Analytische Denkweise und Spaß daran, Hypothesen mit Daten zu prüfen.
  • Hohe Eigeninitiative und Hands-on-Mentalität: Du wartest nicht auf Aufgaben, sondern bringst dich aktiv ein.
  • Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise – auch remote.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift.
  • Nice to have: Interesse an Energie oder Wärmepumpen-/Klimaanlagen-Themen.

Benefits

  • Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Gründern – lerne direkt von Unternehmern, die bereits ein Unternehmen auf 30 Mio. € skaliert haben
  • Breiter Lernhorizont – du siehst, wie ein Unternehmen wirklich aufgebaut wird, statt nur in einer Funktion zu sitzen.
  • Kleines Team, große Wirkung – kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten – passend zu deinem Stundenplan.
  • Remote-Setup – du brauchst nur Laptop und Internetzugang.
  • Übernahmeperspektive – wer liefert und reinpasst, bekommt die Chance, dauerhaft Teil des Teams zu werden.

jobs.title: Produktmanager Managed Services - Cloud & Infrastructure (m/w/d) - Remote
Senior Global HR Business Partner (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Transform with us the future of energy ⚡

The SGB‑SMIT Group is an international transformer manufacturer with locations in Europe, Asia and the United States. With reliable transformer technology, the company actively supports the global energy transition in areas such as renewable energy, industry and urban energy infrastructure.

As a key link between power generation, transmission and distribution, SGB‑SMIT Group develops and manufactures power transformers, distribution transformers, cast‑resin transformers and custom solutions for data centers, industrial applications and e‑mobility. These products ensure efficient, stable and secure energy flows worldwide.

With more than 3,800 employees worldwide, the SGB‑SMIT Group stands for quality, innovation and sustainability and offers a stable environment to work on technologies that shape the energy systems of the future.

What sets the SGB-SMIT Group apart: 🌍

We combine the strength of an international technology company with an employee-oriented corporate culture:

  • Meaningful work at the heart of the energy transition

  • Short decision-making processes and direct cooperation

  • Stable, growing company with long-term prospects

Your contribution counts – both professionally and personally.

Your benefits at SGB-SMIT Group: 🚀

  • Stable, growing company with long-term prospects

  • Attractive salary and social benefits

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid working models

  • 30+1 vacation days plus special leave

  • Training and development opportunities

  • Company pension plan and employee insurance

  • Health and fitness offers (HanseFit)

  • Company restaurant, free drinks, and e-charging parking spaces

  • Bicycle and IT leasing

  • Subsidy for Germany/RVV ticket

  • Employee discounts via Benify

Your tasks: 📌

  • Strategic consulting and support for international business units and local HR organizations on all HR-related issues in a global context

  • Leading and implementing group-wide HR projects and transformation initiatives, e.g., in the areas of organizational development, talent management, performance management, and compensation & benefits

  • Developing, harmonizing, and implementing global HR strategies, standards, processes, and guidelines to support corporate objectives

  • Management of international organizational and change management projects, as well as support for integration and growth initiatives

  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills, as well as a structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to work

  • High level of communication, consulting, and project management skills, as well as the ability to successfully manage change

  • Excellent written and spoken German and English skills

jobs.title: Managing Director
jobs.description:
Description

Valsoft specialises in acquiring and growing vertical market software companies. Our mission is to provide a permanent home for software businesses, preserving the legacy of their founders while investing in the long-term growth and success of the companies we acquire. We operate and manage a global portfolio of wholly owned software businesses, delivering mission-critical solutions across multiple verticals. By implementing industry best practices, Valsoft ensures a time-sensitive integration process and operates a decentralised model, fostering rapid growth through reinvestment in its portfolio.   

The Role:   

This position provides critical operational leadership to a company and potentially a portfolio of companies within a growing software vertical. As the leader of a company, you will be responsible for developing and implementing the business’s strategic plan across all major functions, including sales and marketing, R&D, customer service, professional services, and human resources.   

You will work closely with the leadership team to identify, define, and execute strategies required to achieve growth plans and operating objectives, with a focus on improving operational excellence. This role carries full accountability for the company's results, making it ideal for a driven leader eager to make a significant impact.   

Key Responsibilities:   

  • Own the long-range, annual, and quarterly financial and non-financial goals  
  • Develop and communicate a clear vision of goals and objectives, strategies, and philosophies about growth, revenue generation, profitability, and customer care  
  • Manage day-to-day operations, including sales performance, opportunity management, forecasting, R&D capacity, and customer support  
  • Attend promotional events which include but not limited to tradeshows and panels  

Sales and Marketing   

  • Drive revenue growth, working with the sales team to identify new opportunities and execute growth strategies including cross/upsell and entering adjacent markets     
  • Develop and implement best in class sales operations and sales infrastructure to enable effective scale and ensure process discipline     
  • Develop and maintain competitive intelligence programs, generating industry trend reports to inform new feature and product development    
  • Improve use of Salesforce and other internal tools to increase forecasting capability, implement targets, and provide actionable insights to executive team and board of directors    
  • Create and implement KPIs for sales team to measure performance and productivity (ex: CAC / LTV) ; develop performance dashboards and establish reporting process (measure NRR and MRR trends)    
  • Work with sales leaders in establishing quotas, budgets, compensation plans and pricing optimization    
  • Manage key relationships with large accounts is mandatory    

Customer Care/Customer Success:  

  • Execute an effective, long-term customer success program for clients    
  • Implement and maintain client support initiatives    
  • Facilitate both in-house and client training sessions    
  • Monitor and document Customer Success metrics, including program usage, satisfaction levels, ticket throughput, and resolution    
  • Coordinate the administration of annual customer satisfaction surveys (NPS) and other communication tools    

Research and Development:    

  • Ensure clear product roadmaps are established, followed, and adapted to meet market needs    
  • Balance investment in R&D with maintenance efforts to maximize new customer growth and retain existing clients while maintaining efficient Customer Care and R&D operations    
  • Track Product Manager prioritization of R&D tasks, ensuring they are entered into the corporate system and executed by software developers    
  • Facilitate the growth of Product Managers by aligning their activities with job descriptions    

Professional services:    

  • Ensure we are delivering profitable projects by monitoring billable utilizations, staff OPEX and contribution margin    
  • Establish strategies to increase NRR    
  • Track on a monthly basis results with the Head of Professional Services    

Financial Management:    

  • Review with Senior Management and the team:    
  • Advance performance by driving improvements in revenue, profit, customer retention, loss prevention, and expense ratios    
  • Annual, quarterly, and monthly revenue results/forecasts and costs    
  • Participate in the development of internal department policies and programs to support quality and growth    
  • Drive P&L, ROI, EBITDA, rule of 40 and ARR/ IRR performance of businesses and ensure companies are meeting organizational objectives    

Human resources:    

  • Partnering with your HR lead in driving talent retention and development, complying with local employment legislation and developing a true local company culture   

Growth through M&A:  

  • Engage in M&A activities, working closely with the Valsoft investment group on acquisition strategy and M&A initiatives  
  • Oversee post-acquisition initiatives to integrate companies into your business, focusing on operational transformation and implementation of efficiencies  

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Proven experience in senior leadership roles within the software or technology sector
  • Strong skills in developing and executing strategic business plans across multiple functions
  • Demonstrated success in driving revenue growth and market expansion
  • Hands-on approach to managing daily operations and improving operational excellence
  • Proven track record in leading change management initiatives — bringing teams through restructuring, process redesign, or new ways of working with clarity and buy-in
  • Practical understanding of AI and its application to software products and internal operations, with the ability to translate emerging technology into concrete business value and to drive adoption across the organisation
  • Exceptional leadership with the ability to inspire and manage cross-functional teams through periods of transformation
  • Results-oriented with a focus on achieving targets and continuous improvement
  • Strong commitment to customer success and care
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for influencing stakeholders and building support for change at all levels
  • Innovative, proactive, and adaptable with a collaborative mindset
  • Full professional proficiency in English (required)
  • Legally authorized to work in Germany / Switzerland / Austria / France

Onze klant beheerst als toonaangevend wegenbouwer alle aspecten van de wegenbouw.

Ook in de haven en de petrochemie zijn we sterk vertegenwoordigd.

Met onze vier asfaltcentrales, een participatie van 50% in Ascovil (Villers-Le-Bouillet) en vier betoncentrales zijn we een van de belangrijkste producenten van asfalt en wegenisbeton.

Dankzij onze centrales in Brugge, Gent, Schoten en Lummen kunnen we over heel Vlaanderen TRA 50 gecertificeerd wegenbeton produceren en leveren, zowel voor onze eigen werven, als voor derden.

De certificering is een grote meerwaarde voor het eindresultaat, zowel kwalitatief als esthetisch.

We dragen duurzaamheid hoog in het vaandel.

Dit uit zich enerzijds in het voortdurend nastreven van de hoogst mogelijke kwaliteit en veiligheid tijdens de productie van de materialen en de uitvoering van de werken. Anderzijds in het belang dat we hechten aan de impact van onze activiteiten op het milieu en de maatschappij.

Zo beschikken we over eigen recyclingsites, waardoor we een actieve bijdrage kunnen leveren aan het hergebruiken van beton-, asfalt- en bouwpuin.

Onze inspanningen op het vlak van CO2-reductie op onze werven en in onze bedrijfsvoering werden in 2021 bekroond met het allereerste Belgische CO2-bewust certificaat uitgereikt door COPRO. Op de CO2-Prestatieladder halen we niveau 5.

Onze recyclingsites en betoncentrales zijn sinds begin 2024 ook CSC-gecertificeerd.

jobs.title: Arbeider onderhoud wegenwerken - BOUW
jobs.description:
Heb je ervaring als wegenwerker of grondwerker en zoek je een nieuwe uitdagende job?
Vind je het niet erg om overuren te doen die mooi verloond worden?

Wij zijn opzoek naar arbeiders voor het onderhoud van wegen en rioleringen.
Als familiebedrijf zijn wij uitgegroeid tot een grote speler binnen de bouwsector met focus binnen infrawerken. 

Indien er een herstelling dient te gebeuren, wordt jouw ploeg ingezet om deze te gaan uitvoeren.

Korte beschrijving van het takenpakket:

  • Herstelling van asfalt
  • Werken aan riolering
  • Funderingswerken
  • Plaatsen van borduren, klinkers, enz.
  • ...

Een functie met veel afwisseling: je staat in de loop van één week op verschillende werven, voornamelijk in de ruime regio Antwerpen.
Met je ploeg spreek je een centraal verzamelpunt af waar iedereen ’s ochtends naartoe komt met eigen vervoer.
Van daaruit vertrekken jullie samen met één camionette richting de werf, waar de werkdag om 7 uur start.

Is de werkdag voorbij (8 uur gewerkt) maar is het werk nog niet afgerond, dan sta jij ervoor open om overuren te presteren.
Uiteraard hangt hier een mooie verloning aan vast.

Onze lonen vallen binnen PC 124, aangevuld met extra’s zoals maaltijdcheques, een gsm met abonnement.
Bij een vaste indiensttreding komen daar ook een groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering bij, evenals de mogelijkheid tot een fietsleaseplan.
Daarnaast profiteer je van kortingen via Benefits at Work en voorzien wij werkkledij.

Als extra organiseren we ook tal van activiteiten zoals afterworks, teambuildings, enz.

 

Heb je altijd al in de wegenbouw gewerkt en zie je deze job als een nieuwe stap die je graag wil zetten?

jobs.description:
VEDOUCÍ PROVOZU TEPELNÉHO HOSPODÁŘSTVÍ BECHYNĚ
Posláním české firmy ERDING je zajistit spolehlivé dodávky tepla a teplé vody do bytů, škol, kanceláří atd. Zakládáme si na dlouhodobých vztazích jak s našimi odběrateli, tak se zaměstnanci. Už od roku 1998 úspěšně provozujeme soustavu centrálního zásobování teplem ve městě Bechyně a do našeho stávajícího týmu právě hledáme zodpovědnou posilu s technickým srdcem.
•    Máš logické i technické uvažování a zvládáš operativní řešení provozních výzev?
•    Dokážeš správně vyhodnotit technickou závadu na tepelném zdroji a navrhnout efektivní řešení?
•    Zvládneš efektivně vést tým 4 pracovníků obsluhy kotelny a nevadí ti komunikace s přímým nadřízeným na dálku?
•    Hledáš samostatnou práci a stabilní zázemí přímo v Bechyni?
Pokud ano, pak hledáme právě Tebe!
Co bude náplní tvé práce?
•    Odpovědnost za chod střediska: Zajistíš bezpečný, plynulý a efektivní provoz tepelných zdrojů (kotelna na biomasu, plynové kotelny, výměníkové stanice) v souladu s legislativou a nastavenými standardy
•    Technická správa: Převezmeš řešení provozních záležitostí, odstraňování závad, plánování údržby/oprav a pravidelných revizí
•    Analytická činnost: Budeš technicky vyhodnocovat spotřebu energií, paliv a celkovou účinnost i výkon provozovaných zařízení
•    Vedení lidí: Povedeš menší tým pracovníků obsluhy kotelen
•    Komunikace: Budeš aktivně jednat s dodavateli nakupovaných paliv/služeb i jednotlivými odběrateli tepla, udržovat s nimi profesionální vztahy a zůstaneš v úzkém kontaktu s nadřízeným na dálku
Co od tebe očekáváme?
•    Odbornou praxi: Zkušenosti v oblasti energetiky či TZB, výroby a distribuce tepla/elektřiny, případně z oblasti realizace technologických staveb či TZB
•    Osobnostní předpoklady: Proaktivní přístup k řešení úkolů, ochota učit se novým věcem, samostatnost, rozhodnost a schopnost týmové spolupráce
•    Mobilitu: Řidičský průkaz skupiny B (aktivní řidič)
Kde budeš působit a co pro tebe máme?
Čeká tě různorodá a technicky zajímavá práce v zázemí stabilní společnosti. Tvým hlavním působištěm bude centrální tepelný zdroj v Bechyni, spalující biomasu a zemní plyn. Tento klíčový zdroj zajišťuje spolehlivé dodávky tepla pro celé město – přibližně pro 1 000 domácností, místní školy, komerční objekty apod. Převezmeš také odpovědnost za plynulý a bezpečný  provoz dalších menších kotelen v rámci Jihočeského kraje.
K práci dostaneš služební automobil. Přestože budeš působit samostatně v regionu, minimálně jednou měsíčně se potkáš s celým týmem na poradě v Brně a několikrát do roka se sejdeme na neformálních firemních akcích.
Kontakt: telefonicky, e-mailem, osobně.

jobs.title: KUCHAŘ / KUCHAŘKA, Kuchaři (kromě šéfkuchařů)

Jsme Domov poskytující péči seniorům s chronickým duševním onemocněním, kteří jsou závislí na pomoci jiné osoby.
U nás nejde jen o práci – dáváme prostor k osobnímu rozvoji, smysluplnému vzdělávání a hlavně k tomu, abyste mohli každý den někomu skutečně pomoci a být mu oporou.

Co nabízíme:

•    jistotu, že dobrým pracovníkům garantujeme stálé zaměstnání a férový plat s ohledem na kvalitu  odvedené práce
•    základní plat od 24 450 Kč do 26 280 Kč (po zapracování osobní příplatek)
•    k základnímu platu garantovaný příplatek za víkendové směny ve výši
25 % a směny ve svátek příplatek ve výši 100%  
•    podporu v dalším vzdělávání, moderní pracovní zázemí, přátelský kolektiv  
•    odměny, dovolená 5 týdnů + SICK DAYS
•    firemní stravování
•    příspěvek z FKSP na stravování, DIP, rekreaci, masáže, sportovní, kulturní apod. akce

Toužíte po práci, která Vám umožní skloubit profesní život s rodinou a svými zájmy? Kde noci trávíte doma a ne v práci?
Od ledna 2026 spouštíme v Pelhřimově nové Centrum duševního zdraví (CDZ) - službu, která propojuje zdravotní a sociální péči a přináší do regionu moderní model podpory pro lidi s duševním onemocněním.

Koho hledáme?
- všeobecné sestry s řidičákem skupiny B, které chtějí pracovat v multidisciplinárním týmu a podílet se na rozvoji nové služby

Co nabízíme?
- jednosměnný provoz - pravidelný rytmus dne a více prostoru pro vlastní život,
- hlavní pracovní poměr na 1,0 úvazek, 5 týdnů dovolené
- čas na individuální přístup ke klientovi - možnost pracovat s lidmi tak, aby Vaše péče měla skutečný dopad,
- týmovou podporu - v práci nejste sami, vždy se můžete opřít o psychiatra, psychologa, sociální pracovníky i peer konzultanty,
- možnost podílet se na něčem novém - být u zrodu služby, která je v ČR stále unikátní, a uplatnit své zkušenosti a nápady,
- mzdu od 43.000,- Kč dle specializace

Co Vás čeká?
- poskytování zdravotní péče v ambulanci i v přirozeném prostředí klientů,
- spolupráce s odborníky napříč profesemi,
- supervize, odborné vzdělávání a podpora profesního růstu

Co získáte?
- motivační mzdu
- stabilní zázemí organizace FOKUS Vysočina, z.ú.
- možnost profesně růst a zároveň si udržet rovnováhu mezi prací a osobním životem

Jak se přihlásit?

jobs.title: UVC Partners: Data & AI - Master Thesis / Internship (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About us

UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies.
Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha.

At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way.


Your mission

You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions.


Your profile

  • You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university.
  • You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro).
  • You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop.
  • You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it.
  • You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required.

How we work
We are an AI-powered development team. Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write.
Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you.

Potential Research Directions
These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads.
1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot.
2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data.
3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several.

Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own.


What we offer

  • Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors.
  • Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events.
  • Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship.
  • Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions.
  • Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on.
  • AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly.
  • Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively.

Interested?
Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you!


Diversity is important to us

Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability.

www.uvcpartners.com

UVC Partners is an equal opportunity employer.

UVC Partners is an independent venture capital fund. For efficiency, we use certain shared services from UnternehmerTUM. This is why parts of the application process may appear UTUM-branded, and your application will be processed by UVC Partners and UnternehmerTUM.

  • Du verantwortest verlässliche Lieferung, Systemstabilität und Verfügbarkeit deines Verantwortungsbereichs und sorgst für den gezielten Abbau technischer Schulden.

jobs.title: (Junior) Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Introduction:

At quantilope, we're transforming how the world's biggest brands understand their customers. As a (Junior) Data Scientist, you'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, and Software Engineers to build and evolve our AI-powered consumer insights platform. From developing agentic AI assistants and advanced analytics to creating innovative research tools usable by non-technical users — you'll be at the heart of scaling a sophisticated platform that puts automated, AI-powered insights into the hands of researchers and brands worldwide.

We are looking for a (Junior) Data Scientist who delivers production-grade results to high standards, who combines a passion for the latest AI technologies with the engineering discipline to ship them reliably, and who brings analytical and creative problem-solving to new challenges.


What you will be doing:

  • You design and build agentic AI systems using frameworks like Pydantic AI, including tool registries, prompt engineering, grounding strategies, and orchestration of LLM-based workflows across multiple AI-powered products

  • You closely collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and work with engineers to integrate AI and Data Science features into our platform

  • You automate data analytics and insights visualizations that are applicable and interpretable by non-technical users, helping researchers and brand managers work with advanced methods without needing technical expertise

  • You automate the application of advanced market research methods that are easy to use while being statistically and scientifically valid

  • You build and ship machine learning models (supervised, unsupervised, LLM-based) end-to-end — from prototyping and training to production deployment in our platform

  • You contribute to our AI observability and evaluation practices, working with tools like Langfuse and inspect-ai to monitor, trace, and continuously improve our AI systems in production

  • You stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI, LLMs, and agentic architectures, incorporate them into your work, and proactively share insights and opportunities with colleagues


Who you are:

  • You have a university degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or a related relevant field

  • You have at least one year of professional experience in Data Science and AI building production-grade products

  • You have production-level experience building agentic AI systems or LLM-powered applications, including prompt engineering, tool-use patterns, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or similar approaches

  • You have strong programming skills in Python and proficiency with relevant frameworks and libraries (e.g., FastAPI, Pydantic/Pydantic AI, Pytest, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) as well as experience with LLM integration (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar providers)

  • You have experience in the software industry including delivering high-quality, scalable services via APIs to production

  • You write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code — you're comfortable working in a professional codebase with code reviews, automated testing (e.g., Pytest), and CI/CD practices

  • You are an excellent and creative problem solver who is comfortable with ambiguity and change and who is curious to learn new tools, technologies, and domains

  • You are fluent in English with excellent communication skills — including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and to work effectively in cross-functional teams


Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure for software deployment (Kubernetes, Helm) and AI observability tooling (Langfuse, LLM tracing)

  • Experience in or passion for the area of market research, marketing, or consumer insights


Benefits of working at quantilope:

  • Flexible work environment: With flexible PTO, flexible working hours and remote/hybrid opportunities, we believe you can succeed from anywhere. Did we mention that everyone has the opportunity to work abroad for up to 6 weeks per year?

  • Ongoing learning: With our dedicated learning budget for every employee and company-wide workshops with the best in the biz, we believe in providing our employees with all the tools they need to excel. 

  • Wellness is key: We offer Private Health Insurance & Pension plan options as well as the support of certified mental health first aiders. We also have Quantiwell days which are global mental health days twice a year where the whole company takes a day for themselves.

  • Diverse & inclusive community: Our team spans the globe, driving diverse ways of working and thinking. With the help of an incredible Community Committee, we are committed to advancing education and awareness.
     
  • Team bonding: Team offsites, summer and holiday parties? We’re all working hard and know how important it is to have fun along the way.

Kontakt

jobs.title: Seeking COO Chief Operating Officer at ROEST
jobs.description:
ROEST, a leading Norwegian tech scale-up, is seeking a Chief Operating Officer (COO) to drive our next phase of growth. Over the past 10+ years, we have built an international success story by redefining coffee roasting using sensor technology. We are now serving leading coffee customers in over 90 countries. ROEST has a Red Dot Award for its innovative first product and was named the national “Gaselle” Company of the Year for its rapid growth in early 2023. But we are just getting started.

With the launch of our new production roaster, we are now set to scale significantly in the coming years. To support this growth, we need a strong people-focused leader who can ensure effective operations while fostering a high-performing team, and we look forward to seeing if this is you!


About the role

As ROEST’s COO, you will be responsible for daily operations across all departments, ensuring alignment with strategic goals. This role is heavily focused on people management, requiring a leader who can empower and develop our team while working closely with the founders (CEO & CTO) and department heads on execution. The role is part of a high-expectation, high-support environment, and as a team, we strive to embody curiosity, quality and challenging the status quo. We hope these values resonate with you too.


Key responsibilities:

  • Strategy: As a key member of the executive team, contribute to the development and refinement of company strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and market opportunities.

  • Operations: Oversee and optimize daily operations across departments, identify opportunities and initiate action plans to ensure ROEST has highly efficient, scalable and quality-oriented operations.

  • Growth: Drive sustainable growth by ensuring our processes, systems, and teams evolve in line with our expansion, scaling in a way that strengthens both our business and our culture.

  • People: Foster an inclusive and supportive environment where talent thrives, collaboration flows, and our company culture makes ROEST the place to work. Inspire people to join us - even from across the world - by building a workplace that is as exciting as our technology.


Who you are:

  • Execution oriented: you are a doer and a problem solver, with a focus on efficiency and data.

  • Proven leader: you have well-documented experience in leading teams and empowering the team and department heads to drive growth.

  • Global mindset: you have experience from working across cultures and geographies.

  • Technical savvy: you have a strong understanding of tech-driven business models, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams.

  • Scaling expert: you are experienced in scaling organizations, optimizing operations, and executing strategic plans.

  • People-centric: you have strong communication, collaboration and emotional intelligence skills with a focus on team development and company culture.

  • Structured and strategic: you can balance big-picture thinking with attention to detail. Develop clear strategies while ensuring structured execution, effective processes, and thorough follow-through.


Requirements:

  • Minimum 8 years of relevant work experience.

  • A master's degree in business, economics, technology, or a related field is preferred.

  • Oslo-based or willing to relocate: the role is based in Oslo, Norway.

A plus for us:

  • Passion for coffee: You have a genuine love for coffee and an appreciation for the industry.

  • A deep understanding of startup culture, or experience from tech companies and/or manufacturing.


Why join ROEST?

  • Join a company that has spent the last decade perfecting a groundbreaking product and is now ready to scale from 40 MNOK to 500 MNOK+ in revenue.

  • Lead a highly skilled and passionate team in a creative, innovative, and global market.

  • We are still a small team (20+ people), so you can make a big impact on the future of our company and its culture.

  • An opportunity to become a shareholder at an early stage, as part of the company’s Employee Share Options Program (ESOP).


What began as a Master’s thesis has grown into a fast-paced, open-minded company with an international team passionate about improving coffee. Since 2018, we have sold over 2,000 coffee roasters in more than 90 countries worldwide and we continue on our mission to help coffee people make (even) better coffee.


📩 Apply now and be part of shaping the future of the coffee industry!

Our team is dedicated to develop and manufacture innovative products for the coffee industry, increasing quality in the cup and efficiency in the workflow. ROEST’s current portfolio includes two models of an AI powered hybrid coffee roaster designed for quality control. ROEST Sample Roaster has received several industry awards and even helped coffee enthusiasts to succeed in the World Coffee Championships. In 2023 we will launch a new production roaster for small to medium-sized roasteries. Since 2018 we have sold over 1000 roasters to more than 80 countries around the world. Join Kongsberg Digital — Shaping the future of work with the AI-powered Industrial Work Surface.

At Kongsberg Digital, our mission is to transform the world’s most complex and asset-intensive industries through world-leading, AI-powered digital twin technology.   

As a pioneer in industrial digitalization, we provide a comprehensive suite of software solutions that empower organizations to manage the full lifecycle of their assets—more efficiently, safely, and sustainably than ever before. 

The industry is on the cusp of a digital revolution—and we’re leading the charge. From early adoption of AI to building trusted partnerships with some of the world’s largest industrial players, we are redefining how work gets done. With domain expertise baked into every line of code and a high-calibre team united by a clear mission, we’re not just keeping pace with change—we’re setting the standard. 

As we expand rapidly across the Middle East and Africa, deepen our end-to-end offerings, and push the boundaries of AI, now is the perfect time to join a company that’s growing fast, thinking bold, and delivering real impact. 


About the role

We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused VP Head of Marketing to join our team.

Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, you will lead a global marketing organization across demand generation, product marketing and performance marketing functions, with a mandate to align marketing strategy with commercial execution and measurable revenue outcomes.

As a key member of the revenue leadership team, you will align marketing strategy with sales objectives to accelerate growth, improve pipeline velocity, and increase recurring revenue across our industrial software portfolio.

This role will shape how we position and scale our marketing capability as we strengthen our independent market identity and accelerate global growth.

You will be expected to challenge, influence and partner with executive leadership on commercial direction, positioning and growth priorities.

  • Shape and lead the company’s global go-to-market marketing strategy, balancing long-term positioning with measurable commercial impact.

  • Translate complex technical capabilities into clear, compelling value propositions for target industries.

  • Partner with Product Management and Sales to drive successful launches and field enablement.

  • Develop vertical and persona-based messaging strategies.

In this role, you will own performance across key revenue and pipeline indicators, ensuring marketing impact is measurable and trusted at executive level.

  • Foster strong alignment with Sales, Delivery, Product and Communications to ensure cohesive go-to-market execution and consistent market messaging.

  • Develop a performance-driven culture grounded in measurable outcomes and continuous optimization.

  • Where you can be part of our commitment to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work.      


Diversity & Inclusion 

  At Kongsberg Digital, we celebrate diversity and strive for inclusivity. We strongly believe that different perspectives and backgrounds drive innovation and contribute to our success. We actively promote a culture of inclusiveness that values and respects every individual, providing equal opportunities for all our employees. Together, we will create a workplace where every game-changing employee can shine and seize equal opportunities.  

 

Application process 

If you're ready to be a game changer in the pursuit of creating a better tomorrow, seize this opportunity! Submit your resume and a compelling cover letter that showcases yourrelevant experience and articulates why joining us at Kongsberg Digital excites you.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At No Isolation, your work has real purpose. We’re on a mission to bring learning and belonging to every child — and we need a sharp digital mind to help us get there. You'll be part of an international and inspiring team making a real impact on society, and playing a key role in how we show up online.


⭐️ Your role and impact.

As our Digital Marketing Manager, you'll take the lead in building and optimising our digital presence — from paid ads to SEO and social media. You’ll run campaigns, follow the data, and keep levelling up performance, making sure No Isolation shows up in a meaningful way wherever people are searching, scrolling or clicking.

We’re growing fast, entering new markets, and reaching more educators and children than ever before, and you’ll be a key part of that momentum, helping us cut through the noise and get our message to the right people in the right way. You’ll work closely with the rest of the Marketing and Sales team, and you’ll be our in-house go-to for anything digital — guiding and inspiring with your knowledge, and helping the team stay digitally sharp.


🛠 What you'll be creating.

  • Run performance-driven campaigns across Google Ads, Facebook, LinkedIn and other platforms 

  • Own our SEO efforts — from keyword research to on-page/off-page improvements

  • Analyse user data and run A/B tests to improve conversion rates (CRO)

  • Collaborate with UX and creative designers to optimise landing pages and campaign creatives

  • Identify and manage direct ad placements on relevant industry sites

  • Plan and schedule organic social content tailored to different platforms

  • Write and publish website articles together with the wider marketing team

  • Maintain and optimise website content, including landing pages for regional

  • Track and report on key metrics, media spend, and campaign ROI campaigns


🎯 Who are we looking for?

You’re someone who gets excited about digital marketing, data, and finding smart, creative ways to drive results. You know your way around campaign tools and analytics dashboards, and you’re not afraid to dive into the details and make things happen. You’re curious, up-to-date on the latest digital marketing solutions, and you love testing out new things to see what works.


Your skill set includes.…

  • Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager

  • Solid understanding of SEM, SEO, CRO, A/B testing and analytics tools (e.g., Hotjar, Piwik Pro)

  • Proven track record in B2B digital marketing, preferably in a tech or digital agency environment

  • Experience managing direct media buys and negotiating placements

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English — and ideally fluency in another language from our core markets (Scandinavian or DACH)


🚀 What will make you stand out?

  • You’ve worked in high-performing teams or top digital agencies

  • You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • You bring a collaborative mindset and enjoy juggling a few things at once

  • You're passionate about meaningful work and using your skills for something that matters


What’s in it for YOU? 

🌍 Impactful work. Help us reach educators and decision-makers across Europe to bring learning and belonging to every child.

🎨 Autonomy and trust. Take ownership of our digital strategy and bring your ideas to life.

📈 Growth and development. You’ll be part of an exciting scale-up journey where the pace is fast and the opportunities are wide open — new markets, new roles, new ideas. There's plenty of room to grow.

🤝 Incredible colleagues. Work with smart, inspiring people who are truly passionate about what they do.

💻 Flexible setup. Core hours are 10–15, with a hybrid work model that allows you to split your time between home and the office.

🌱 Wellness support. We offer therapy sessions, mobile/internet reimbursements, wellness hours, and PJ days. 

📍 Location: Oslo or London (hybrid). You'll work closely with both the sales team and the rest of the global marketing team. 💰 Salary: NOK 550,000–700,000 / £40,000-50,000. This range is an estimate; the actual salary will depend on experience, skills, and other factors.


🤖 Who Are We?

No Isolation was founded in 2015 when we developed AV1, a telepresence robot that helps children and young people stay connected to their education during long-term absences due to illness. Our mission is to help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students.


nclusion And Diversity

At No Isolation, we value diversity and inclusion in our workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require adjustments during the application process, please contact us at below email.


We kindly ask external recruitment agencies and consultants to refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Our AV1 robots connect absent students, ensure learning and belonging, and support reintegration back to the classroom. Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students. No Isolation works across Europe, with 45 employees across Europe and in offices in Oslo, Munich and London. Join us in our growth journey!

jobs.title: Technical Support Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

Heimdall Power is a fast-growing Norwegian tech company, established in 2016. We have global ambitions and are already present in 17 European countries as well as the US and Asia. We provide solutions to optimize power grids worldwide, promoting a swift, secure and affordable green energy transition. Our unique offering combines software and sensors to increase grid capacity and monitor asset health. By enabling more efficient use of existing infrastructure we reduce carbon footprints while at the same time creating value for society, industry and our shareholders.


THE POSITION:

We are seeking a Technical Support Manager to build and lead Heimdall Power’s technical support organization. This role is critical in ensuring that our customers experience best-in-class operational support. The Technical Support Manager will be responsible for establishing and managing first-line support processes, monitoring system performance, managing escalations, and driving continuous improvements in customer support and technical operations.

This role requires a hands-on, proactive leader with a strong technical background, a passion for operational excellence, and a dedication to delivering outstanding customer service.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Building the Support Organization: Establish and grow Heimdall Power’s technical support team and processes. Improve support workflows, procedures, and best practices.

  • Monitoring & First-Line Support: Oversee daily monitoring of customer installations and system performance. Provide and manage efficient first-line technical support.

  • Reporting & Escalations: Implement structured reporting routines for incidents, performance metrics, and system health. Manage escalations by collaborating closely with engineering, and product teams.

  • Process Improvement: Identify and implement improvements to support processes, tools, and systems. Drive initiatives to increase support efficiency and customer satisfaction.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Customer Success, Operations, Engineering, and Product teams to ensure issues are addressed swiftly and effectively.

  • Customer Advocacy: Act as a key voice of the customer internally, ensuring that support insights are shared to improve our offerings.


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in technical support, operations, or system monitoring roles, preferably within technology or energy industries.

  • Experience in building or managing a technical support function is highly desirable.

  • Strong technical understanding of IoT systems, software platforms, and/or grid technologies.

  • Familiarity with support tools and ticketing systems.

  • Fluency in English is required; additional languages are a plus.


SKILLS:

  • High sense of ownership, structured mindset, and proactive problem-solving skills.

  • Strong leadership skills and the ability to build and motivate a team.

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic environment.

  • Customer-centric mindset with a passion for delivering high-quality support.

  • Ability to work effectively within an international team and across time zones.

  • Flexibility to accommodate operational needs outside standard business hours when necessary.



WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Competitive compensation package

  • An energetic, young, and dynamic work environment

  • A chance to work with top-tier technology and contribute directly to the green transition on a global scale

  • Professional development. We strongly believe in the growth of our employees. At Heimdall Power, you will be given the necessary tools to grow as a person and a professional.

  • Work-life balance. We offer flexible working conditions, allowing you to balance your professional and personal life.


At Heimdall Power, you’ll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and to ensure that we drive customers towards success, helping towards a meaningful change in the energy sector. If you’re passionate about developing the electrical grid, project management, thrive in a collaborative environment, and excel at building strong customer relationships, we want to hear from you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

In Norse mythology, Heimdall is the all-seeing, all-knowing watchman who guards Asgard, the home of the gods. He possesses extraordinary abilities to see for hundreds of miles, hear the faintest of sounds, and stands vigilant at the Bifrost, the rainbow bridge connecting Asgard to the world of mortals, ready to sound the Gjallarhorn at the first sign of danger. Much like the mythical guardian, Heimdall Power ensures the safety and efficiency of power grids. Founded in Norway in 2016, we provide accurate, cost-effective monitoring of both grid capacity and health. We achieve this through advanced grid-enhancing technologies, combining world-leading sensors (Neurons) and software (Heimdall’s Brain) to optimize the performance and reliability of energy networks. Our unique autonomous drone installation system facilitates safe, quick, and scalable deployment worldwide. With our help, grid operators can unlock up to 40% more capacity in their high-voltage power grids while simultaneously improving operational safety. Our technology equips you to meet the increasing demand for electricity while reducing the need for expensive infrastructure upgrades.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

Heimdall Power is a fast-growing Norwegian tech company established in 2016. We have global ambitions and are already present in several European countries as well as the US and Asia. We provide solutions to optimize power grids worldwide, promoting a swift, secure, and affordable transition to green energy. Our unique offering combines software and sensors to increase grid capacity and monitor asset health. By enabling the more efficient use of existing infrastructure, we reduce carbon footprints while creating value for society, industry, and our shareholders.


THE POSITION:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to help shape and deliver the core software powering Heimdall Power's grid operations platform. You will play a key role in designing and developing scalable backend services that enable real-time data processing, grid insights, and operational insights for utilities worldwide.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on building backend services and software components that integrate with utility operational systems. You'll contribute to data pipelines, APIs, and automation that help our customers operate the power grid more efficiently and safely. This includes implementing aggregation techniques for time-series data, developing features that improve both user-facing insights and developer observability, and building robust backend infrastructure that supports both cloud and customer-hosted deployments.

You'll join a team that values clarity, simplicity, and long-term maintainability. We work from a monorepo, use shared infrastructure and tooling, and apply Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to ensure our software accurately reflects the complexity of the energy grid. We aim to build things once—and build them right.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Software Development: Design, implement, and maintain robust backend services using modern technologies and best practices

  • Architecture & Design: Contribute to system design decisions, ensuring modularity, scalability, and maintainability

  • Grid Integration: Build services and components for data ingestion, processing, and integration into customer operational systems

  • Data & Observability: Implement time-series aggregation, developer observability, and user-facing insights using the Grafana stack

  • Collaboration: Work closely with other engineers, product managers, and domain experts to deliver complete solutions

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify areas for performance optimization, automation, and architectural improvements


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

  • 5-8+ years of experience in backend development, ideally in distributed systems or data-intensive applications

  • Strong proficiency in C# and .NET is required.

  • Experience with cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and containerized environments (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and system observability

  • Strong experience with relational databases (especially PostgreSQL); bonus if you've worked with time-series data and PostgreSQL extensions such as Citus


SKILLS:

  • Strong sense of ownership, autonomy, and accountability

  • Pragmatic engineering mindset with attention to quality and performance

  • Ability to take initiative and work independently in a cross-functional setting

  • Comfortable working across data, APIs, infrastructure, and observability layers

  • Passion for sustainability, innovation, and building systems that have real-world impact


WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Competitive compensation package

  • An energetic and dynamic work environment

  • A chance to work with top-tier technology and contribute directly to the green transition on a global scale

  • Professional Development: We strongly believe in the growth and development of our employees. At Heimdall Power, you will be given the necessary tools to grow as a person and a professional

  • Work-life balance: We offer flexible working conditions, allowing you to balance your professional and personal life


At Heimdall Power, you will contribute to technology that supports the global transition to clean energy. If you are excited about solving complex challenges and building impactful software that makes a difference, we would love to hear from you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

In Norse mythology, Heimdall is the all-seeing, all-knowing watchman who guards Asgard, the home of the gods. He possesses extraordinary abilities to see for hundreds of miles, hear the faintest of sounds, and stands vigilant at the Bifrost, the rainbow bridge connecting Asgard to the world of mortals, ready to sound the Gjallarhorn at the first sign of danger. Much like the mythical guardian, Heimdall Power ensures the safety and efficiency of power grids. Founded in Norway in 2016, we provide accurate, cost-effective monitoring of both grid capacity and health. We achieve this through advanced grid-enhancing technologies, combining world-leading sensors (Neurons) and software (Heimdall’s Brain) to optimize the performance and reliability of energy networks. Our unique autonomous drone installation system facilitates safe, quick, and scalable deployment worldwide. With our help, grid operators can unlock up to 40% more capacity in their high-voltage power grids while simultaneously improving operational safety. Our technology equips you to meet the increasing demand for electricity while reducing the need for expensive infrastructure upgrades.

We're a multidisciplinary team of scientists, engineers, and product thinkers committed to impact and innovation. Based in Oslo, we foster a pragmatic, collaborative culture that values autonomy and technical excellence.

Our team represents 12 nationalities, and we believe that diversity fuels high performance, creativity, innovation, and success. We strive to ensure that everyone feels valued, heard and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. If you’re passionate about our mission, we’d love to have you on board!


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior or Principal Software Engineer to lead core systems development across backend infrastructure, ML inference pipelines, and edge computing workloads. You’ll operate across architecture and implementation, working on systems that enable real-time tracking of birds and bats, on-device species classification, and scalable data onboarding.

This is a high-impact technical leadership role, with deep individual contribution and strong cross-functional collaboration. You’ll help shape system design, guide other engineers, and take ownership of critical software foundations.


What you’ll Do

  • Architect and implement scalable backend cloud services using Python, Postgres, Docker, and AWS

  • Design and build low-latency edge computing pipelines

  • Collaborate with ML engineers to deploy and optimize vision-language models in production

  • Lead development of systems for customer onboarding, processing pipeline orchestration, and PTZ camera control

  • Apply geometry and trigonometry to solve spatial computing problems in tracking and classification

  • Drive engineering standards and best practices, design reviews, and technical direction across the team

  • Mentor junior engineers through pairing, review, and collaborative design


What we’re looking for

We recognize that experience comes in many forms, and we encourage you to apply even if you don’t check every box. If you’re excited about our mission and eager to make an impact, we want to hear from you!

We think you’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Minimum 6 years of professional software engineering experience

  • Strong backend development skills, particularly in Python and cloud-native systems

  • Hands-on experience with computer vision applications in production

  • Proficiency in a compiled systems language (Rust or C++) for edge computing

  • Solid understanding of mathematics, especially geometry and trigonometry

  • Proven ability to lead technical architecture while remaining deeply hands-on

  • Effective collaborator with a bias toward simplicity, clarity, and reliability


🚀 Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with camera control systems (e.g. PTZ devices)

  • Familiarity with real-time video processing and edge deployment

  • Background in IoT, robotics, or sensor networks

  • Exposure to pipeline orchestration and data onboarding systems


Why join Spoor?

🌍 Work on a mission that matters: making renewable energy safer for nature

🧠 Solve hard, real-world problems in AI, edge computing, and applied math 🤝 Join a focused, collaborative team where your work has visible impact

🏢 Be based in Oslo with a high degree of autonomy and technical ownership

What are you waiting for? Apply now!

jobs.title: Fullstack Software Engineer - Data & AI
jobs.description:
👋 Hey there! We’re Attensi – a tech company born in Norway with a passion for gamified simulation training. Since 2012, we’ve gone global, and today our solutions are used by some of the world’s biggest brands in 150+ countries and 50+ languages.

We combine gamification, realistic interactive scenarios, and decision-driven dialogues – all powered by our own game AI – to create immersive, hands-on learning experiences. It's a radically new way to deliver high-impact training that scales across large organizations and actually sticks.

We work with some of the world’s largest brands in energy, retail, hospitality, pharma, professional services, and more – including Circle K, The Boston Consulting Group, PwC, Accenture, KPMG, ABB, Zurich, and Novartis. We are currently over 240 Game Changers across Europe and the US – with 140 of us based in our HQ in Oslo.

We're now seeking a developer who understands both code and context — someone who can build interfaces that make data actionable.


Join Attensi INSIGHTS — where raw training data becomes clear, actionable stories.

We’re building a next-generation analytics platform that helps users explore, interpret, and act on complex datasets with ease. Your work will shape the interfaces that turn this data into real impact for our clients.

This is a fullstack role with a strong frontend focus — ideal for someone who loves building user-first data products, learns fast, and thrives at the intersection of design, data, and AI. You’ll be a key part of a nimble, cross-functional team, collaborating with backend services and our data platform team to create seamless, high-performance web experiences. We value velocity, clarity, and autonomy — and we’re looking for someone who does too.

  • Build intuitive, data-rich interfaces that support deep exploration and storytelling

  • Translate complex data structures into clean, interactive UIs

  • Contribute to AI-driven product features that surface insights and drive decisions

  • Collaborate closely with backend and data teams on architecture and APIs

  • Write scalable, maintainable code focused on user value and performance


The stack you'll work with: We use a modern, evolving tech stack. You don’t need to know it all — but you should be eager to learn fast and go deep when needed:

  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript

  • Backend: Node.js, C#, .NET

  • Data: PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Docker, data visualization tools

  • AI & Analytics: Tools for structured data handling and model integration


Who are you?

  • A frontend-leaning fullstack engineer who’s built complex web-based apps — ideally with a data or analytics focus

  • Curious, resourceful, and fast-learning — you pick up new technologies quickly and thrive in fast-moving environments

  • Comfortable navigating both frontend and backend architecture, and how they fit together to deliver value

  • Passionate about building clean, understandable interfaces that empower users

  • Excited by the opportunity to work on AI-native tools and help shape how people interact with data in the future

  • A team player who collaborates closely with engineers, designers, and product thinkers

What do we offer?

At Attensi, you’ll become part of an exciting and rapidly growing scale-up that’s already a global leader in its field. You’ll work in a flat, open, and collaborative environment, surrounded by committed, smart, and talented colleagues from diverse backgrounds — both culturally and academically.

We’re committed to giving people the opportunity to grow with us, and you’ll be able to shape your role over time. Expect exciting challenges in a dynamic, innovative environment with big ambitions.

We work hard, but we also have a lot of fun. From Attensi-days to sporting events, after-work drinks, parties, game nights, hackathons, guilds and company trips — we make sure we don’t just work together, we play together too.


Excited to make training data simple, meaningful, and actionable?

Send us your CV — and if you’ve got any dashboards, data projects, or frontend work you’re proud of, we’d love to check them out. Bonus points if you can share something you’ve built!

We’re looking for curious, collaborative developers who want to make a real difference by turning complex data into simple, powerful tools — and who are excited to grow and push boundaries with a passionate, product-driven team.

You’ll be a key contributor to help us grow with the passionate and talented individuals needed to reduce social isolation and improve lives through technology. This is more than just a job; it’s a chance to make a tangible impact on society by helping us attract and hire the people who will drive our mission forward.


⭐️ What will be your mission?

Our People & Organization Team is growing! We’re expanding our Talent Acquisition team by adding a second Talent Acquisition Manager to help scale our efforts in attracting and hiring top talent. You will play a crucial role in sourcing, attracting, and hiring the best candidates to meet No Isolation’s recruitment needs as we grow in existing and new markets. Working closely with hiring managers, you will ensure they are supported in identifying and selecting the right talent to fuel our expansion.

Additionally, you’ll play a key role in enhancing our employer brand, continuously improve No Isolation’s ability to attract top talent and ensure a positive candidate experience. You will report to the Chief People & Organization Officer.


What you'll be doing...

Collaborating with hiring managers:

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand their recruitment needs and align the hiring process with business needs and goals

  • Provide guidance on interview techniques and candidate selection processes

Sourcing and recruitment:

  • Proactively source candidates across current and emerging markets

  • Produce compelling job postings

  • Streamline and automate recruitment tasks to improve efficiency

Working across markets:

  • Support international recruitment across multiple countries, adapting to local candidate markets, hiring cultures, and role-specific expectations

Candidate screening and assessment:

  • Review resumes and applications

  • Conduct initial interviews to shortlist candidates

  • Manage and interpret Alva Labs assessments to support data-informed hiring decisions

Employer branding:

  • Promote our employer brand across online platforms and social media

  • Maintain and develop our career site to reflect No Isolation’s employee value proposition

Candidate experience:

Who are you?

You bring experience from international recruitment and know how to adapt sourcing strategies, communication styles and hiring processes to suit different candidate markets and cultures.

  • Sourcing expertise: You know how to find the right candidates across various channels. Going forward we will mainly be looking to hire commercial roles (sales and customer success)

  • Communication skills: You’re a great communicator, able to build trust and rapport with both candidates and hiring managers

  • Organizational abilities: You’re able to manage multiple vacancies and deadlines simultaneously

  • Resilience: You have a can-do mentality and can perform well under pressure

  • Proactive approach: You’re self-driven and always looking for ways to learn and improve

🎥 Show us what excites you about joining our team! You can upload a short video as part of your application. This is completely optional but gives us a chance to get to know you beyond your CV. Let your personality and passion shine!

Today, there are 4,000 active AV1 robots used across 19 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students.

If you require adjustments during the application process, please contact our Talent Acquisition Manager, Julia Riis at riis at noisolation.com
