jobs.title: Validation Engineer
jobs.description:
About Nofence

Nofence is a Norwegian scale up who has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we are revolutionizing livestock management we need more top-notch competence in our Engineering team, and we are now looking for a Validation Engineer.

About the Role

As a Hardware Validation Engineer you will be part of the New Product Development Team (NPD team), who's responsible for developing new hardware from prototype phase to volume manufacturing. Your work environment will be a mix of lab life and farm life. 

Main tasks:

  • User research to understand the various environments in which our products are used.

  • Develop test equipment and validation processes for our lab.

  • Develop and execute field tests.

  • Document test procedures and results.

  • Contribute on hardware development.

You will be part of a core team of quality engineers who together cover validation in the field and lab. In projects you will cooperate with the rest of the engineering team, and you will report to the Engineering Manager for the NPD team. Your work life will be spent 50% in the lab close to Oslo, 25% in office (including a bit of travel to see your colleagues in Trondheim, Molde and beyond) and 25% on travel to do field and animal research.

Animal and environmental research

Understanding our current and new markets is crucial for developing state of the art validation procedures. This means that you will need to be actively involved in doing user and environmental studies so that you can best replicate field use of our product in order to simulate in the lab. This means a varied work schedule where you need to be able to travel when needed to our key markets in Europe and the US.

In the lab

Back in the lab you will replicate the conditions from the field by running and developing our test equipment and procedures. You shall be able to document data in a structured way and communicate findings to our stakeholders.

Working with the animals

Not everything in the field can be replicated in the lab. Especially when you design for animals. You will also plan, conduct and document user and animal tests in the field. This means that you shall be comfortable working in farm environments with animals and our heroes: the farmers.


Experience and qualifications

  • Bachelor or Master degree in electrical, mechanical, automation engineering or a similar discipline.

  • Experience with lab validation of hardware.

  • Enjoy working in an autonomous cross-functional team.

  • Structured with the ability to document and communicate your work.

  • Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.

  • Comfortable working hands on in farm environments around the world.


What can we offer?

Your work will directly shape products used by farmers worldwide, influencing animal welfare and sustainable farming.

You’ll work hands-on with state-of-the-art AgTech hardware, both in the field and in our lab, combining innovation with real-world impact. This is a role full of variety, flexibility, and purpose. Frequent travel to farms and test sites will take you beyond the office, turning your workdays into a mix of exploration, collaboration, and practical problem-solving.  We offer a competitive salary and the opportunity to be part of a fun, supportive and collaborative team.

Still curious? Visit our website. We will evaluate candidates continuously. If you have any questions about Nofence or regarding the application, please reach out to our Engineering Manager NPD, Kjetil Grimsæth at below email.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Målsettingen til Nofence er å få beitedyra ut på beite, på en trygg og god måte, slik at de kan ha det godt og selv finne den maten de er skapt for å spise.Vi vil at beitedyr skal få muligheten til å ta i bruk sitt naturlige miljø. Det er god dyrevelferd og det vil frigjøre store arealer som kan brukes til å dyrke menneskemat i stedet for soya i kraftforproduksjon.Vår teknologi gir dyra denne muligheten.

With our wide selection and competitive prices, we deliver to the doorsteps of thousands of Scandinavian homes every week.


We are looking for drivers to work weekend shifts from Alnabru! As a driver with us, you play an essential role in representing Oda to our customers. You will be part of our dedicated team of drivers and report to the Delivery Operating Manager and Delivery Team Leaders on site. You’ll be delivering groceries and packages to our many customers in the area. We believe you'll like working as a driver at Oda if you can manage your time effectively, work independently and in a team, and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. Additionally, it would be best to enjoy being active, as this job involves a lot of physical activity, not only driving.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Delivering food and packages to our customers.

  • Maintain efficiency and quality in our work by loading and unloading goods, handling customers, and implementing routines and processes.

  • Ensuring Customer service at the highest level.

  • Be responsible for simple maintenance of the car fleet, such as changing light bulbs, topping up liquids, and keeping the cars clean and presentable at all times.

  • Training new drivers on the road.

  • Contributing to the improvement of driver routines and processes.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Driving license (Class B) with a minimum of 2 year's driving experience.

  • Speaking English is required, and familiarity with Norwegian or another Nordic language is a plus.


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Are active and like it, as this is a physically demanding job

  • Likes working independently and with a team

  • Have a good work ethic

  • Are service-oriented and solution-oriented.

  • Have a genuine desire to succeed and make customers happy

  • Responsible and prioritizes safe behaviour in traffic


What we offer 🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact as a Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.


Practical informationℹ️

  • Application deadline: Assessed on an ongoing basis

  • Starting date: As soon as possible

  • Location: Verkseier Furulunds Vei 1, Oslo

  • Working hours: This position rotates between working every other weekend


At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.


Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium!


We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

As part of our work to ensure a fair and open-minded recruitment process, we have chosen to collaborate with Hubert.ai, a virtual recruitment assistant that helps with the selection process. As soon as you submit an application for this position, you will be invited via email to a chat-based interview. Therefore, be careful to enter your correct email address so that the invitation reaches the right person🤖

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about optimizing marketing workflows and creating impactful customer experiences through technology?

reMarkable is looking for a Marketing Cloud Specialist to join our dynamic team and drive the future of our Marketing Cloud ecosystem!

In this role, you’ll play a key part in shaping and executing world-class marketing automation processes that are at the core of our customer engagement strategy. Working with cross-functional teams, you’ll bring your expertise in Salesforce Marketing Cloud to help us create seamless, personalized journeys that engage our customers and make a real difference.


About reMarkable

reMarkable creates hardware and software products that help people all over the world find focus. We want to combine the best of both worlds: the digital and the analogue, and to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence for knowledge workers. Our tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new. We are enabling better thinking through technology.

Join us in preserving human creativity amidst a sea of technological time thieves!


About the role:

As a Marketing Cloud Specialist at reMarkable, you'll be instrumental in shaping our customer communication strategy. You'll optimize event-based and transactional workflows, ensuring timely and personalized messaging, while also strategically partnering with business teams to translate their goals into scalable technical solutions aligned with our broader Marketing, Sales, and Software objectives.

You'll lead the technical execution within Marketing Cloud, managing data extensions, AMPscript, and dynamic content, always ensuring compliance with global privacy regulations (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA). Collaborating with developers, you'll configure API calls, data syncs, and real-time message triggers. As a technical leader, you'll guide design, testing, QA, and deployment, troubleshooting issues and documenting technical specifications. Your proactive approach will include championing new feature developments in Marketing Cloud that drive significant benefits across reMarkable.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Proactively identify new feature developments within Marketing Cloud, advocating for those that align with and deliver benefits to wider reMarkable business goals.

  • Champion platform adoption and knowledge sharing by supporting super user and stakeholder training sessions and developing comprehensive enablement documentation.

  • Drive strategic business enablement by working with cross-functional teams to translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions within Marketing Cloud, aligning with Marketing, Sales, and Software objectives.

  • Lead prioritization meetings and manage sprints for the Marketing stream, ensuring efficient project delivery.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for key partnerships such as Signature Success MCE and DeSelect, fostering strong relationships and maximising platform value.

  • Build and optimise event-based triggered customer journeys (e.g., payment confirmations, shipping updates), including data extensions, AMPscript, and templates.


We are looking for someone with:

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and related technologies.

  • Strong expertise in designing and optimizing marketing automation workflows.

  • Experience with AMPscript, dynamic content, and transactional templates.

  • Knowledge of API integrations and data synchronization processes.

  • Familiarity with compliance standards (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA).

  • Proven experience leading cross-functional teams and workshops.

  • Experience in troubleshooting technical issues related to email systems and integrations.


As a person you have collaborative mindset who is passionate about continuous improvement and actively seeks opportunities to drive technical solutions. You have strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders.


Practical Information:

  • We will consider applications on a rolling basis.

  • Language requirements: Our company language is English.

  • Location: Oslo, Norway.

  • Visa requirements: Citizenship/valid work permit from the EU/EEA (Relocation assistance can be provided).


Why reMarkable?

  • A modern campus located central in Oslo, specially designed to reflect reMarkable as a company.

  • Access to a free employee gym with top equipment.

  • A flexible hybrid work model

  • 5 extra “reMarkable days” you can make use of in addition to regular vacation.

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deepdive and be creative.

  • Premium health insurance, travel insurance, and home broadband coverage.

  • Access to our employee share incentive scheme.

  • Most importantly: We have fun! We have regular events and social gatherings.


At reMarkable, we are constantly evolving, and we need exceptional talent like you to help us shape the future. If you’re ready to make an impact with your technical expertise in Marketing Cloud, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now and become part of the reMarkable team, where your work will inspire better thinking through technology!

As part of our hiring process, we assess candidates' affiliation with high-risk countries, defined by PST (Norwegian Police Security Service), for security purposes. We also conduct background checks for candidates in the final stages. Data is handled in full compliance with privacy regulations. Should you reach the final stages of the recruitment process, you will be informed. Background checks will not be performed without your knowledge.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

reMarkable is on a mission to help people think better through technology in a distracted world. Our paper tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new - enabling better thinking through technology. We have sold millions of devices worldwide, wanting to combine the best of the digital and analogue to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence. To help us get there, we need colleagues that want to make a real difference through their work – and that’s where you come in! Find our current job openings here: https://jobs.remarkable.com/jobs

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer (CPO)
jobs.description:
At Tise, we’re on a mission to create the world’s best second-hand marketplace — a place where sustainability meets style, and where buying pre-loved feels even better than buying new. We’re looking for a visionary Chief Product Officer (CPO) to join our leadership team in Oslo, Norway.

In this role, you’ll lead our talented Product & Design team of 12, directly leading 5 senior team members while being responsible for the full product development process from vision to execution. You’ll collaborate with our CEO and team to influence the trajectory of Tise, guaranteeing we continue developing products that resonate with our community.

We’re seeking someone fluent in English, who knows the magic of Tise, understands our community, and thrives at the intersection of product, design, and business. The successful candidate will be a curious, experienced leader with a track record of creating products people love — and ready to help us take second-hand shopping to the next level.


What you will accomplish:

  • Oversee the Product & Design department, ensuring we deliver outstanding experiences for our users.

  • Own the vision and execution of product development across Tise.

  • Work closely with the CEO, and the rest of the leadership team to set company direction.

  • Identify and prioritise opportunities that will shape the future of second-hand shopping.

  • Support, mentor, and develop our skilled product managers and designers.


What you will bring:

  • A consistent track record in product development, ideally from a startup or scale-up, and bring diverse experiences and perspectives from more than one environment.

  • A bridge-builder, able to capture what’s happening across teams and ensure clarity, alignment, and collaboration.

  • Leading with empathy and fairness, creating psychological safety and trust, while also holding people accountable and following up on expectations.

  • Highly data- and experiment-driven, comfortable with analytics, A/B testing, and emerging technologies like AI/ML

  • Ability to combine strategic vision with practical execution, focusing upwards and outwards on growth and opportunity rather than micromanagement.

  • Understand how to connect product, business, and growth, and are skilled at managing partners.


Why Tise?

  • Join a purposeful company that’s shaping a more sustainable future.

  • Be part of a dedicated, passionate, and kind team.

  • Have a real say in the direction of the product — and the company.

  • Competitive compensation package including equity options.

  • Be part of our vibrant Oslo HQ and unique team.


Let’s create the best second-hand marketplace in the world — together!

Application will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Questions for the role can be directed to Head of People at below email.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Tise, we’re on a mission to inspire people to make more sustainable choices in their everyday lives – in a simple and fun way. Our platform is designed to make it easy, enjoyable, and inspiring to buy and sell secondhand. With over 4 million users and a passionate community of Tise’ers across the Nordics, we’ve experienced strong growth in recent years! 🌱

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.description:
We're thrilled that you're considering a career at Kindly! Here's everything you need to know about this job. 🥳

Do you want to lead the next wave of AI-driven customer experiences in Europe? Are you passionate about scaling SaaS platforms and building world-class engineering teams? We’re looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to join Kindly at a pivotal moment in our growth.

As we scale, we need a CTO who can own our long-term technical strategy, elevate our AI and automation capabilities, and lead our outstanding engineering organization. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of conversational AI across Europe.


About Kindly 🟢

Kindly is a tech scale-up company of 70+ employees, working out of Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, and Amsterdam! We create AI-agents for businesses, particularly in the B2C sector. We have over 150 incredible clients that include Booking.com, Voi, Tele 2, Boozt Fashion, Kahoot!, TV4, and Norwegian Airlines – just to name a few. Our tech reaches over one million users every month, and we handle thousands of messages every hour.

We believe that one of the key factors for success in a job is enjoying your workplace. At Kindly, we all work towards common goals, and everyone wants the best for each other. We want you to have fun at work! That's why it's important for us that when we hire new people, they share this philosophy.  


About the role👋 

As the CTO at Kindly, you will be part of the Management Team and responsible for all aspects of Kindly’s technology and product architecture. You’ll lead our engineering, DevOps, and AI/ML teams consisting of 20+ people in Oslo, while working closely with Product, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure we deliver robust, scalable, and innovative solutions.

This is both a strategic and operational role. You'll drive the technical vision but also explore architecture decisions, security, platform scalability, and team structure.


What you’ll be doing 📋

As a CTO, your job will be to:

  • Define and execute the long-term technology roadmap aligned with business goals

  • Lead and scale a distributed team of software engineers, AI specialists, and technical leaders

  • Ensure our platform is scalable, secure, and reliable for enterprise customers across Europe while laying the foundation for global growth

  • Drive our AI strategy, integrating LLMs and automation into customer-facing use cases

  • Collaborate with Product to accelerate feature delivery and innovation

  • Own the technical hiring strategy, processes, and team culture

  • Represent Kindly’s tech strategy to key customers, partners, investors, and the board

  • Stay close to architecture and implementation to ensure technical excellence

  • Champion agile practices, continuous delivery, and a strong DevOps mindset

  • Evolve Kindly into a fully agentic platform, using technologies like MCP, ML, and LLMs


Who you are 🏌️

  • You have led engineering or product teams in a scaling B2B SaaS company

  • Strong technical background—ideally hands-on at some point—with experience in building cloud-native, API-first platforms

  • Experience working with AI/ML or LLM-driven products is a big plus

  • You’ve scaled systems, teams, and infrastructure to meet enterprise-grade reliability and security

  • Collaborative and pragmatic—you balance product velocity with long-term architecture

  • You lead with empathy and clarity, and are comfortable coaching teams through growth and change

  • You’re comfortable in an international environment and fluent in English

  • Bonus: You have experience with and enjoy public speaking


The Kindly perks 🛍️

  • Kindly offer a pleasant, inclusive, and creative workplace. We give our team both responsibility and trust, along with the opportunity to shape their own working day

  • Large degree of professional freedom

  • Recognition of hard work and direct influence on our products

  • Modern office, situated near Oslo Central Station

  • Option to buy stocks at a discount

  • Modern gym with everything you need to get a sweat in

  • Subsidized employee restaurant with delicious food

  • Competitive salary and conditions

  • All the necessary hardware to thrive in the role

  • 2-day bi-monthly Hackathon during work hours

  • Personal development hours during work hours (10 hours /month)


That's it for now. There is more to tell, but let's do that if you find this interesting 🤞


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kindly is one of Europe’s leading chatbot providers specializing in the development of artificial intelligence and automation solutions for customer service and communication. The company offers a platform that combines advanced machine learning techniques and natural language processing (NLP) to enhance the customer experience and improve the efficiency of customer service processes.

jobs.title: Head of Business Technology
jobs.description:
Location: Oslo, Norway or Stockholm, Sweden

Reports to: COO


About Nofence

Nofence is a Norwegian scale-up who has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionize livestock management, we will need top-notch competence within Business Technology / IT, and we are now looking for a Head of Business Technology. This position can be performed from our Stockholm or Oslo office. Occasional travel will be required. Elevate your career with us and be at the forefront of innovation in agricultural technology!


The Role

As Head of Business Technology at Nofence, you will define, build, and lead our business technology function shaping the systems, data, and infrastructure that enable scalable growth and operational excellence.

Reporting to the COO, you’ll combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution. You’ll balance transformation with reliable, secure, and scalable operations that keep our business running smoothly every day.

This role carries ownership for the business technology roadmap, budget, and delivery. You’ll ensure investments are cost-effective, compliant, and aligned with business objectives, while driving the adoption of tools, data, and platforms that empower every team at Nofence.


Key Responsibilities

Tech Strategy & Governance

  • Define and execute Nofence’s business technology strategy and enterprise architecture

  • Manage the business technology budget, optimizing cost efficiency and value realization

  • Define technology standards, interoperability principles, and governance frameworks

  • Manage run/change portfolios, allocate capacity, and track technical debt and dependencies

  • Serve as product owner for enterprise platforms by managing roadmaps, partners, and delivery

Data & Business Intelligence

  • Establish data governance, MDM, and quality SLAs with clear domain ownership

  • Define and implement the BI strategy to deliver a trusted single source of truth and enable self-service analytics

Security, Risk & Compliance

  • Own information security, privacy, and compliance frameworks

  • Oversee risk management, vendor assessments, and audit readiness

  • Define business continuity and disaster recovery plans with clear response governance

Operations & Reliability

  • Design and maintain scalable, secure, and resilient IT infrastructure

  • Oversee end-user IT services, including device lifecycle, software provisioning, and service desk operations

  • Lead the evaluation and rollout of platforms such as ERP, CRM, e-commerce, and low/no-code tools, always balancing governance, security, and ROI

  • Implement QA and release governance for enterprise platforms and integrations

Ecosystem & Vendor Management

  • Own the partner and vendor landscape across enterprise platforms and services

  • Negotiate contracts, manage SLAs/OLAs, and ensure transparent SaaS/cloud spend through FinOps practices

Stakeholder & Change Management

  • Collaborate with Product & Engineering, Finance, Commercial, and Operations to deliver secure, scalable solutions that enable business performance

  • Serve as the executive point of contact for IT, ensuring transparent communication, alignment, and proactive risk management

  • Drive user adoption and readiness for new systems and processes through structured change management

Talent & Organization

  • Design the future IT organization, hire and develop key roles

  • Build team capabilities and foster effective collaboration across technical and business teams


Collaboration with Product & Engineering

This role focuses on business technology: the systems, data, and infrastructure that enable scalable internal operations.

Our Product & Engineering teams retain full ownership of customer-facing technology, development frameworks, and cloud architecture decisions. The Head of Business Technology will collaborate closely as a consultative partner to ensure coherence, data flow, and security across the enterprise landscape.


What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of IT leadership experience, ideally in a fast-growing international environment

  • Proven track record in IT strategy, systems/enterprise architecture, and infrastructure management

  • Deep understanding of IT security, privacy, compliance, and risk management frameworks

  • Experience managing run/change portfolios, platform roadmaps, and technical debt

  • Strong knowledge of data governance, MDM, and modern BI tooling

  • Experience managing IT budgets, P&L accountability, SaaS/cloud FinOps, and vendor relationships

  • Background with ERP, CRM, process automation, and integrations

  • Skilled in defining and enforcing QA/release governance and service SLAs

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder alignment skills across all levels

  • Hands-on leader with experience hiring and developing high-performing IT teams

  • Fluent in English (Norwegian or Swedish is a plus)


Why Join Nofence

Join a passionate, mission-driven team redefining agriculture through innovation. You’ll have end-to-end ownership of the business technology function, shaping how systems and data drive growth, efficiency, and security across the company.

If you’re ready to combine strategic influence with hands-on execution and make a real-world impact, we’d love to hear from you.


Apply Now

Apply through Teamtailor and tell us how your experience can help Nofence scale with secure, reliable, and impactful business technology.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Oslo
jobs.description:

Join Scrive and be part of an international, fast-growing company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. Collaborate with smart, caring, and driven colleagues across Europe as we shape the Scrive story. 🚀

We are currently looking for an Account Executive to join our team and play a key role in expanding Scrive’s presence in the Norwegian market. jobs.title: Integration Manager
jobs.description:
At Tise, we’re on a mission to create the world’s best second-hand marketplace — where sustainability meets style and where buying pre-loved feels even better than buying new. Following our acquisition by eBay, we’re entering an exciting new chapter, and we’re now looking for an Integration Manager to help us shape the future of Tise as we integrate into the broader eBay ecosystem 🚀

In this role, you’ll play a crucial part in supporting the successful integration of new acquisitions into eBay’s back-office functions, working closely with Tise’s Integration Lead. You’ll help assist in coordinating day-to-day integration activities, scheduling meetings, maintaining documentation, and facilitating communication between functional leads, acquired teams, and central integration partners. The Integration Manager is a key teammate ensuring processes run efficiently, issues are tracked, and deliverables are met, without owning overall program management responsibilities.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys bringing structure, clarity, and follow-through to complex projects — and who’s excited about contributing to one of the most interesting integrations in the Nordic tech scene.


What you’ll accomplish:

  • Support integration activities across Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance, IT, and Facilities by tracking progress, documenting updates, and ensuring follow-up on deliverables

  • Coordinate schedules for meetings, workshops, and delivery reviews with functional leads and integration partners

  • Maintain up-to-date documentation — including trackers, action logs, and status reports for integration workstreams, as directed by the Integration Lead

  • Prepare meeting notes, circulate action items, and ensure partners complete deliverables on time

  • Identify and raise operational issues, resource needs, or blockers to the Integration Lead

  • Assist with onboarding logistics for new tools, systems, and employees post-close, ensuring compliance with integration playbooks

  • Facilitate communication with acquired employees to ensure clear updates and a smooth integration experience

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO SALG
jobs.description:
At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.

Our world-class logistics and tech solutions allow us to reduce food waste, save time and money, and ease the mental and physical load for people who want more space for life.


We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join Oda!

We’re looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to join our Infrastructure & Organizational Engineering team in Oda! You’ll work on the fundamental platform that keeps our systems running, while helping our product and platform teams move faster and more reliably. This is a senior role in a small, highly competent team where you’ll have real influence over how things are built and operated.

You’ll develop and operate scalable cloud-based systems, shaping the platform that enables teams across Oda to own their services from code to production. Expect autonomy, ownership, complex problems, and the chance to make existing systems even better. We value people who take initiative, enjoy solving tough challenges, and thrive in an environment where you can move fast and have a tangible impact.

Our platform is built on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes/GKE, powered by a custom deployment system. For observability, we use the Grafana stack, and for Infrastructure as Code, it’s Terraform all the way. On the coding side, you’ll work with Python, and with a bit of Go and Rust sprinkled in for glue. Oh, and yes — YAML might occasionally make an appearance in your workflow.


What you’ll be doing as a Platform Engineer

  • Develop and operate scalable cloud infrastructure.

  • Build and maintain our development platform.

  • Support and accelerate developers by providing tools and best practices for deployment, reliability, security, and observability.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Have experience with cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code (IaC), container orchestration, observability, monitoring, and alerting systems.

  • Are proficient in one or more programming/scripting languages, along with knowledge of DevOps tools, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, cloud security, and network design, particularly in cloud networking.

  • Have great communication skills and know how to work well with both technical and non-technical people.

  • Have fluency in English, both written and spoken; Norwegian is a plus.

  • Are self-motivated and take responsibility for tasks from start to finish.

  • Are eager to learn new things and share knowledge with others.

  • Are committed to writing clean, scalable, and maintainable code.


What we offer 🚀

  • A close-knit Infrastructure & Organizational Engineering team that supports and enables our organization. Curious about how the team works? You can read more about it here!

  • A chance to make a real impact as a Platform Engineer in a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A buzzing office at Tøyen, with lunch made by our very own chefs. 🧑‍🍳

  • A collaborative approach-we tackle exciting tech and product challenges together, across different fields.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job. 🧡

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

Application deadline: 21/10/2025

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.
