jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
Are you comfortable in a world where criminal gangs are well funded, life savings of innocent people are destroyed and vulnerable people are trafficked? Do you think financial crime pays? Ever think that selling a Saas solution could help you combat this and be part of the solution? Keep reading…

Strise is a technology company, that helps top-tier banks, fintechs, and other financial institutions fight financial crime through our AI-powered AML automation solutions.

We make an impact by making it easier and faster for banks to fulfill their mission of uncovering financial violations, like money laundering. As a Series A stage company, with investors like Atomico, we're on an extremely ambitious growth trajectory.

After successfully becoming trusted by over 70% of the biggest financial institutions in Scandinavia, we are now expanding into the UK, followed by the rest of Europe. We’re well on our way to becoming the global standard in anti-money laundering.


Apply if?

  • You are ready to sell into a tough industry like finance

  • You genuinely (and not just say you do) love working in an early stage company where you need to build sales stories and processes, sometimes from 0-1

  • You are great not just at selling, but auditing the customer's current process to actually give relevant advice, not just sales fluff.


Don’t apply if…

  • You need everything to be easy and to come inbound to you to be able to sell.

  • You aren’t interested in learning the industry we work in.

  • You think MEDDIC is a new health tech startup.


About the role

We are on the lookout for a driven Account Executive, who will play a key role in achieving revenue growth across a number of markets. Your focus will be to engage potential clients, build a robust pipeline, and guide prospects through the sales process. Your influence will be critical for Strise to stay ahead with innovative, user-centric products in the global arena of financial crime prevention.

We are open to applications from those based in Oslo.

You can read more about why you should join Strise on our careers page.


Expectations?

  • Above all else you are ready for a challenge. You are expected to run your sales remit like an owner, make decisions, lead with ideas. You are not just slotting into a team; you need to create a new standard in an early-stage technology company where not everything is perfect and has a process. The excuse department is closed.

  • Prospecting and Pipeline Development. Leverage multiple channels and your creativity to target clients within our Ideal Customer Profile. You’ll have access to top-tier tools, ongoing training, and an exceptional demand generation engine to support your efforts.

  • Drive the Sales Process to Close. Lead prospects through the sales cycle—from initial contact to closing—ensuring smooth transitions through each stage while maintaining pipeline momentum.

  • Deal Orchestration. Assess strengths, recognize areas for collaboration, and effectively utilize internal resources to close deals.


We absolutely need:

  • A strong background as an Account Executive within B2B sales, SaaS, or finance with a track record of high-velocity, pipeline building.

  • Proactive and curious mindset, who thrives on finding and closing new business.

  • The ability to think outside the box to identify and engage potential clients and generate new opportunities.

  • Confident, clear, and concise communication skills, that can spark interest and create engagement.

  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments, with a willingness to adapt and learn, take responsibility, and drive new experiments.


Fantastic to have;

  • Experience using the MEDDPICC framework.

  • Experience selling AML / KYC / Compliance products.

  • Experience from working with AML and KYC in industry.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary

  • Occupational pension

  • Generous learning budget for your personal growth and development

  • Flexible working set-up for all, with Lunch or Wellness allowance as options

  • A generous hardware budget is granted, to ensure that you are set up with the best tools to do your best work

  • A unique opportunity to join and impact a fast-growing scale-up with global ambitions in the field of anti-money laundering

  • The privilege of working with modern technology in a highly skilled and motivated team, solving a real societal problem

  • Great workplace options in Oslo (HQ with great location and standard

  • We have the best social committee in the business arranging two off-sites a year, a week workation, after-work catch-ups, monthly sauna visits, and more.


We’re focused on making Strise a great place to be, and to keep hiring great people to work with.

If you want to know more about Strise, check out life at Strise on Instagram (at-strise.ai), our podcast on Anti-Money-Laundering, The Laundry, and our YouTube channel!


Important Note: We will begin reviewing applications on November 10th, but we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
From the docks of Lofoten, Bilberry has grown into a tech company helping travel businesses across Norway work smarter. We are now creating a new marketing function — and this is one of the key roles shaping its direction. Join us to tell Bilberry’s story, engage our audience, and create real impact for our customers.


Your Role

This is a newly established position in the new marketing unit reporting to the COO. You will join a small, highly capable marketing team of two, working closely with a fellow Marketing Manager who knows Bilberry’s journey, brand, and product inside out. Together, you’ll define how we communicate, position, and connect with our customers.

As Product Marketing Manager, you will play a central role in building the bridge between our product and marketing teams. You’ll translate product insights into clear, engaging communication that resonates with customers and the wider travel tech community.

Working across messaging, content, and engagement, you’ll develop initiatives that establish Bilberry as a trusted voice in the travel tech industry, drive awareness, and generate customer interest. This is a hands-on role with room to take ownership, explore new ideas, and shape how we engage our audience.


Qualifications & Experience

Required:

  • Marketing degree or relevant, recent professional certifications

  • Fluency in English and strong writing/copywriting skills, enabling the creation of high-quality content that engages and connects with customers

  • Strong storytelling skills, with experience in content creation, SEO, campaigns, or website optimization

  • Curiosity about measuring performance and iterating based on insights

Highly valued:

  • Experience or familiarity with the travel industry, providing insight into customers’ world and challenges

  • Additional certifications, such as Google Analytics, HubSpot, SEO, or copywriting


Most importantly, you should thrive on this type of work, with the drive to bring ideas to life and see them through to meaningful impact.


Why Bilberry

We are rooted in the travel industry and focused on creating tools that help travel businesses thrive. Here, you will have the space to be creative, take ownership, and build something meaningful.

Bilberry is an open, curious, and welcoming company with room for different perspectives and personalities. We are fully digital, which gives our employees flexibility in where they work from — but we also truly enjoy meeting and collaborating in our offices. Our main office is in Svolvær, with smaller offices in Bergen and Oslo.

For this role, we see you preferably working from Bergen or Svolvær, where you can be close to the teams you’ll collaborate most with.


We look forward to hearing from you — please submit your application by November 17.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bilberry Technologies is a Norwegian technology company deeply rooted in the travel and tourism sector. Our state-of-the-art tech stack develops cutting-edge travel technology, addressing challenges in the travel industry and making experiences available in a sustainable way. Our journey began in the Lofoten Islands, far up in the north of Norway, where we identified a gap in technology solutions for activity providers and tour operators. With our talented teams of top developers, who possess strong travel industry knowledge, we set out to create smart booking platforms. The Norwegian travel industry quickly recognized our solutions as the answer to their needs, and within just a year, we became market leaders. We have since successfully expanded to international markets. By building a company based on individual skill, creativity, adventure, loyalty, and empathy, we offer robust solutions and a reliable business partner for the long haul. For activity companies, we offer Bilberry Base, a tool that helps manage day-to-day operations while planning for the next season. For larger operators, we offer Bilberry Blend, a powerful package builder that works 24/7 through direct integrations. Bilberry is a wholly-owned subsidiary of DSD and a proud member of the DSD Explore family. We elevate the travel industry by building digital tools that help companies plan, sell, deliver, and scale. We go beyond the basics, delivering tools that help businesses extend their seasons and scale their operations.

jobs.title: Strategy & Insights Manager
jobs.description:

Following our acquisition by eBay, we’re entering an exciting new chapter, scaling our impact across the Nordics and beyond 🌍

To accelerate this journey, we’re looking for a Strategy & Insights Manager to join our Finance & Strategy team at our Oslo HQ. What you’ll do

You’ll work closely with the rest of the Finance & Strategy team, as well as the Tise management team to structure strategic processes, align cross-company initiatives, and drive projects that support growth and operational excellence.


Your responsibilities will include:

Build models and frameworks to assess business performance, forecast growth, and support investment decisions.

Why join Tise

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply by submitting your CV and cover letter in English. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until the role is filled.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition & People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
People & Organization | Oslo, London, Munich or remote within Europe

No Isolation is an award-winning EdTech scale-up on a global mission to help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. As we continue to scale, hiring the right people and running structured, reliable People processes are business-critical.

We are now looking for a Talent Acquisition & People Operations Manager to strengthen both. The scope of the role is split between proactive Talent Acquisition and operational People responsibilities and may flex based on business priorities.

This is a high-impact execution role. You will actively drive sourcing for demanding and hard-to-fill roles while ensuring structured, compliant and efficient People Operations that support performance, scalability and our ability to deliver on our mission.

The role supports recruitment and People Operations across our European entities and EoR employees. You will report to the Chief People & Organizational Officer. 


The impact you’ll have

You will:

  • Proactively identify, approach and engage strong candidates for priority and hard-to-fill roles

  • Build and nurture high-quality talent pipelines

  • Ensure structured, efficient and professional recruitment processes

  • Maintain reliable and compliant People Operations across the employee lifecycle

  • Contribute to structured workforce insights and continuous process improvement


You will continuously improve our sourcing and People workflows by leveraging AI and modern HR tech to automate the repetitive stuff, freeing you up to focus on engaging with high-calibre candidates, and employee engagement.

This role sits at the intersection of growth and operational discipline. Your work will directly influence hiring quality, execution capacity and long-term scalability. 


What you’ll work on

Talent Acquisition

You will play an active role in strengthening our sourcing capability and pipeline quality to attract and engage high-caliber talent. 

You will conduct structured talent mapping and market research, identify and engage passive candidates through proactive outreach, and build strong pipelines for demanding roles. You will contribute to screening and candidate assessment when relevant, ensure disciplined use of our ATS and workflows, and continuously improve sourcing tools and efficiency.

We are particularly interested in candidates who truly enjoy outbound sourcing and are motivated by finding and engaging high-quality talent in competitive markets. You take pride in raising the bar on talent quality.

People Operations

You will play a key role in ensuring structured, reliable and compliant People Operations across the organization. This includes maintaining accurate employment documentation, supporting employee relations matters and ensuring our HR systems and processes function effectively in daily operations.

You will coordinate key employee lifecycle processes, from onboarding to role changes, parental leave and offboarding, ensuring a consistent and positive experience at every stage.

You will provide operational HR support across the organization and contribute to continuous improvement of our People processes.

In addition, you will help maintain visibility into workforce data and engagement through pulse surveys, People KPIs and structured reporting, contributing to a strong company culture aligned with our Guiding Principles.


We believe you bring...

  • Experience: 3–5 years in Talent Acquisition and/or People Operations, ideally within a fast-growing international scale-up

  • Sourcing DNA: A proven track record of finding and engaging high-caliber talent for demanding or hard-to-fill roles. You genuinely enjoy the "hunt."

  • Operational grip: A solid understanding of the employee lifecycle, from structured onboarding to compliant offboarding, including exposure to labor law (preferred) and employee relations

  • Tech-forward mindset: You are naturally curious and tech-savvy. You proactively use AI and automation to "automate the boring stuff," improve efficiency, and work smarter and faster

  • Business Acumen: The ability to prioritize your workload based on business impact

  • Growth mindset: You actively seek feedback, take initiative to improve your skills, and see challenges as opportunities to learn and raise the bar.


As a person, you are structured, resilient, and self-driven. You thrive in environments where disciplined execution is the key to performance, and you are comfortable navigating the healthy "chaos" of a scaling company.


What we offer 

  • Real impact on a mission that matters. Your work directly strengthens our ability to scale and deliver on our mission of bringing learning and belonging to every child. You will play a key role in building strong teams and ensuring structured, efficient People Operations in a growing international scale-up

  • Learning & development in a growing scale-up. Growth creates constant new challenges and opportunities. You will continuously develop your capabilities across international People Operations, demanding sourcing, and process improvement

  • High-performance, high-support. You’ll join 60+ driven and highly-skilled colleagues from 20 nationalities in a "high-challenge, high-support" environment. We set the bar high and celebrate wins, but we also prioritize a fun, collaborative atmosphere where people genuinely enjoy working together

  • Trust-based leadership. We start from a place of trust. You’ll have ownership and accountability of your responsibilities and the space to drive your work, with the support and mentorship needed to grow


How to apply

Please click APPLY NOW, upload your CV (English) and answer the screening questions. 

🎥 Want to stand out? You’re welcome to upload a short (optional) video introducing yourself and what motivates you to join No Isolation.

We are excited to hear from you!


About No Isolation

No Isolation is an award-winning scale-up in EdTech on a global mission to help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. With offices in Oslo, London, and Munich, and employees spread across Europe, we provide the technology and solutions required to tackle the societal challenge of school absence, empowering institutions to uphold academic continuity and inclusion for every student.

Our flagship solution, the AV1 robot, is deployed across 19 countries with 5,000+ units, supporting schools to sustain attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.

🎥 Watch how AV1 transforms inclusion in education here: vimeo.com/1098745115 🌍 Explore our mission and impact stories at noisolation.com


We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. School absence is the biggest challenge facing education. Our AV1 robots connect absent students, ensure learning and belonging, and support reintegration back to the classroom. Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students. No Isolation works across Europe, with 45 employees across Europe and in offices in Oslo, Munich and London. Join us in our growth journey!

  • Contributing to the improvement of driver routines and processes.

  • Have a good work ethic

jobs.title: Firmware / Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Heimdall Power is a growing Norwegian tech company established in 2016. With closer to 70 employees across Norway, Europe and the US we produce a Neuron, our sensor sollution often reffered to as "magic ball", that exceptionally combines hardware, firmware and software into one product. The purpose of the Neuron is to bring greater awareness and intelligence to power grids — making them safer, smarter, and more responsive. Our solution strengthen the grid, the people who operate it, and everyone who depends on it. We are a proud contributor to the world's green energy transition. Our unique offering combines software and sensors to increase capacity in existing power grids by up to 30%. This technology enables integration of more renewable energy and electrification of consumption.  By making better use of what we already have, we reduce carbon footprints while also creating value for society, industry, and our shareholders. 

We have global ambitions and are already present in 15 European countries, as well as the US. 


What are we looking for?

We are now looking for a new firmware / Embedded Software Engineer. You will be part of a great team of 10 colleagues, working with both hardware and firmware. You will also be working closely with the rest of the teams in the company.


What will you be working with? 

Your main tasks will be within:

  • Development of firmware for sensor and communication products 

  • Implementation of low-level drivers all the way up to high-level application code 

  • Participation in architectural discussions, design and code reviews 

  • Close collaboration with hardware and test engineers 

  • Debugging and troubleshooting embedded systems on real hardware 

  • Supporting verification, testing, and production ramp-up 

  • Taking ownership of features and contributing to product success 

  • Participate in firmware release processes, monitor and roll-out new firmware to field devices 


Who are you?

You have 0–3 years of relevant work experience, and a BS/MS in Embedded Systems, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or similar. You value readability, clean code, good architecture and think that code is meant to be read by humans and happen to compile for machines. You also think unit tests are equally as important as code. Last but not least, you want to contribute to a great working environment enjoy working collaboratively in cross-disciplinary teams. 

Not a requirement, but it would be extra beneficial if you have experience working close to hardware (MCUs, peripherals, sensors), are familiar with RTOS (preferably Zephyr) and embedded system constraints and have basic experience with Python.


What do we offer? 

We offer competitive salary with great pension and insurance benefits. We have a positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment, with flexible working condition. We are a team of highly competent and friendly colleagues, with lots of social events, such as game nights, chess, running clubs etc. Our office is centrally located in Oslo, close to public transportation of all kind.  

Does this sound interesting? If so, we want to hear from you! We are interviewing candidates on a continuous basis. We therefore encourage interested applicants to submit their application as early as possible.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

In Norse mythology, Heimdall is the all-seeing, all-knowing watchman who guards Asgard, the home of the gods. He possesses extraordinary abilities to see for hundreds of miles, hear the faintest of sounds, and stands vigilant at the Bifrost, the rainbow bridge connecting Asgard to the world of mortals, ready to sound the Gjallarhorn at the first sign of danger. Much like the mythical guardian, Heimdall Power ensures the safety and efficiency of power grids. Founded in Norway in 2016, we provide accurate, cost-effective monitoring of both grid capacity and health. We achieve this through advanced grid-enhancing technologies, combining world-leading sensors (Neurons) and software (Heimdall’s Brain) to optimize the performance and reliability of energy networks. Our unique autonomous drone installation system facilitates safe, quick, and scalable deployment worldwide. With our help, grid operators can unlock up to 40% more capacity in their high-voltage power grids while simultaneously improving operational safety. Our technology equips you to meet the increasing demand for electricity while reducing the need for expensive infrastructure upgrades.

jobs.title: Key Partner Specialist
jobs.employer: TOO GOOD TO GO NORGE AS
jobs.description:
Porteføljeoptimalisering | Kommersiell vekst | Datadrevet rådgivning


Om rollen

Som Partner Growth Specialist (SMB) får du kommersielt ansvar for en utvalgt portefølje av våre viktigste individuelle partnere (Tier 1 & 2). Dette er ikke en klassisk kundeservice-rolle – du jobber tett med butikk- og restauranteiere for å skape målbar vekst, redusere matsvinn og optimalisere både pris og volum.

Porteføljen din er sentral for Too Good To Go sitt samfunnsoppdrag og inntektsmodell. Du lykkes når partnerne dine vokser, overskuddsmat selges, og beslutninger tas basert på data – ikke magefølelse.


Dine viktigste ansvarsområder

  • Eie og utvikle en høyverdiportefølje (Tier 1 & 2) Bruke innsikt fra Salesforce og Looker til å identifisere hvor potensialet er størst, og prioritere deretter.

  • Drive kommersiell vekst gjennom dynamisk prising Rådgive og implementere Dynamic Pricing for kvalifiserte partnere for å øke snittpris og total omsetning.

  • Optimalisere tilbud og volum Sikre at partnerne selger mest mulig av overskuddsmaten sin, med mål om høy Saved Ratio og stabil daglig supply.

  • Rådgivende og datadrevet dialog Foreslå konkrete forbedringer i drift og struktur (f.eks. Scheduled Supply) som gjør samarbeidet enklere, mer lønnsomt og mer forutsigbart.

  • Håndtere kommersiell motstand Ta eierskap til innvendinger rundt pris, drift eller brukeropplevelse – og omgjøre dem til løsninger som skaper verdi for begge parter.


Hvem vi tror du er

  • Du har kommersiell teft og sterk tallforståelse – og evner å gjøre innsikt om til handling

  • Du er trygg i dialog, særlig på telefon, og trives med rådgivende salg og kommersiell påvirkning

  • Du har erfaring fra Account Management eller Salg, gjerne innen SaaS, Fintech eller FMCG

  • Du er komfortabel med CRM-verktøy (Salesforce) og jobber strukturert med data og KPI-er

  • Du er selvstendig, strukturert og trives i et høyt tempo

  • Du motiveres av å jobbe med et tydelig samfunnsoppdrag og ønsker å bidra til å redusere matsvinn

Språk: Flytende norsk og engelsk, muntlig og skriftlig


Hva vi tilbyr

  • En rolle med stor påvirkning, der du forvalter en portefølje med tyngde og ansvar

  • Muligheten til å jobbe med avanserte prismodeller og markedsplass-optimalisering

  • Et engasjert og ambisiøst team med tydelige mål

  • Kontor i Oslo og fleksibel/hybrid arbeidshverdag

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode utviklingsmuligheter


A Movement for Everyone

We want to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. With that mission, it’s only natural that we want to build a diverse and inclusive team of highly capable individuals who are passionate about doing things in a better way. We strongly believe we all excel and are more creative when we’re allowed to be ourselves, and we’re committed to a culture where all of us belong. We are an equal opportunity employer and all employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Too Good To Go we are dedicated to the fight against food waste! Food waste is a huge global issue, with one-third of all food produced being wasted, a landfill is overflowing and our environment is really suffering the consequences. And it's not just about the food itself, it's all the resources that went into producing the food, the land, the water, the labour. It's a sad state of affairs and we're on a mission to inspire and empower everyone to take action! Our platform allows people to buy surplus, unsold food from restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, bakeries etc. that otherwise would have to be thrown out. Through our app, everybody can make a difference by 'saving'​ perfectly good, delicious food from going in the bin.

jobs.title: Senior Mulesoft Developer
jobs.description:
Do you want to:

  • Play a core role in our transformational journey as a MuleSoft Expert, shaping both technical and strategic direction?

  • Work with a modern DevOps and automation-first approach, building scalable, high-quality integrations end-to-end?

  • Join a close-knit, diverse team where you can both learn from others and make a real impact on the platform and the business?

If yes, check out the job ad below – we’re hiring a Senior Mulesoft Developer to join our team and make an impact!

As a Senior MuleSoft Developer, you will play a key role in reducing complexity and manual effort across reMarkable by building a modern, scalable integration layer. You will design, build, and operate production-grade integrations that connect platforms, processes, and people enabling automation, speed, and scale across the business.

This role sits at the heart of a major transformation journey, including the replatforming of our integration layer to MuleSoft. You will have explicit ownership of integration best practices and standards, and real influence over both technical and strategic direction.

Our team is a cross-functional integration and engineering team that enables IT initiatives across supply chain, finance, e-commerce, and customer experience. We integrate and complement platforms such as SAP and Salesforce, unlocking value through APIs, microservices, and event-driven solutions.


Your responsibilities may include:

  • Design technical integration solutions by gathering functional and non-functional requirements in close collaboration with stakeholders and the team

  • Build and maintain integrations primarily on MuleSoft, with clear ownership of best practices, standards, and solution quality.

  • Operate and monitor the integration platform, ensuring system health, responding to alerts and escalations, and handling incidents.

  • Act as a MuleSoft Subject Matter Expert by identifying improvements, sharing best practices, and coaching others through code reviews, pair programming, and internal demos.

  • As part of a DevOps team, take end-to-end ownership of integrations, including testing, deployments, infrastructure, observability, and CI/CD tooling.


We are looking for the following experience:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience developing integrations with MuleSoft, working end-to-end across the full integration lifecycle.

  • Experience designing integration solutions and creating technical reference materials, including RAML and/or OpenAPI specifications.

  • Solid understanding of API security (OAuth, OpenID, SAML) and REST/HTTP best practices.

  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems in a DevOps environment.


It is also nice to have if you have:

  • MuleSoft developer certifications

  • Experience with SAP or Salesforce integrations

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP preferred) and observability tools (Grafana preferred)


As a person, you are a collaborative team player who works well across teams and domains. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, balancing priorities while keeping sight of the bigger picture and the end-to-end process. 

You enjoy solving complex problems and bring an “outside-the-box” mindset, looking beyond obvious solutions to create meaningful and effective outcomes.


Practical information: 

  • We will consider applications on a rolling basis. 

  • Language requirements: Our company language is English.

  • Location: Oslo, Norway.

  • Visa requirements: Citizenship/valid work permit from the EU/EEA. (Relocation assistance can be provided)


Why we enjoy working here: 

  • A modern campus located central in Oslo, specially designed to reflect reMarkable as a company.

  • Access to a free employee gym with top equipment.

  • A flexible hybrid work model

  • 5 extra “reMarkable days” you can make use of in addition to regular vacation.

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deepdive and be creative. 

  • Premium health insurance, travel insurance, and home broadband coverage.

  • Access to our employee share incentive scheme.

  • Most importantly: We have fun! We have regular events and social gatherings.


About reMarkable

reMarkable creates hardware and software products that help people all over the world find focus. We want to combine the best of both worlds: the digital and the analogue, and to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence for knowledge workers. Our tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new. We are enabling better thinking through technology.

Join us in preserving human creativity amidst a sea of technological time thieves!

As part of our hiring process, we assess candidates' affiliation with high-risk countries, defined by PST (Norwegian Police Security Service), for security purposes. We also conduct background checks for candidates in the final stages. Data is handled in full compliance with privacy regulations. Should you reach the final stages of the recruitment process, you will be informed. Background checks will not be performed without your knowledge.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

reMarkable is on a mission to help people think better through technology in a distracted world. Our paper tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new - enabling better thinking through technology. We have sold millions of devices worldwide, wanting to combine the best of the digital and analogue to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence. To help us get there, we need colleagues that want to make a real difference through their work – and that’s where you come in! Find our current job openings here: https://jobs.remarkable.com/jobs

jobs.title: Part-time Driver Råde

jobs.description:
At Oda, we come to work every day with the goal of creating affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy for our customers in Norway and Sweden. That’s what gets us fired up. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system. With our wide selection and competitive prices, we deliver to the doorsteps of thousands of Scandinavian homes every week.


Would you like to join us as a part-time driver in Råde?

You will be part of our dedicated team of drivers and report to the Delivery Operating Manager and Delivery Team Leaders on site. What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About Six Robotics

At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible. From our base in Oslo, our 50+ experts in defence, software, and AI develop Valkyrie, our flagship autonomy and swarm platform used by both government and industry. In close partnership with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), we move fast from concept to live deployment, often in the field alongside end users.

We work with advanced hardware and software, a modern tech stack, and missions that demand both technical mastery and operational discipline. Everyone is close to the action, from deep technical problem-solving to field operations. We move fast and value clarity, integrity, and teamwork in everything we do.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. Getting in is hard, and you’ll be challenged every day. But if you have the skill, the discipline, and the drive to push your limits and always be sharpening your blade, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact while collaborating and learning from the best in the field.


About The Role

At Six Robotics, we know that achieving our mission requires more than great engineers; it requires an exceptional engineering environment. That’s where you come in. We are building a self-hosted Kubernetes cluster that will serve as a multi-purpose platform for internal web services, CI runners, remote devcontainers, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) environments. This is not about maintaining an existing setup. It is about designing and implementing the foundation from scratch. 

Your mission follows this: to design, implement, and operationalize a highly available and scalable Kubernetes cluster that is adopted by developers and actively serving at least one of its intended purposes within the first six months. 

You will be part of Team Factory, which builds the internal infrastructure and tooling that engineering depends on. This is a role with real ownership, where there is room to become the key Kubernetes contributor in the company. 


What You Will Do

  • Design and implement a highly available, self-hosted Kubernetes cluster

  • Own cluster architecture, scalability, and lifecycle management

  • Build a multi-purpose cluster supporting staging, production, CI runners, and remote dev containers.

  • Develop internal tooling in Python and contribute to Kubernetes-specific components in Go where relevant

  • Design resource-aware workload orchestration with priority- and capability-aware queueing mechanisms.

  • Expose and integrate Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) setups into the platform


What we are looking for

We are looking for a Senior Engineer who understands Kubernetes beyond surface-level usage. You are comfortable operating between application developers and bare-metal infrastructure, and you proactively propose solutions rather than waiting for direction. 

You are motivated by ownership. You want to design something properly, build it, and maintain it over time. You thrive in environments where responsibility is real, and the technical bar is high. You think about how your technical decisions translate into value for real end users, and you are motivated by being part of building something that operates reliably in critical, real-world contexts where performance, correctness, and usability truly matter.


We believe the right candidate brings:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in platform, infrastructure, or backend engineering

  • Strong Kubernetes experience as a power user and at cluster-architecture level, not only deploying workloads

  • Experience designing and operating self-hosted or on-prem Kubernetes environments

  • Solid software engineering background and mindset, with comfort in languages like Python (for internal tooling) and Go

  • Strong Linux fundamentals

  • Experience with Docker and GitHub Actions

  • Highly efficient and structured technical communication skills, expressing decisions and trade-offs in a clear manner

  • Fluent in English (Norwegian not required)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with GitHub Actions Runner Controller (ARC)

  • Dynamic VLAN configuration

  • OpenStack

  • Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments

  • Building internal developer platforms

  • Bare-metal-as-a-service concepts

  • On-prem infrastructure management


Why You Should Join

At Six Robotics, we're not just building software - we're redefining how unmanned systems operate in the real world. If you're driven by meaningful problems, technical depth, and the chance to shape something from the ground up, you'll find your place here.

  • Work on problems that matter

    Our technology helps unlock smarter, safer, and more adaptable UAV operations in defense and industry, solving real challenges with direct, tangible impact.

  • Lead the shift in a hardware-dominated space

    We're bringing modern AI, autonomy, and scalable software into a field that's long relied on rigid, pre-programmed systems, to change how UAVs are designed, deployed, and managed.

  • Build from zero, shape the future

    Join early and help define the core systems, tools, and culture of a company that’s still being built - where your ideas, code, and decisions will have a lasting influence.

  • Work with purpose, supported by great benefits You'll be part of a mission-driven team that values clarity, integrity, and collaboration, offering competitive pay, equity potential, strong insurance and pension plans, and ongoing learning opportunities.


Our Recruitment Process

  1. Screening interview with one of our recruiters to get to know you better (30 min).

  2. Meet & Greet with someone from the team to learn more about us (60 min).

  3. Programming assignment to be solved in your own time, followed by a technical interview more closely related to the specifics of the role (90 min).

  4. Final interview with our CTO and Head of People (45 min)


Reference check followed by an offer if everything goes well. We consider applications continuously, so don’t hold off with applying if this looks interesting. Our Commitment to Inclusion At Six Robotics, we are committed to creating a workplace built on respect, integrity, and collaboration. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we believe that diversity within our team strengthens both our work and our culture. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and help us build technology that makes a real impact.


Security Clearance Requirement

All employees at Six Robotics are required to undergo a security clearance due to our close collaboration with the Norwegian Armed Forces. While prior clearance is not necessary, the clearance process will be initiated as part of onboarding.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We exist to strengthen defence, protect nations, and deter conflict in an era defined by unmanned warfare. Our mission is to multiply operational capabilities, accelerate the transition to robotic warfare, and give NATO and our allies a decisive advantage in the new era of unmanned operations. We overcome the limits of current systems with collaborative swarm autonomy, enabling unmanned systems to act as one. Our software lets drones collaborate, adapt, and execute missions as a team, allowing a single operator to control an army of robots, accelerate decisions, and multiply combat effectiveness.

jobs.title: Head of Finance
jobs.description:
Join the future of Sustainable Manufacturing at reTyre!

At reTyre, you’re not just joining a company — you’re joining a groundbreaking industrial journey together with a great team of innovators.

We’ve built the world’s first sustainable tire factory, right in the heart of Ski, 20 min outside of Oslo. Our factory uses a revolutionary production method that makes it possible to replace traditional rubber in pneumatic tires with new, sustainable materials.

We are now looking for a hands-on scale-up experienced Head of Finance to lead the company’s Finance efforts in a crucial growth phase, driving our mission forward to a larger scale.

Our team is young, energetic, and united by a passion for innovation and sustainability, highly motivated by development and success. Every day, we challenge the conventional and push the boundaries of what manufacturing can be — for the benefit of people and the planet.

The company language is English, and the position demands good English communication skills.

This position is mainly stationed at the Company’s HQ in Ski, but remote possibilities can be discussed for the right candidate.


The role

The Head of Finance provides financial leadership with hands-on operational execution, ensuring strong financial control, regulatory compliance, and data-driven decision-making. While partnering with the CEO and Executive Management team to make informed decisions that maximize value creation, the Head of Finance is a partner for data driven and operational financial efficiency and planning.

The position oversees financial reporting, cash flow management, budgeting, working capital optimization, inventory control, cost accounting, payroll oversight, and external stakeholder reporting.

The right person will have the ability to balance the compliance rigor, have commercial insight, operational understanding, and the ability to support processes that scale alongside the organization’s growth trajectory.


What You’ll Do

Overall, our Head of Finance will be involved in a wide range of financial strategies, efforts and tasks in the company and collaborate across departments, with great influence on decisions supporting the company’s overall strategies and goals.

Top-level summary:

Business flow

  • Budgeting and growth forecasting

  • Monitor financial performance through monthly, quarterly and yearly reports and collaboration with department managers and subsidiary companies.

  • D2D accounting, bookkeeping, timely payments including payroll, ERP flow and financial compliance.

  • Yearly close and audit

  • Investor relations

New initiatives

  • Strengthen liquidity

    • Grants

    • Leasing

    • Loans

Strengthen Working capital

  • COGS reduction

  • Supplier payment terms

  • Export financing


Who We’re Looking For

Experience matters — but so does attitude and passion!

Finding the right person that fits our company environment, and mentality is very important when looking for our Head of Finance.

We are looking for someone who has the right “on paper” competences and also is personally motivated and enthusiastic for the opportunity to take the driver seat of the financial efforts in a company with big goals and potential in a growing phase.

You preferably started your career in revision or similar to having the compliance foundation, and have later been working in business finance, controlling or accounting prior to entering a Senior or Managerial role. Overall, you know what it takes to run a profitable and compliant business.

You are experienced with growth processes, preferably in a company producing physical hardware with a global supply chain. You feel confident entering this role with your existing skillsets and are still highly motivated and eager for further growth and success by reaching great milestones in your new journey.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Accounting, Auditing, or equivalent.

  • 3-5 years of experience in a senior or managerial Finance position.

  • Understanding of fundraising and capital markets.

  • Strong expertise in financial planning and unit economics.

  • Knowledge of Norwegian accounting legislation, tax, VAT, and payroll regulations.

  • Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.

  • A plus if one has experience from a hardware manufacturing startup or early-stage company’s growth stage (IPO, acquisition, or major funding round).


Personal Qualities

  • Proactive and take initiative.

  • Structured, accurate and strong analytical skills.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills.

  • Self-driven and highly independent.

  • Motivated by growth and reaching targets.

  • Solution oriented and can thrive in a fast-changing environment.

  • Flexible and comfortable working in a modern, small-team environment with real influence.

  • A positive team player who contributes to a great work culture.

Why Work at reTyre?

🌱 Be a Pioneer — Join a company redefining an entire industry

🚀 Real Impact — Your ideas can become reality fast

🤝 People First Culture — We invest in our team through collaboration, support, and growth.

🧠 Innovation Every Day — Work with motivated experts shaping the future

💼 Competitive Salary & Benefits

🚗 Easy Work-Life Balance — Easy commute to Ski, free parking, available charging stations.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are an award-winning tyre manufacturer focusing on innovation and sustainability and the first company in the world capable of mass-producing pneumatic tyres without the use of rubber. As pioneers in tyre manufacturing, we’re spearheading an ambitious production method that integrates cutting-edge technologies from multiple industries. As a result, our tyres have significantly lower emissions compared to conventional tyres. reTyre wants to make the lives of various vehicle users easier by sustainable tyre solutions. Above anything else, reTyre values an innovative and fearless entrepreneurial mindset. JOIN THE REVOLUTION Make A Real Difference If you have been dreaming of being part of something great – now’s your time. We’re not just another tyre company. We’re building a state-of-the-art factory with groundbreaking machines, pushing the boundaries of innovation. Our mission? Leading the charge in sustainability and innovation. We have multiple positions open in all departments of our company and we are always looking for talented people who want to be a part of our exciting growth journey and make a real difference.

jobs.title: Frontend Software Engineer (React Native, web)
jobs.description:
Monil is building world-leading technology for virtual fencing and livestock monitoring and we’re on a mission to create a product experience that matches that ambition. In just three years, we’ve grown to over 1,000 customers and more than 20,000 collars in active use across multiple markets. Now we’re entering a new phase of international growth, and the quality of our user experience will be a key competitive advantage.

Our technology is trusted not only by forward-thinking farmers, but also by leading research institutions and agricultural organizations across several countries.

As we scale globally, we need to deliver a digital experience that is as reliable, intuitive, and thoughtfully designed as the hardware and technology behind it. That’s why we’re looking for a Frontend Engineer who wants to build products that people truly depend on in environments where usability, performance, and trust matter.

In this role, you’ll help shape and build the interfaces that farmers and internal teams use daily, from onboarding and configuration to real-time monitoring and insights. You’ll work closely with product, design, and backend teams, and have a direct impact on how Monil’s platform evolves as we grow.

Our devices collect tons of data about what the animals are doing. We utilize this data to improve the lives of both animals and farmers. Our expert and experienced team runs our extensive cloud platform, applying deep expertise to provide the best solutions.

In Monil, we don't work in silos – you'll have the chance to contribute to the entire software stack together with our experienced team. We strongly believe in sharing knowledge and constantly learning, with no strict divides between frontend, back-end and infrastructure. As a Frontend Engineer in Monil, you'll work very closely together with back-end engineers and be encouraged to contribute to the entire stack.


What we're looking for

  • 1–3+ years of experience building production-ready applications with React and/or modern frontend frameworks

  • Solid understanding of TypeScript, component architecture, and state management

  • Experience working with APIs (GraphQL or REST)

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Informatics or Engineering

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with React Native or native mobile development

  • Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment

  • Real-life experience with farming or agriculture (not required, but appreciated)

  • Norwegian language skills (preferred but not required)

Fluency in Norwegian is preferred (we make exceptions for the exceptional).


Our Tech Stack

  • React and React Native: We're building our apps rapidly and correctly – React and React Native helps us do both. This mature way of building apps lets us focus on the important parts, while also peeking under the hood and build features directly for iOS and Android where needed. We're using TypeScript to enforce types, and Expo to simplify our React Native project.

  • GraphQL and gRPC: The main interface between the frontends and our servers is our GraphQL API, which lets us efficiently fetch data and update it in real-time. The API lets us fetch what we need and also communicate directly with devices on animals.

  • NodeJS, Go, Kubernetes: Our back-ends are written in Go and run on Kubernetes, letting us quickly build new APIs – with features often spanning the entire stack. Even if your main focus is Frontend, you'll get the chance to get experience with the whole stack.


We can offer

Join a high-growth startup entering an exciting international scale-up phase.You won’t just write code, you’ll own features and initiatives, influence technical decisions, and help build the foundation of a growing company.Nevertheless your work will create meaningful impact by improving animal welfare, farming efficiency, and global sustainability. You’ll collaborate with a highly interdisciplinary team across hardware, embedded systems, backend, and frontend. We offer a competitive salary, including an option program. 


Requirements

Candidates must have the right to work in Norway or within the EU/EEA, as we are unable to support relocation or visa sponsorship from outside this area.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Accelerate the worlds transition to sustainable agriculture by automating animal care. We design and build high-tech smart collars that benefits both farmer, animal and environment: - The farmer saves time and money on building fences and animal feed - The animals spend less time inside and more time grazing on open pastures - The smart collars enable grazing techniques that boost soil health and reduce the need for artificial fertilizer

jobs.title: Fleet Specialist Team Lead
jobs.employer: VOI TECHNOLOGY NORWAY AS AVD KRISTIANSAND
jobs.description:
YOUR MISSION AT VOI

As the Team Lead you will manage a team of Fleet Specialists and work together to ensure operational excellence to keep our vehicles available to our users and a high quality of service for the riders in Kristiansand. In this role you will divide your time between managerial duties (hiring, training, performance management of the team) and performing tasks or based on business priorities. This will include:

  • Providing organised shifts and managing the performance of your team in line with set expectations

  • Implementing new procedures and SOP's

  • Ensuring a high quality standard for our vehicles in the field by working with the team to identify damaged vehicles, rebalance wrongly parked vehicles, tidy parking spots and lift vehicles that have fallen over

  • Maintaining and repairing Voi’s fleet of vehicles to ensure that we extend their lifetime as long as possible to minimise costs, while upholding a high quality standard

  • Working together with your manager to schedule and plan the work most effectively, including shift planning

  • Overseeing the work being done by your team, either in the warehouse or in the field to ensure tasks are completed in the most safe and efficient manner

  • Being the guardian of our physical assets and extending the lifetime of our vehicles and facilities as long as possible

  • Ensuring the team adheres to defined Health & Safety procedures set out by Voi in all tasks performed

  • Being a role model when performing tasks such as repairs and in-field management and foster a collaborative, safe and friendly working environment


WHAT YOU NEED TO EMBARK

We are looking for a pragmatic and responsible team-player who can fulfil tasks, solve problems independently and work as a part of a team to find new solutions. Besides thriving in a hands on position, we believe this person is performance oriented with the motivation to not only reach their targets, but exceed them. In addition to being fluent in English the right person needs:

  • 2+ years of previous work experience in a similar role

  • Experience managing a team of people

  • A valid driver's licence for Norway

  • General understanding of digital work tools (MS-office, G-Suite)


WHY VOI?

Working at Voi is more than just a job. Our promise includes a personal voiage where you grow as a professional and become part of a team ƒand culture that creates something meaningful for society. On top of that, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work with great colleagues and in an enriching work environment

  • Use our scooters free of charge

  • Exciting opportunities for further development in and with the company

  • Join the micromobility-revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Voi is one of the fastest-growing mobility companies in the world. Born in Sweden, we drive innovation through our state-of-the-art hardware and software solutions, shaping the future of sustainable transportation and urban development. Experience the convenience of getting from point A to point B with our shared electric vehicles, while reducing air and noise pollution and easing traffic congestion across Europe.

jobs.title: Hospitality Crew (On-Call)
jobs.description:
We’re hiring Hospitality Crew (On-Call) at Mesh – Join the team behind Oslo’s startup events

Are you looking for a flexible part-time role in a professional, fast-paced environment? Do you enjoy hands-on work and delivering high-quality service? Then keep reading 👇

We are looking for On-Call Hospitality Staff to join the team at Mesh. You will assist in the execution of our events and support our daily operations, ensuring that everything from professional seminars to evening social gatherings is handled with care and efficiency.

This is a flexible position well-suited for students or individuals looking for part-time work. The workload is seasonal, with peaks during the summer and Christmas event seasons.

What you'll do

  • Event Rigging & Derigging – Handling the physical setup and breakdown of event spaces, including moving furniture and preparing the venue according to the floor plan.

  • Event Execution – Managing bar sales, table service, and maintaining the cleanliness and flow of the venue during events.

  • Workbar & Coworking Support – Taking on ad-hoc shifts in our Workbar and assisting with various operational tasks across the coworking space as needed.

  • Service Delivery – Ensuring a high standard of hospitality for our members and guests at all times.

What we're looking for

  • Reliable and proactive – You take initiative and thrive in an active, physical work environment.

  • Service-minded – You have a professional demeanor and enjoy interacting with guests.

  • Flexible schedule – You are available to work evenings and weekends, with occasional daytime shifts.

  • Relevant experience – Previous experience from bars, restaurants, or event production is preferred.

  • Interest in our ecosystem – You are motivated by working in a hub for innovation and entrepreneurship.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary – Fair compensation for your work and dedication.

  • Mesh Membership – While employed, you will have a membership giving you access to our hubs in Oslo, Trondheim, and Copenhagen.

  • A unique network – Access to the vibrant Mesh community, which serves as an excellent stepping stone into the tech and startup scene for those interested in that path after their studies.

Logistics

Work will take place across both our Oslo locations (Mesh Youngstorget and Mesh Nationaltheatret). Shifts are scheduled based on our event calendar and vary according to the season.

What’s next?

We are continuously looking for motivated hospitality staff to join our pool. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

How to apply

Apply through The Hub with your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Mesh Community we work with the objective to boost the startup ecosystem in the Nordics, in order to help startups grow faster and smarter. Our winning aspiration is to be the solution and go-to place for 4 critical startup challenges: Space, Network, Talent and Funding. We strive to inspire and empower entrepreneurs in our communities by offering the best startup hubs and the most valuable network, while working to modernise the entire startup sector. We currently focus on the Nordics (Norway, Denmark, Sweden and Finland) and work with both physical and digital channels. One of our main efforts is to create innovation hubs that combine startup offices, co-working spaces, meeting places and events to stimulate networking opportunities for our startups, members and other visitors. In addition we run The Hub, the leading startup recruitment platform in the Nordics, working to connect Startups with talent and investors. Mesh was founded in 2012 as the first co-working space in Oslo ever. Since our launch we have been creating positive noise to push the startup scene forward, and to modernise its dynamics. Today, we have four Hubs in the hearts of three key Nordic cities; Mesh Nationaltheatret and Mesh Youngstorget in Oslo, DIGS in Trondheim, and Matrikel 1 in Copenhagen, and we plan to open more hubs and expand to new cities in the coming years. Being a part of Mesh makes you a part of a community and network with over 3,800 members and 100,000 users annually. Our curated community and offerings cater to innovators and creatives in all stages of the entrepreneurial journey, from early-stage startups to international success stories such as PortalOne, Kahoot, reMarkable, Marketer and Databutton. By working at Mesh you become an integral part of our community. In other words, if you are interested in the startup ecosystem in the Nordics, this is the place to be. The total Mesh team is currently around 60 employees across our different hubs, with people from many different backgrounds and nationalities. We are a dedicated and diverse team, with a big entrepreneurial spirit, working at an ambitious company in high growth. We have a strong company culture and live our values of startup passion, high ambition, freedom under responsibility, and excellence. We celebrate and promote this through the way we work with a flat hierarchy, great responsibility, high autonomy and independence, as well as having a lot of fun at work! Joining Mesh will instantly bring you to a team with plenty of social and networking events, Friday beers and other team activities. So if you want to be part of a fast-growing startup ecosystem player, working to make a real difference for startups in the Nordics apply for one of our open positions!

jobs.title: Senior podkastjournalist
jobs.description:
Vi er en av Europas raskest voksende plattformer for podkast og lydbøker, og nå leter vi etter en Senior podkastjournalist til vårt voksende norske innholdsteam.


Dette er rollen 

I denne rollen vil du være redaksjonelt ansvarlig for en ny stor samfunnsaktuell videopodkast. Du vil ha eierskap til seriens redaksjonelle identitet, journalistiske kvalitet og publiseringsplan, for å bygge en unik og viktig serie i samfunnsdebatten. Du vil samarbeide tett med store, brede og velkjente profiler og vil sammen med det norske innholdsteamet levere innhold av høy kvalitet i et høyt tempo.

Du vil få muligheten til å lede en liten, men viktig redaksjon og få stor innflytelse på hvordan podkasten utvikler seg. Det er en nyopprettet stilling.

I tillegg til denne produksjonen vil du støtte utviklingen av øvrige podkaster, bidra til planlegging av innholdsporteføljen og bidra til å utvikle nye formater og talenter.


Dette vil du gjøre

Ny videopodkast

  • Lede den redaksjonelle retningen: posisjonering, format, tone og seriens verdier.

  • Eie det redaksjonelle: utvelgelse av temaer, research, vinkling, bookingstrategi, kjøreplaner og langsiktig planlegging.

  • Være en betrodd redaksjonell partner for våre profiler og sikre høy journalistisk standard.

  • Samarbeide med innholds- og produksjonsteamet for å balansere ambisjoner med leveranseevne, samt bruke innsikt og data for å videreutvikle og planlegge sesonger.

Konsept- og innholdsutvikling

  • Utvikle nye journalistiske konsepter for lansering, samt identifisere historier og talenter som kan styrke porteføljen.

  • Bidra til porteføljeplanlegging: publiseringsplan, identifisere mangler og prioritere utviklingsløp.

  • Bidra til å skalere innholdet vårt ved å definere kjerneområder og underkategorier, samt bygge nye formater og talenter.


Dette er deg

  • Minimum 5 års erfaring med  journalistikk og redaksjonelt arbeid med podkast (nyheter/samfunn, undersøkende journalistikk, historiefortelling).

  • Dokumentert erfaring med å lede en redaksjonell produksjon under tidsfrister, med gode ferdigheter innen historiefortelling og intervjuteknikk.

  • Sterk dømmekraft, gode samarbeidsevner og erfaring med stakeholder management. Du er komfortabel med å bruke innsikt og data for å forbedre innholdet.

  • Svært strukturert og i stand til å håndtere flere parallelle prosesser samtidig som du holder teamet samlet.

  • Sterk formidlingsevne på både norsk (flytende) og engelsk, skriftlig og muntlig.

  • Etablert forhold til Vær Varsom-plakaten. 


Det er naturligvis et stort pluss om du er lidenskapelig opptatt av og har god kunnskap om podkast, lydinnhold, medier og underholdning!


Dette er fordelene

  • ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) for alle ansatte

  • Hyggelige kontorlokaler sentralt i Oslo

  • Gratis online terapitimer via We.Care

  • Digg lunsj med skikkelig fine kollegaer

  • Muligheter for læring og personlig utvikling i en raskt voksende bransje

  • Mulighet til å jobbe fleksible tider og delvis remote

  • Sjansen til å gjøre en reell forskjell i et voksende internasjonalt selskap – og se effekten av arbeidet ditt med én gang


Dette er oss

Podimo ble grunnlagt i København i 2019, og er en plattform for podkast- og lydbokelskere – og for skapere av lydinnhold. I appen vår har du en hel verden av podkaster og lydbøker lett tilgjengelig. Inntektsdelingsmodellen vår belønner skapere for å lage innhold folk faktisk vil høre på – enten de har et stort publikum eller en nisje.

Vi er en modig og nysgjerrig gjeng. Vi ser verdien i det hver enkelt bidrar med, og respekterer kollegaers ideer, meninger og tid. Vi jobber med integritet og ydmykhet, og tror vi blir best når vi er best sammen. Vi har null tid til “brilliant jerks”.

Vi brenner for å oppdage, skape og nerde over gode historier. Vi støtter skaperne våre tett og har stor respekt for prosessen deres når vi hjelper dem med å realisere de mest spennende ideene og historiene. Vi elsker det vi gjør – og viktigst av alt, vi har det gøy mens vi gjør det.

Vi ønsker å bygge et selskap og en kultur som speiler mangfoldet i verden vi lever i: mangfold av talent, stemmer, ideer og perspektiver. Det gjelder for merkevaren vår, innholdet vårt, skaperne våre og teamene våre.

Hos Podimo er du velkommen som den du er – uansett hvor du kommer fra, hvordan du ser ut, eller hvilke historier du har på øret.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Founded in Copenhagen in 2019, Podimo is a platform for podcast and audiobook lovers as well as audio content creators. Our app puts a world of podcasts and audiobooks at your fingertips. We're a courageous and curious bunch. We recognize the value every individual brings, and respect our coworkers’ ideas, opinions, and time. We approach our work with integrity and humility and believe that we are better together. We have zero time for brilliant jerks. We’re fiercely passionate about discovering, creating, and obsessing over great stories. We support our creators deeply and have massive respect for their process as we help them bring their most exciting ideas and stories to life. We love what we do, but more importantly, we have a good time doing it. We seek to build a company and culture that mirrors the diversity of the world we’re living in. This means; diversity of talent, voices, ideas, and thoughts. That goes both for our brand, our content, our creators, and our teams. You are welcome at Podimo for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what stories you have playing in your headphones.

jobs.title: Tech Lead
jobs.description:
🚀 Join ZTL as Our Next Tech Lead

Help shape the future of B2B payments.

ZTL is building the next generation of bank-independent payment infrastructure. We provide modern, API-driven payment solutions that enable software platforms and system owners to offer seamless financial services to thousands of businesses.

We’re now looking for a Tech Lead who wants to play a key role in shaping the technical direction of our regulated payment platform.

As a Tech Lead in ZTL, you’ll work closely with the CTO, Product, DevOps, and the engineering team to balance delivery speed, quality, scalability, and regulatory requirements.


🌟 What You’ll Do

Shape Technical Direction

  • Contribute to and refine ZTL’s technical strategy together with the CTO

  • Set direction for architecture, scalability, and long-term system health

  • Translate product goals and regulatory requirements into pragmatic technical solutions

Lead by Doing

  • Work hands-on in the code while guiding architectural decisions

  • Lead design discussions and code reviews

  • Identify and manage technical debt over time

  • Ensure high standards for code quality, security, and reliability

Strengthen Engineering Culture

  • Support and mentor engineers

  • Improve engineering processes and collaboration

  • Work closely with Product and DevOps to ensure smooth, predictable delivery

  • Contribute to hiring and team growth when needed


👩‍💻 Who We Think You Are

  • You have solid experience building modern backend or full-stack systems, ideally in cloud environments

  • You’ve contributed to system design and architectural decisions in a product-driven environment

  • You understand the balance between engineering excellence and pragmatic delivery

  • You care about security, scalability, and reliability, especially in regulated environments

  • You enjoy writing code, but are equally motivated by helping others succeed.

  • You communicate effectively in Norwegian and English

Experience in fintech, payments, APIs, or regulated systems is a strong advantage, but curiosity and the ability to learn fast matter more than ticking every box.


🛠️ Our Tech Stack

We run our applications in the cloud (Microsoft Azure), using containerized services, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code.

Our current stack includes:

  • Kotlin, Ktor, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Next.js, React, Typescript

  • Docker, Kubernetes, Helmfile, Bitbucket Pipelines

  • Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Slack, Miro, Jira, Confluence

You don’t need hands-on experience with every tool in our stack. If you’ve worked with similar technologies and understand the underlying principles, you’ll ramp up quickly.


💡 Why You’ll Thrive at ZTL

Real Impact

You won’t just maintain a system, you’ll shape how we build it. From architecture decisions to engineering culture, your influence will be tangible.

Meaningful Complexity

Payments are not simple. You’ll work at the intersection of infrastructure, compliance, product, and real business value.

Ownership with Collaboration

You’ll have technical ownership, but always within a tight-knit, ambitious team that builds together.

Growth and Opportunity

We’re scaling across markets and expanding our platform. That means room to grow, both technically and professionally.


🏠 About ZTL

ZTL is a Norwegian B2B PayTech company building modern payment infrastructure for system providers and their customers. Through one API integration, our partners gain access to payments and open banking services — delivered in a transparent, scalable, and developer-friendly way.

We’re currently around 20 people, characterized by an entrepreneurial and innovative mindset. While we can offer some flexibility, we primarily like to work together from our office in downtown Oslo.


If you want to help build the backbone of modern business payments, we’d love to hear from you.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

ZTL is a challenger to the banks' "Transactional Services". We're a cloud-native SaaS hybrid B2B payment company in the early expansion phase. We integrate our Open Banking APIs into various ERPs and API platforms to build new business models within payment services. Drop us an email if you want to explore opportunities.

jobs.title: Salesforce Developer
jobs.description:
Join reMarkable at a pivotal moment as we scale our Salesforce ecosystem, strengthen customer engagement, and build a world-class CRM foundation. As our Salesforce Developer with Marketing Cloud focus, you will bridge technical development across Salesforce Core and Marketing Cloud, building integrated solutions that power customer journeys and platform operations within a fast-growing, cross-functional CRM team.

You'll be part of a multicultural CRM team that owns Salesforce Core, Marketing Cloud, and Data Cloud across reMarkable. Together we deliver stable operations, continuous improvements, and strategic initiatives that support the full customer lifecycle. In this role, you'll work across clouds, connecting systems, ensuring data quality, and building automation that spans the entire Salesforce platform.

Your responsibilities may include

  • Developing and maintaining integrations between Salesforce Core and Marketing Cloud, ensuring seamless data flow and system connectivity.

  • Building automated journeys, triggers, campaigns, and segmentation flows in Marketing Cloud - or learning to do so with team support.

  • Writing Apex, flows, and custom solutions in Salesforce Core while expanding skills in AMPscript, SQL, and Marketing Cloud automation.

  • Configuring data extensions, automations, and data workflows across Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Core, and Data Cloud.

  • Troubleshooting technical issues across multiple Salesforce clouds, debugging code, and ensuring platform reliability.

  • Supporting Data Cloud activation use cases and cross-cloud governance.

  • Leading technical documentation, QA, and platform architecture to maintain scalable, well-structured Salesforce environments.

  • Collaborating closely with Marketing, Sales, Service, Software, and Data teams to translate business needs into robust, well-architected technical solutions.

We are looking for the following experience

  • 4+ years of hands-on Salesforce development, including Apex, Lightning Components, Flows, and integrations.

  • Strong technical expertise in at least one Salesforce Cloud (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Marketing Cloud).

  • Solid experience with SQL, data modeling, API integrations, and automation design.

  • Hands-on experience with Marketing Cloud (Email Studio, Journey Builder, AMPscript) OR a strong interest and demonstrated aptitude for learning Marketing Cloud development.

  • Proven ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.


Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with Data Cloud and cross-cloud activation.

  • Marketing Cloud skills: AMPscript, Automation Studio, Journey Builder, segmentation.

  • Experience in CRM, digital marketing, or customer lifecycle communication in a scale-up or international environment.

  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Marketing Cloud Developer, Administrator, Data Cloud Consultant).


As a person, you are analytical, structured, and proactive. You take ownership, build reliable solutions, and ensure quality across systems. You're curious about learning new Salesforce technologies and excited to expand your skill set. You communicate clearly, collaborate well across teams, and translate technical complexity into simple explanations.


Practical information: 

  • We will consider applications on a rolling basis. 

  • Language requirements: Our company language is English.

  • Location: Oslo, Norway.

  • Visa requirements: Citizenship/valid work permit from the EU/EEA. (Relocation assistance can be provided)


Why we enjoy working here: 

  • A modern campus located central in Oslo, specially designed to reflect reMarkable as a company.

  • Access to a free employee gym with top equipment.

  • A flexible hybrid work model

  • 5 extra “reMarkable days” you can make use of in addition to regular vacation.

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deepdive and be creative. 

  • Premium health insurance, travel insurance, and home broadband coverage.

  • Access to our employee share incentive scheme.

  • Most importantly: We have fun! We have regular events and social gatherings.


About reMarkable

reMarkable creates hardware and software products that help people all over the world find focus. We want to combine the best of both worlds: the digital and the analogue, and to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence for knowledge workers. Our tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new. We are enabling better thinking through technology.


Join us in preserving human creativity amidst a sea of technological time thieves!


As part of our hiring process, we assess candidates' affiliation with high-risk countries, defined by PST (Norwegian Police Security Service), for security purposes. We also conduct background checks for candidates in the final stages. Data is handled in full compliance with privacy regulations. Should you reach the final stages of the recruitment process, you will be informed. Background checks will not be performed without your knowledge.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

reMarkable is on a mission to help people think better through technology in a distracted world. Our paper tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new - enabling better thinking through technology. We have sold millions of devices worldwide, wanting to combine the best of the digital and analogue to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence. To help us get there, we need colleagues that want to make a real difference through their work – and that’s where you come in! Find our current job openings here: https://jobs.remarkable.com/jobs

jobs.title: Responsable d'exploitation - Directeur adjoint (H/F)
jobs.description:

Véritable relais opérationnel de la direction, vous êtes capable de piloter l'ensemble de l'activité et de garantir son bon fonctionnement, y compris en l'absence des dirigeants.

Vos principales missions :
- Piloter les ouvertures, fermetures et différents services
- Coordonner les équipes de cuisine, de salle et du bowling
- Organiser les plannings, gérer les absences et animer les briefings

- Gérer les incidents et prendre les décisions opérationnelles nécessaires

Vous devez être à l'aise avec les outils numériques, les caisses, les plannings et la gestion des stocks.

Disponibilité nécessaire en soirée, les week-ends et lors des événements. Une formation HACCP et le permis B seraient appréciés.

Prise de poste dès que possible
Rémunération motivante selon profil et expérience, repas et prime trimestrielle sur objectifs.
