jobs.title: Sales Liaison & Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Role Overview Monroe’s Tavern is seeking a Sales Liaison & Social Media Manager to support the growth of the business through sales, customer engagement, social media management and digital marketing. The position combines business development and client relationship management with hands-on social media and content creation. The successful candidate will be responsible for generating new business for events and private bookings, managing the customer journey, developing Monroe’s social media presence and supporting wider sales and marketing activities. Key Responsibilities Sales & Customer Engagement Drive sales by identifying and securing new customers for corporate events, private parties, group bookings, gigs and other venue events. Proactively identify and approach prospective clients and organisations to generate new business opportunities. Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients. Understand individual client requirements and develop tailored event and venue packages. Manage enquiries and bookings from initial contact through to event completion. Personally engage with clients and guests to ensure a positive and seamless customer experience. Follow up with clients and identify opportunities for repeat business. Work closely with the Sales & Marketing Manager to support sales targets and identify opportunities to increase bookings and revenue. Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure client requirements and event details are communicated effectively. Social Media & Content Manage Monroe’s social media platforms and day-to-day social media presence. Develop and implement social media strategies supporting events, sales, brand awareness and audience growth. Plan and manage social media and content calendars. Create original short-form content for platforms including Instagram, TikTok and Facebook. Capture content on-site during gigs, events and other key occasions. Film, edit and publish short-form video and other social content. Carry out live social media coverage where required. Manage community engagement across social platforms. Monitor social media analytics and use performance insights to improve future content and campaigns. Maintain consistent brand messaging across social channels. Marketing Support Work closely with the Sales & Marketing Manager to align marketing activity with sales objectives. Assist in developing marketing and promotional materials, including presentations and digital assets. Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across digital, social media and email channels. Support promotional activity for gigs, private events, corporate bookings and seasonal campaigns. Assist with email marketing and other customer communications. Monitor campaign performance and provide insights to support future marketing decisions. Assist with tracking marketing expenditure and budget planning. Work across departments to ensure consistent marketing

jobs.title: Mekaniker
jobs.description:
¤Brænder du for at fejlfinde og finde på løsninger, som får maskiner, køretøjer eller anlæg til at virke igen? Så er det dig, vi søger til en spændende virksomhed i Greve.


Virksomheden er eksperter inden for slamsugere og fejemaskiner, hvor de har et værksted, som mangler dig med en el-baggrund eller mekanisk baggrund.
Du kan komme med en baggrund som elektriker, industrielektriker, automatiktekniker, mekaniker, smed, entreprenørmekaniker eller lign. Det vigtigste er, at du tidligere har lavet reparationer på maskiner, køretøjer, kraner, anlæg eller lignende.

Du vil blive ansat hos kunden i Greve på en Try & Hire-løsning med henblik på fastansættelse. Stillingen skal betragtes som en fastansættelse!
Der er tale om almindeligt daghold med god løn.
Jeg ser frem til at læse dit CV!

¤Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

- Fejlfinding
- Reparation
- Omprogrammering
- El-diagrammer

¤Din profil:

- Du har gerne en håndværksmæssig baggrund og/eller erfaring fra produktion
- Du arbejder systematisk og sætter en ære i høj kvalitet
- Du har interesse for teknik og maskiner
- Du er mødestabil, positiv og en god teamplayer


Hos virksomheden får du mulighed for løbende kompetenceudvikling i et spændende arbejdsmiljø med dygtige kolleger.

¤Arbejdstid:
Du møder mellem kl. 6 og 7, og arbejdet er helt almindelig dagsarbejde med mulighed for fleksibilitet.

¤Vi tilbyder:

- Løn efter kvalifikationer
- Fritvalgskonto og pensionsordning
- Fastansættelse efter endt prøveperiode

¤Ansøgning og spørgsmål:

Hvis stillingen har fanget din interesse, så send dit CV via denne side. Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så du opfordres til at søge hurtigst muligt.
Alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte seniorkonsulent Jesper Høgh på tlf. 92 92 16 38.

¤om randstad

Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle uanset baggrund og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.
Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.
Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark, med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

jobs.title: Tarjoilija Ravintola Suloon, Kajaaniin
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KAJAANI

Etsimme nyt Ravintola Suloon TARJOILIJAA ihan tavallisiin töihin, poikkeuksellisen timanttiseen tarjoilijatiimiin
Meillä Maakunnalla tehdään ihan tavallisia töitä. Tavallisilla töillä tarkoitetaan tehokasta ja sujuvaa arkea yhdessä harvinaisen hyvän tiimin kanssa – tavallisuus ei siis ole tylsää.Arjesta - ja välillä myös juhlasta - tehdään arvokasta ilman ylistyssanoja. Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut sekä poikkeuksellisen monipuolisesti työmahdollisuuksia.
Nyt etsimme vahvistusta Ravintola Suloon, Original Sokos Hotel Valjuksen yhteydessä toimivaan kahvila-, lounas- ja ala carte-ravintolaan, aivan Kajaanin keskustassa. Arkemme on lounas- ja iltavuoroja, joita maustaa erilaiset sesongit ja tapahtumat. Tutustut myös kokouspalveluidemme rakentamiseen sekä työskentelet kokousten ja muiden tilaisuuksien parissa.

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja osa-aikainen (vähintään keskimäärin 60 h/3vko).

Haemme tiimiimme asiakaspalveluhenkistä tarjoilijaa, joka tuo persoonallaan iloa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja juhlaan. Koulutus ja kokemus luo pohjan työlle, mutta meillä iloinen ja reipas asenne voittaa ansioluettelon.

Osuuskauppa Maakunta huolehtii työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista ja työturvallisuudesta: Meillä on poikkeuksellisen kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten alennukset S-ryhmän kaupoissa, ravintoloissa ja hotelleissa. Käytössäsi ovat laajat työterveyshuollon palvelut, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus, mahdollisuus henkilöstörahastoon sekä ePassin tuoma tuki liikuntaan, kulttuuriin ja hyvinvointiin.
Panostus henkilöstön hyvinvointiin näkyy myös tunnustuksina: Osuuskauppa Maakunta on tänä vuonna palkittu Suomen Innostavimmat työpaikat -kilpailun keskisuurten yritysten sarjassa, sijoituksen perustuessa henkilökunnan työtyytyväisyyskyselyn tuloksiin.

Palkka perustuu matkailu- ja ravitsemisalan työehtosopimukseen ja on kokemusvuosiin perustuen 13,70-15,04 €/tunti. Vuorotyössä peruspalkan päälle maksetaan ilta-, lauantai- ja sunnuntai -lisät. Meillä työryhmillä on mahdollisuus myös tulospalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1 €/tehty työtunti.

Lisätietoja antaa ravintolapäällikkö Hannemari Kautto puh. 010 763 7053 tai hannemari.kautto@sok.fi
Hae pian, viimeistään 28.9.2026 mennessä.

Osuuskauppa Maakunta on kainuulaisten asiakasomistajien omistama alueosuuskauppa. Toimialamme ovat päivittäis- ja erikoistavarakauppa, liikennekauppa sekä matkailu- ja ravitsemiskauppa. Myyntimme v. 2025 oli 265 milj. euroa ja työllistämme Kainuussa noin 500 ihmistä.

jobs.title: BMS Project Manager for Datacenter Projects
jobs.description:
We are recruiting experienced BMS Project Manager for datacenter projects in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the successful delivery of building automation projects across multiple datacenter construction sites. You will work closely with project teams, subcontractors, consultants, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget.

This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in high-profile critical infrastructure projects within a growing and technically demanding industry.

The assignment starts ASAP and is expected to continue for approximately 12 months.

The successful candidate can be employed under a fixed-term employment contract or engaged through a contractor agreement, depending on their situation and preferences.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of building automation projects across multiple datacenter construction sites
* Manage project teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery
* Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, forecasts, and risk management plans
* Oversee project financials, including cost control, forecasting, reporting, and margin management
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations, quality standards, and project requirements
* Coordinate activities with consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders
* Oversee procurement, logistics, and resource allocation across multiple sites
* Monitor project performance and provide regular project reporting
* Support commissioning, handover, and project close-out activities

What We Are Looking For:

* 5+ years of project management experience within construction, building services, automation, or related industries
* Demonstrated success managing complex, multidisciplinary projects
* Strong understanding of construction contracts, project controls, and safety legislation
* Experience managing project budgets, forecasting, and P&L responsibility
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Good written and spoken English communication skills
* Valid driving licence and willingness to travel between project sites within the Helsinki Metropolitan Area
* Valid right to work in Finland
* Valid Occupational Safety Card and Electrical Safety Card

Previous experience in datacenter construction projects will be considered a strong advantage. We also value building automation (BMS) knowledge and experience with platforms such as Metasys, EasyIO, Tridium Niagara, Trend, Siemens, Schneider Electric, or similar systems. Experience managing large-scale projects, working in regulated environments, and proficiency with project management tools such as MS Project or Primavera will further support success in this role.

PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certifications, as well as a degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Automation, or a related field, are considered advantageous.

Details:

The position is based in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area across multiple datacenter construction sites. The assignment starts ASAP and will last approximately 12 months.

Working hours are between Monday to Friday from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm and Saturday from 8:00 am to 2:00 pm.

Interested?

Apply through the application link and submit your CV and salary expectations. A brief application letter is optional.

Apply as soon as possible, as interviews have already started and suitable candidates may be selected during the application period.

For data security reasons, we do not accept applications via email.

For further information, please contact:

Leevi Rantalainen, leevi.rantalainen@manpowergroup.fi, +358 40 480 2914
Miia Koivula, miia.koivula@manpowergroup.fi, +358 40 193 0347

With offices in 80 countries, Manpower is one of the largest contingent and permanent staffing firms globally, and the market leader in the Nordic and Baltic countries. In Finland we are one of the largest companies specializing in recruitment, temporary staffing and assessments. We help employers find competent and motivated professionals for interim and permanent positions at all organizational levels. We serve our clients and candidates across the nation.

jobs.title: Sosiaaliohjaaja
jobs.description:
Pelastusarmeijan tuettu asuminen (PATAS Pori) on pieni mielenterveys- ja päihdekuntoutujien sekä asunnottomuutta kokeneiden henkilöiden tuetun asumisen järjestämiseen erikoistunut yksikkö, jossa palvelut tuotetaan pääosin asiakkaan omaan kotiin. Yksikkö toimii osana Pelastusarmeijan Porin osastoa. Yksikön vetäjän siirtyessä säätiössä toiseen tehtävään etsimme motivoitunutta sosiaalialan ammattilaista käytännön asiakastyöhön sekä kasvamaan yksikön vastuuhenkilöksi.

**Toimenkuva**

Sosiaaliohjaajan tehtävänkuva on monipuolinen ja toivomme, että vastuu motivoi sinua. Vastaat itsenäisesti tuetun asumisen asiakastyöstä ja toimit sujuvasti yhteistyöverkostoissa. Vertaisryhmien ohjaaminen ja avustustyö osastossa onnistuu sinulta tarvittaessa luontevasti. Otat valmiuksien mukaan vastuun yksikön hallinollisista tehtävistä kokeneen kollegan perehdytyksessä. Noudatamme yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Palkkaluokka on G24D (2811,09€-3071,09€ riippuen kokemusvuosista) ja palkkaus tarkistetaan hallinnollisen vastuun kasvaessa. Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja pääsääntöisesti päivätyötä arkisin, mutta työhön voi sisältyä yksittäisiä ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroja. Työn aloitus sopimuksen mukaan.

**Odotamme sinulta**

- Sosionomi AMK tai muuta vastaavaa, soveltuvaa korkeakoulutusta (kelpoisuusehto: laki sosiaalihuollon ammatillisen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista _272/2005_)

- Vahvaa kokemusta mielenterveys- ja päihdeasiakkaiden kanssa tehtävästä tukityöstä

- Näkemystä ja tahtoa toiminnan kehittämiseen muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä

- Tartuntatautilain _(1227/2016)_ 48 pykälän mukaista rokotussuojaa ja tuberkuloosi-selvitystä

- B-luokan ajokorttia


**Arvostamme**

- Kokemusta hallinnollisten töiden hoitamisesta

- Toipumisorientaation mukaista työotetta ja koulutusmyönteisyyttä.


**Tarjoamme**

Toimivan työyhteisön, lisäkouluttautumista ja laajan organisaation tuen. Panostamme perehdytykseen, työntekijöidemme osaamiseen ja työhyvinvointiin, hyvään vuorovaikutukseen sekä johtamiseen. Meillä yhdessä tekeminen on avainsana ja tarjoamme ainutkertaisen tilaisuuden tehdä merkityksellistä työtä arvostetussa kansainvälisessä järjestössä. Työntekijöidemme hyvinvointia tuemme mm. työterveyshuollon ja ePassin kautta.

**Näin haet:**

Jätä hakemuksesi 30.9 mennessä helposti alla olevasta linkistä ja liitä mukaan cv. Aloitamme haastattelut viikolla 41 ja teemme valinnan, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy. Mikäli sinulla jäi jotain kysyttävää, niin soita tai lähetä sähköpostia:

Niko Paasikivi, Porin osaston johtaja, PATAS Pori vastaava ohjaaja, 045-1393292, niko.paasikivi@pelastusarmeija.fi (arkisin toimistoaikaan)

jobs.title: Bartendere søges til Palmehaven i København
jobs.description:
Kan du lide mennesker mere end du kan lide mandage? Så læs videre.

Palmehaven er en hyggelig bar midt i København, hvor kolde fadøl, god stemning og skæve idéer går hånd i hånd. Vi har åbent alle ugens dage, og hos os kan en tirsdag lige så godt udvikle sig til en fest som en lørdag.

Vi elsker danske øl og spiritus, gode stamgæster og arrangementer, der er lidt anderledes. Quiz, poolturneringer, croquis, livemusik eller noget ingen har fundet på endnu – hvis idéen er god, prøver vi den.

Nu mangler vi flere bartendere til holdet.

Det får du

Et deltidsjob, hvor to vagter sjældent er ens
Fleksible vagter, der passer ved siden af studie eller andet arbejde
Et socialt fællesskab med kollegaer, der også hænger ud efter fyraften
Personalerabatter på vores barer i Indre København
Grundig oplæring – erfaring er ikke et krav

Vi leder efter dig, der...

  • Er fyldt 18 år

  • Kan tage et par nattevagter om måneden

  • Har let til smil og elsker at snakke med mennesker

  • Trives, når der er fart på

  • Har lyst til at lære og blive en del af et stærkt team

Du behøver ikke vide, hvordan man skænker den perfekte fadøl. Det lærer vi dig.

Det vigtigste er, at du møder op med god energi, tager ansvar og har lyst til at give gæsterne en aften, de har lyst til at komme tilbage til.

Hvis du samtidig synes, at det lyder sjovere at arbejde i en bar end bag et supermarkedskassebånd, er vi allerede godt på vej.

Lyder det som dig?

Send os en kort ansøgning og et CV. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, så vent ikke for længe.

Vi glæder os til at møde dig.

Vi søger nye Managere til vores team.

Det vigtigste for os er ikke nødvendigvis mange års erfaring – men at du er et godt menneske med den rigtige indstilling.

jobs.title: Koirasafariopas Leville
jobs.description:
KOKENEITA KOIRASAFARIOPPAITA LEVILLE!

Etsimme kahta kokenutta koirasafariopasta osaksi vauhdikasta ja hyvähenkistä talvisesonkia Levillä!

Jos tunnet olosi kotoisaksi sekä koirien että ihmisten seurassa, viihdyt Lapin luonnossa ja sinulla on kokemusta safarien vetämisestä, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö.


MITÄ TYÖ PITÄÄ SISÄLLÄÄN?

Koirasafarioppaana vastaat asiakkaiden turvallisesta ja onnistuneesta safari-elämyksestä sekä koirien hyvinvoinnista. Työhön kuuluu muun muassa:

* koirasafareiden itsenäinen vetäminen

* koirien päivittäinen huolto ja hyvinvoinnista huolehtiminen

* päivärutiinien ja aikataulujen hallinta

* asiakkaiden ohjaaminen ja opastaminen

* turvallisuusohjeiden tarkka noudattaminen

* luonnossa ja talvisissa olosuhteissa liikkuminen

* yhteistyö muun työyhteisön kanssa


MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Etsimme kokenutta ja luotettavaa opasta, jolla on:

* aikaisempaa kokemusta koirasafareiden vetämisestä

* hyvä ymmärrys päivittäisistä rutiineista ja aikatauluista safarioppaana

* suomen tai englannin kielen taito

* muiden kielten osaaminen katsotaan eduksi

* rauhallinen ja vastuullinen ote safarien ohjaamiseen

* tarkkuutta turvallisuusohjeiden noudattamisessa

* joustavuutta ja positiivista asennetta

* hyvä fyysinen toimintakyky ja luonteva tapa liikkua luonnossa

Ennen kaikkea toivomme, että tulet hyvin toimeen koirien ja ihmisten kanssa. Arvostamme opasta, joka osaa pitää tilanteet rauhallisina, huomioi asiakkaat ja koirat, sekä nauttit Lapin luonnosta.


MITÄ TARJOAMME?

* Työt voidaan aloittaa heti

* Työsuhde kestää sesongin loppuun

* Tarjolla on täydet työtunnit, mutta myös pienemmät tuntitakuut ovat mahdollisia

* Majoitus voidaan järjestää läheltä työpaikkaa

* Palkkaus ohjelmapalvelualan TES** mukaan tai osaamisen ja kokemuksen perusteella**

* Mahdollisuus tehdä työtä, jossa Lapin luonto, koirat ja ihmiset kohtaavat joka päivä


KIINNOSTUITKO?

Jos olet kokenut koirasafariopas ja haluat viettää loppusesongin Lapissa koirien, asiakkaiden ja upeiden maisemien parissa, laita meille viestiä ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi sekä aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi.

Paikkoja avoinna: 2

Levi, Kittilä
Koirasafariopas
Aloitus: heti
Kesto: sesongin loppuun



Hakuprosessi

Toivottavasti kiinnostuit tehtävästä! Jätä hakemus järjestelmämme kautta helposti parissa minuutissa. Huomioithan, että ainoastaan sähköisen hakujärjestelmämme kautta saapuneet hakemukset käsitellään. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse tai muun kanavan kautta toimitettuja työhakemuksia. Lisätietoja saat arkisin 9.00-16.00 Marko Nääppä, 044 9011 732, marko.naappa@henkilostoliiga.fi [marko.naappa@henkilostoliiga.fi]

Olemme aktiivinen asiantuntijayritys ja tavoitteenamme on saada työntekijämme viihtymään. Henkilöstöliiga on Henkilöstöala HELAn jäsen. jobs.title: Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon i Århus
jobs.description:
Vil du køre nogle af Danmarks mest ikoniske lastbiler og være med til at levere fundamentet for fremtidens byggeri?

Hos Unicon søger vi en betonchauffør til vores fabrik i Skejby. Som betonchauffør hos os er du meget mere end chauffør. Du er en vigtig del af støbningen og den, der sikrer, at betonen kommer sikkert frem, i den rette kvalitet og på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Du trives naturligvis bag rattet i en stor bil, men mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du kan samarbejde med kollegerne på fabrikken og med kunderne på byggepladserne. Alle dage afsluttes på fabrikken, så du slipper for overnatninger i bilen.


Du bliver en vigtig del af byggepladsen

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du betonen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen, hvor du samarbejder med både kunden, pumpechaufføren og kollegerne om at få støbningen til at forløbe som planlagt.

Du leverer ikke bare et produkt – du er med til at sikre, at byggeriet kan fortsætte.

Nogle leverancer losses direkte fra bilens bånd, mens andre overføres til en betonpumpe. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan samarbejde med de mennesker, der modtager betonen, og bidrage til, at arbejdet udføres sikkert og effektivt.

Du kommer til at navigere på byggepladser, hvor pladsen ofte er trang, og hvor præcision og overblik er afgørende. Det kræver gode køreevner, sikkerhedsfokus og evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når forholdene er udfordrende.


Mere byggeplads end landevej

Hvis du drømmer om lange ture gennem Europa, er dette nok ikke det rette job.

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du typisk mange korte ture mellem fabrikken og lokale byggepladser. Til gengæld bliver du en del af byggeprojekterne og får en hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide variation, ansvar og en arbejdsdag, hvor du gør en synlig forskel.


Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer (CE)

  • Har EU-bevis

  • Har fokus på din egen og andres sikkerhed

  • Trives med at køre og manøvrere store køretøjer under krævende forhold

  • Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med kunderne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine leverancer

  • Har fysik til rengøring og vedligeholdelse af bilen

  • Holder orden omkring dig og dit materiel

Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat eller erfaring fra bygge-, entreprenør- eller transportbranchen, men det er ikke et krav.


Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • En unik holdånd og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Overenskomst gennem Dansk Industri og 3F

  • En hverdag med selvstændighed og ansvar

En arbejdsdag, hvor kunderne er med til at sætte dagsordenen

Som betonchauffør er din arbejdsdag styret af byggepladsernes behov og dagens leverancer.

Du får typisk besked om mødetid den følgende dag om eftermiddagen, når næste dags produktion og leverancer er planlagt. Arbejdsdagen slutter, når den sidste tur er kørt og bilen er vasket. Du kommer derfor hjem hver dag og slipper for overnatninger i bilen. Det er ikke et traditionelt 7-15-job, og nogle dage kan blive kortere end forventet, mens andre dage bliver længere. Overarbejde forekommer jævnligt, men bliver naturligvis honoreret, og vi har gode muligheder for både udbetaling og opsparing af afspadsering, som mange af vores chauffører bruger til hele fridage.

Hvis du trives med variation, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor opgaven bliver gjort færdig, vil du passe godt ind hos os.


Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

Med udgangspunkt fra vores fabrik i Skejby bliver du en del af et stærkt team af chauffører og kolleger, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere beton til nogle af områdets vigtigste byggeprojekter.

Du refererer til fabrikkens daglige leder.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Plant Supervisor, Casper Sakskjær Nielsen, på telefon +45 2688 4995.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

Om Unicon 

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

jobs.title: Tarjoilija Polku Hotelliin
jobs.description:
**Etsimme intohimoista tarjoilijaa Polku Hotelliin Nuuksion kansallispuistoon!**

Haluatko yhdistää tasokkaan asiakaspalvelun, makuelämykset ja Suomen kauneimman luonnon? Polku Hotelli on ainutlaatuinen luontohotelli Nuuksion kansallispuiston sydämessä. Etsimme nyt ravintolatiimiimme vahvistukseksi tarjoilijaa, joka haluaa luoda vieraillemme unohtumattomia hetkiä kansallispuiston rauhassa.

Työtehtäväsi ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevat seurueiden mukaan: vuorosi voivat sisältää niin laadukasta lautastarjoilua kuin sujuvaa buffatarjoilua. Meillä pääset osaksi lämminhenkistä työyhteisöä, jossa puhallamme aina yhteen hiileen.

**Mitä toivomme sinulta?**

- **Aiempaa kokemusta ja osaamista:** Sinulla on jo aiempaa kokemusta tarjoilijan työstä. Alan koulutus katsotaan suureksi hyödyksi, mutta tärkeintä on ammattitaitoinen ote työhön.

- **Aitoa paloa alaa kohtaan:** Olet aidosti kiinnostunut tarjoilemisesta, hyvästä ruuasta ja viineistä. Haluat kehittää osaamistasi ja suositella vieraille parhaita makupareja.

- **Kielitaitoa:** Kommunikoit sujuvasti sekä **suomeksi** että **englanniksi**. Kaikki muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksesi.

As a Hybrid Cloud Architect, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution. You will work in a team of eight to ensure a reliable and scalable infrastructure while staying close to technical implementation.

As our client is building our future IT landscape, you'll have the opportunity to grow your expertise and influence technological decisions while staying close to implementation and delivery. You will work across cloud services, infrastructure, integrations, security, and enterprise applications, helping ensure our technological environment supports both office and manufacturing operations.

What you'll be doing In this role, guided by experienced team members, you will:
- Participate in designing and developing solutions across Azure and on-premises environments

- Work with internal teams and external partners to deliver infrastructure and platform solutions

We are looking for

- Relevant IT education (Bachelor's or Master's degree) or equivalent foundational experience in IT infrastructure/cloud services

- Strong interest in cloud architecture, infrastructure, and enterprise platforms

- Interest in automation, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud operations (FinOps)
- Ability to communicate technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- A practical, hands-on, and curious approach to technology
- Fluent English skills

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of the Finnish language
- Experience with SAP, data platforms, or AI solutions
- Background in manufacturing environments
- Microsoft Azure Certification

Other information:

Our recruitment process

jobs.title: R&D Project Manager, Vaisala
jobs.description:
_Vaisala is a global leader in measurement instruments and intelligence helping industries, nations, people, and the planet to thrive. From predicting hurricanes to optimising renewable energy production, our technology is used where it matters the most – from data centres, windfarms and laboratories to airports, the Arctic and even the surface of Mars. Vaisala was recognised by Time Magazine in 2025 as one of the worlds best companies for Sustainable Growth. Our team of over 2,300 experts and 59 nationalities around the world is committed to taking every measure for the planet. Driven by our shared purpose, curiosity, and pioneering spirit, we stay ahead and make a difference. At Vaisala, you don't have to fit in to belong._

**What would you do as an R&D Project Manager?**

As an R&D Project Manager, you will join Vaisala's growing Industrial Measurements business and lead product development projects that bring first-class measurement solutions to demanding industrial applications, such as data center HVAC environments.

You will be responsible for driving product development projects from concept and planning through industrialization and production readiness, following Vaisala's established development process. Your role is to ensure projects progress according to agreed objectives, schedules, and quality requirements while keeping stakeholders aligned and engaged throughout the project lifecycle.

You will be working with physical measurement instruments produced at scale, which calls for close collaboration between R&D and manufacturing – both located on the same site in Vantaa, giving you direct access to experts throughout the development process. You will lead a cross-functional project team and collaborate closely with product management, manufacturing, sourcing, regulatory specialists, marketing, and other stakeholders.

The position is based at Vaisalas headquarters in Vantaa. The role follows a hybrid working model, but due to the highly collaborative nature of the work, we expect you to spend approximately 80% of your time on-site. This is a full-time, permanent position with Biisoni, and you will work on assignment at Vaisala. Our preferred start date is as soon as possible.

**What would help you succeed in this role?**

We are looking for an R&D Project Manager with 1-2 years of project management experience and a background in product development, manufacturing, industrial projects, or another technical environment involving physical products. A degree in engineering, technology, or business will support your success in the role. You communicate fluently in English, while Finnish language skills are considered a plus.

Success in this role requires strong communication and stakeholder management skills, a structured way of working, and the ability to keep projects moving forward in a changing business environment. You are comfortable balancing different priorities, building alignment across teams, and ensuring progress toward business objectives.

We hope you are someone who takes ownership of your work, adapts when plans evolve, and approaches challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. You enjoy working with others, take initiative when needed, and are committed to seeing projects through to completion.

**What is in it for you?**

Joining Vaisala means becoming part of one of the world's leading measurement technology companies and a business area that is experiencing strong global growth. By improving the accuracy and reliability of industrial measurements, Vaisala's solutions help customers boost energy efficiency, reduce waste, and operate more sustainably.

You will work with experienced colleagues in an environment that values collaboration, technical quality and long-term development. At Vaisala, you will have the opportunity to contribute to technology that helps address global sustainability challenges while building your expertise in a company known for its strong culture, commitment to innovation, and long-term career opportunities.

**Are you interested?**

If this opportunity sounds like the right next step for you, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English or Finnish as soon as possible, but no later than 4 October 2026. We will start interviewing candidates during the application period and may fill the position as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

You will be employed by Biisoni and work on assignment at Vaisala. Please note that we are unfortunately unable to offer relocation support to Finland. For more information about the position, please contact Nea Repo, Recruitment Consultant at Biisoni, at **nea.repo@biisoni.fi**.

jobs.title: Kerroshoitaja
jobs.description:
**Haemme kerroshoitajaa Hotelli Siuntioon**

Etsimme joukkoomme **reipasta ja huolellista kerroshoitajaa** huolehtimaan hotellihuoneidemme ja yleisten tilojemme siisteydestä.

Hotelli Siuntiossa puhtaus ja viihtyisyys ovat tärkeä osa asiakkaan onnistunutta hotellivierailua. Kerroshoitajana olet tärkeässä roolissa varmistamassa, että asiakkaamme saapuvat siistiin, viihtyisään ja valmiiseen huoneeseen.

**Työtehtäviisi kuuluu**

- hotellihuoneiden siivous ja vuoteiden petaaminen

- huoneiden varustelusta ja yleisestä siisteydestä huolehtiminen

- hotellin yleisten tilojen siivous

- muut kerroshoidon ja puhtaanapidon tehtävät


**Toivomme sinulta**

Arvostamme **reipasta työotetta, huolellisuutta ja luotettavuutta**. Aikaisempi kokemus hotellisiivouksesta tai muista siivoustehtävistä on eduksi, mutta tärkeintä meille on hyvä asenne ja halu tehdä työ hyvin.

Työ on fyysistä ja itsenäistä, mutta ympärilläsi työskentelee mukava hotellitiimi. Työtä tehdään hotellin toiminnan mukaisesti myös **viikonloppuisin**.

Julkisten kulkuyhteyksien aikataulujen vuoksi, toivomme, että käytössäsi on oma auto

**Tarjoamme**

- työtunnit **sopimuksen mukaan**

- perehdytyksen tehtävään

- vaihtelevan työn hotelliympäristössä

- mukavan ja helposti lähestyttävän työyhteisön

- mahdollisuuden työskennellä osana paikallista, perheomisteista hotelliyritystä

- palkka maksetaan kokemuksen mukaan, vähintään Marava-tesin mukaisesti.


**Työpaikka:** Hotelli Siuntio, Siuntio **Työn aloitus:** Sopimuksen mukaan **Työtunnit:** Sopimuksen mukaan

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä meille lyhyt hakemus ja kerro itsestäsi, aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi sekä siitä, millaisia työtunteja etsit.

**Tervetuloa osaksi Hotelli Siuntion tiimiä!**

jobs.title: Keittiötyöntekijä
jobs.description:
**Häme Food Oy etsii reipasta ja monipuolista keittiötyöntekijää osaksi tiimiämme.**

Valmistamme maukkaita ja ravitsevia aterioita erityisesti kotona asuville ikäihmisille sekä toimitilan yhteydessä olevan palvelutalon asukkaille. Etsimme nyt tekijää, joka tarttuu rohkeasti erilaisiin keittiön työtehtäviin ja pystyy työskentelemään osana kiireistäkin keittiöarkea.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Työtehtävät ovat monipuolisia ja sisältävät muun muassa:

- ruoanvalmistusta ja esivalmistelua

- keittiön päivittäisiä työtehtäviä

- aterioiden annostelua ja pakkaamista

- puhtaanapitoa ja muita keittiön ylläpitotehtäviä.


Arvostamme erityisesti sitä, että olet valmis tarvittaessa tekemään myös muita yrityksemme työtehtäviä. Näitä voivat olla esimerkiksi aterioiden pakkaaminen, kauppakassipalvelun tehtävät sekä muut ateriapalvelun päivittäiseen toimintaan liittyvät työt.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Toivomme, että sinulla on aikaisempaa kokemusta keittiötyöstä ja osaat monipuolisesti erilaisia keittiön tehtäviä ruoanvalmistuksesta alkaen. Alan koulutus katsotaan eduksi, mutta meille käytännön osaaminen, hyvä työasenne ja halu tehdä ovat vähintään yhtä tärkeitä.

Työssä pärjäät hyvin, jos olet oma-aloitteinen, huolellinen ja luotettava. Arvostamme joustavuutta ja sitä, ettet säikähdä vaihtelevia työtehtäviä – meillä jokainen auttaa tarvittaessa siellä, missä apua tarvitaan.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Työsuhde on **ainakin aluksi osa-aikainen**, ja työmäärästä sekä työajoista voidaan sopia tarkemmin valitun henkilön kanssa.

Tarjoamme käytännönläheisen työn pienessä yrityksessä, jossa pääset tekemään monipuolisesti erilaisia tehtäviä ja näkemään oman työsi merkityksen asiakkaidemme arjessa.

Jos olet keittiöalan osaaja, joka pitää vaihtelevasta työstä ja tarttuu mielellään erilaisiin tehtäviin, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö.

**Lähetä meille lyhyt hakemus ja kerro itsestäsi, aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi sekä siitä, millaista työtä etsit.**

jobs.title: Manufacturing Data Engineer, Bluefors Oy
jobs.description:
Do you want to help develop product data management and change management processes in one of the world's leading quantum technology companies?

We are looking for a Manufacturing Data Engineer to join our client Bluefors Oy's Manufacturing Engineering team. In this role, you will work at the interface of engineering, production, and product data management, ensuring that product structures, revisions, and technical data are maintained accurately and released to production in a controlled manner.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with technical data, systems, and processes while collaborating closely with engineering and manufacturing teams in a growing high-tech environment.

Job Description

As a Manufacturing Data Engineer, you will be responsible for maintaining and managing product data while supporting change management processes across the organization.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Creating, maintaining, and managing Bills of Materials (BOMs)
- Maintaining product data in ERP and PLM systems
- Supporting and coordinating engineering change processes (ECO/ECM)
- Managing the release and scheduling of revisions and engineering changes
- Ensuring data consistency between ERP and PLM systems
- Collaborating closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Change Management teams
- Supporting product data quality and continuous process improvement
- Assisting the Manufacturing Engineering team with product data management related activities

We Expect You To Have

- A relevant technical degree
- A few years of relevant work experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment
- Experience working with ERP and PLM/PDM systems (Experience with Lean ERP is considered an advantage)
- Experience managing and maintaining Bills of Materials (BOMs)
- Understanding of engineering change management processes (ECO/ECM) and product lifecycle management
- Strong English communication skills, as English is the primary working language
- A structured, detail-oriented, and proactive way of working
- Good collaboration and communication skills

We Offer

- An opportunity to work for a global leader in quantum technology
- A key role at the intersection of Manufacturing Engineering and Product Data Management
- A supportive and highly skilled team environment
- A thorough onboarding process
- Opportunities to grow your responsibilities and develop professionally
- Flexible working hours
- Partial remote work possibilities depending on business needs
- A modern and international working environment

At Bluefors, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of scalable processes in a rapidly growing organization while building expertise in product lifecycle and manufacturing data management.

Interested?

Submit your application as soon as possible, as interviews will be conducted during the application period and the position will be filled once a suitable candidate is found.

Please note that, for security reasons, we cannot process applications submitted via email.

jobs.title: Forklift Driver (trukkikuski) to Föglö, Åland Islands for the Fish Industry, Permanent Position , AX- Föglö
jobs.description:
--- *Suomeksi alla* ---

We are now looking for a forklift driver for a permanent position in the natural paradise of Föglö, Åland Islands (a temporary position is possible if desired).

The job involves operating a forklift in various stages of production and storage, such as moving products, loading and unloading cargo, and ensuring the smooth flow of materials in the production area. The forklift in use is a counterbalanced electric forklift (brand: Linde). The work requires good precision, initiative, and the ability to operate safely in a busy environment. The working conditions are cool, around +2 – +6°C, so readiness to work in cold conditions is important. You will also drive the forklift on a slightly sloped yard. If necessary, you can also participate in other production-supporting tasks. At Kalaneuvos, you will become part of a skilled and truly collaborative "work family".

Who is this job suitable for?
We are looking for a communicative person who is capable of working independently and is not afraid to take initiative. Previous experience in operating a forklift is a requirement for this job. You will receive comprehensive training on the specific forklift model and the work environment. The job is suitable for someone who enjoys being close to nature, as the workplace is located on Föglö Island, in a scenic archipelago. You should be able to communicate in English to ensure smooth communication within the team.

- Working hours: full-time: 37.5h/week
- Salary: approx. 13-14.50 EUR/h, depending on experience
- Collective agreement: Food Industry collective agreement
- Employment: through Bolt
- Start date: flexible according to agreement
- The role has possibility to advance into bigger role

Information about the workplace and practical arrangements:
Föglö does not have city services: the island has K-extra, a library, and a gym, while other city services can be found in Mariehamn, 35 minutes by ferry + 30 minutes by car. You can also manage without a car on the island, as the workplace is close to accommodation and there is a bus to Mariehamn. If desired, we can arrange accommodation for you: you will typically stay with another employee in a two- or three-room apartment, and the rent is around 300-450 EUR, which may or may not include electricity/water, depending on the apartment (you will receive exact information with the job offer).

About Kalaneuvos:
Kalaneuvos is the largest player in the Finnish fish industry and a pioneer in fish processing, fish wholesale, fish import and export, and fish farming. Kalaneuvos has been producing high-quality fish products for over 40 years, focusing not only on product quality but also on modern production methods and employee well-being. The Kalaneuvos brand offers a wide range of delicious fish products. For more information: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Please apply for the job soon: the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

--- SUOMEKSI ---

Haemme nyt trukkikuskia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen luonnonhelmaan Ahvenanmaan Föglön saareen (halutessasi määräaikaisuus on mahdollinen).

Työtehtäviin kuuluu trukin käyttö tuotannon ja varaston eri työvaiheissa, kuten tuotteiden siirtäminen, kuormien lastaus ja purku, sekä materiaalivirran sujuvuuden varmistaminen tuotantoalueella. Käytössä oleva trukki on vastapainoinen sähkötrukki (merkki: Linde). Työ vaatii hyvää tarkkuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä kykyä toimia turvallisesti kiireisessä ympäristössä. Työskentelytilat ovat viileät, noin +2 – +6°C, joten valmius työskennellä kylmässä on tärkeää. Ajat trukkia myös hieman kaltevalla pihalla. Tarpeen mukaan voit osallistua myös muihin tuotantoa tukeviin työtehtäviin. Kalaneuvoksella pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja todellakin yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa "työperhettä".

Kenelle työ sopii?
Etsimme kommunikaatiotaitoista ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevää henkilöä, joka ei pelkää tarttua toimeen. Aiempi kokemus trukin käytöstä on vaatimuksena tälle työlle. Saat toki kattavan perehdytyksen kyseiseen trukkimalliin sekä työympäristöön. Työ sopii luonnon läheiselle henkilölle, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee Föglön saarella, saaristomaisemissa. Puhuthan englantia, jotta kommunikaatio työporukassa sujuu ongelmitta.

- Työtunnit: täydet tunnit: 37,5h/vko
- Palkkaus: n. 13-14,50eur/h, kokemuksen mukaan
- Työehtosopimus: Elintarvikealan TES
- Työsuhde: Boltin kautta
- Aloitus joustavasti sopimuksen mukaan
- Roolissa on hyvä mahdollisuus edetä

Tietoa työskentelypaikkakunnasta ja käytännön järjestelyissä:
Föglössä ei ole kaupungin palveluita: saarella on K-extra, kirjasto ja kuntosali, ja muutoin kaupungin palvelut löytyvät esim. Maarianhaminasta, 35min lauttamatkan ja 30min ajomatkan päästä. Saarella pärjää myös ilman autoa, sillä työpaikka on lähellä majoitusta ja Maarianhaminaan pääsee bussilla. Halutessasi järjestämme sinulle majoituksen: majoitut tyypillisesti toisen työntekijän kanssa rivitalokaksiossa tai -kolmiossa, ja vuokra on n. 300-450eur, ja sisältää, tai ei sisällä sähköä / vettä, riippuen asunnosta (saat tarkan tiedon työtarjouksen yhteydessä).

Tietoa Kalaneuvoksesta:
Kalaneuvos on Suomen kalateollisuuden suurin toimija ja alan edelläkävijä kalanjalostuksessa, kalatukkukaupassa, kalan tuonnissa ja viennissä sekä kalankasvatuksessa. Kalaneuvos on valmistanut korkealaatuisia kalatuotteita jo yli 40 vuoden ajan panostaen tuotteiden laadun lisäksi nykyaikaisiin tuotantomenetelmiin sekä henkilöstön hyvinvointiin. Kalaneuvos-brändin alta löytyy laaja valikoima herkullisia kalatuotteita. Lisätietoja: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Haethan työpaikkaa pian: paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.description:
Impact Fund Denmark has changed a lot in a short time. We have grown quickly, welcomed many new colleagues and are becoming a larger, more international investment organisation. The same goes for People & Culture and we need and experienced People & Culture professional to strengthen our deliveries in the next phase.

The next phase is about making that growth work well: helping teams come together, strengthening leadership and building and implementing people practices that are robust enough for a more complex organisation without becoming unnecessarily heavy.

We are looking for a senior People & Culture professional with a proven track record across the full HR agenda, including culture and organisational development. You will bring experience and judgement that strengthen the whole function, with the ambition and potential to be considered for the Head of People & Culture role within three to four years. We also welcome experienced former Heads of People & Culture who want to contribute at this level as an individual contributor.

You will serve the whole organisation, where you will partner closely with senior leaders on organisational, leadership, performance and people questions. You will also take responsibility for selected People & Culture priorities and projects across Impact Fund Denmark.

You will be a senior sparring partner to the Head of People & Culture and Executive Management, bringing the confidence and experience to challenge established thinking, shape our people strategy and lead its implementation. We expect you to contribute expertise that colleagues across People & Culture, including its leadership, can learn from.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

What you’ll be working on

A part of your role will be spent working directly with leaders across our investment organisation. The questions will vary: how a team should be structured, what capabilities we need next, how to address and build performance, how we strengthen succession, or what senior management needs to know before making a people decision.

You will:

  • lead culture and organisational development initiatives, translating our values and strategic priorities into everyday leadership behaviours, stronger collaboration and clear accountability for performance

  • advise senior leaders and Executive Management on organisational, capability, performance and complex people matters across headquarters and regional offices

  • prepare analysis, recommendations and decision material for Executive Management and, when relevant, the Board

  • support organisational and job design as teams, mandates and responsibilities evolve

  • advise on employee relations matters within local employment law and our agreements across headquarters and regional offices

  • use people data to identify patterns, challenge assumptions and support better decisions

  • take ownership of selected People & Culture projects that cut across the organisation

  • work with People Operations, Finance and Legal to ensure that people processes have clear approvals, appropriate controls and traceable documentation, supporting compliance and auditability under the Danish standards on public-sector auditing (SOR)

  • work closely with colleagues in Recruitment, People Operations and People Development, and coach and mentor People & Culture colleagues to strengthen their business partnering skills and prepare them for broader responsibilities

We are currently a relatively lean People & Culture function. That means there is not a specialist team to hand work over to. If a recommendation requires analysis, a presentation, a new process or careful implementation, you should be comfortable taking ownership and doing that work yourself.

What a good first year looks like

After your first year, we would expect that:

  • Change has moved beyond discussion and design. You have taken ownership of important organisational or capability priorities and helped turn them into practical improvements.

  • Core processes work well. Performance, talent and compensation processes in your area are consistent, useful and delivered on time. Leaders can explain and document their decisions, and demonstrate that people resources are used responsibly and effectively in a state-owned organisation.

  • Leaders trust your advice and judgement. Senior investment leaders involve you early as a trusted advisor and challenger when important organisational or people questions arise.

  • Decisions are better supported. Executive Management receives clear, well-argued recommendations and useful People material from you.

What we’re looking for

There is no single background that will make someone successful in this role, but you will need substantial experience dealing with the full People & Culture agenda, strategy and policy work, senior stakeholders and an organisation that has really great people and leaders with massive potential.

We would expect you to bring:

  • substantial experience in a broad senior HR Business Partner, People Partner or People leadership role in international organisations

  • experience advising senior executives directly on organisational and people decisions

  • demonstrated experience across the full HR agenda, including people strategy, culture and organisational development, recruitment, leadership development, performance, talent and succession, reward, employee relations and HR governance

  • practical experience with organisational design and complex employee matters

  • strong analytical skills and an ability to turn complicated information into a clear point of view and useful recommendations

  • evidence that you can take work from diagnosis through to implementation rather than relying on large specialist teams

  • solid knowledge of Danish employment law and HR practice; knowledge of local employment law across our regional offices is considered an advantage

  • professional fluency in Danish and English

It would be useful, but is not essential, if you also have experience with one or more of the following:

  • financial services, investment or another complex, knowledge-intensive organisation.

  • working with Executive teams and Boards or preparing material for Executives and Board discussions

  • international HR

  • a lean or smaller organisation where senior People professionals remain in delivery

  • compensation, People Analytics, talent or succession

Where the role sits

This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports.

You will be the main People & Culture partner for our investment organisation, working directly with senior investment leaders. At the same time, you will own selected priorities that matter across Impact Fund Denmark and work closely with the Head of People & Culture.

The role will suit someone who likes that combination: being in the room for senior discussions, then staying close enough to the work to make sure something actually happens afterwards.

You should be comfortable moving between an Executive Management discussion, detailed analysis and the practical conversations needed to implement a decision.

Why join Impact Fund Denmark?

You will have close access to the Head of People & Culture and senior leaders across our organisation. You will have considerable scope to influence how we organise, lead and develop our people as Impact Fund Denmark grows and consolidates.

You will also be joining at a point where the organisation is evolving. We are building the people foundation for a larger and more professional international investor, which means some things are already well established while others still need to be shaped.

And the organisation's purpose is tangible. Our investments support green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries.

Practical details

  • Location: Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø

  • Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

  • Hybrid working: We currently have up to 20% of working time from home starting after 6 months of employment. We believe being in office is important for successful onboarding and integration into team and organisation.

  • Application deadline: 23 September 2026

  • Please apply through our talent platform. Applications submitted outside the platform will not be considered.

  • We review applications on an ongoing basis.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Impact Fund Denmark has grown over the past few years, and many of our colleagues are still relatively new to the organisation. In 2027, our focus is on making that growth work well: strengthening the systems, processes and ways of working a larger organisation needs, while continuing to hire for our ambitions toward our 2027-2030 strategy.

Recruitment is an important part of that next phase.

We are creating a dedicated Senior Talent Acquisition Partner role to take ownership of how recruitment works across Impact Fund Denmark from attraction and sourcing to assessment, candidate experience and offer.

Hiring managers make the final hiring decision. Your role is to make sure they reach it through a strong, well-run and well-informed process.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

What you’ll be working on

You will own end-to-end recruitment across the organisation, covering both investment roles and corporate and support functions.

For each hire, you will take the process from the first conversation with the hiring manager through to offer. You will be responsible for keeping the process moving, maintaining a high standard and making sure both candidates and hiring managers know what to expect.

At the same time, you are responsible for anchoring the recruitment process in the organisation, training hiring manager or appointed recruitment panel, and meticulous documentation of the hiring process and decisions to ensure compliance.

That includes:

  • advising hiring managers on role definition, the candidate market and the right recruitment approach

  • delivering a professional and engaging candidate journey from start to finish, including a welcoming, seamless and positive on-site experience for arriving candidates

  • coordinating, overseeing and driving end-to-end recruitment processes in close collaboration with hiring managers

  • sourcing directly, mapping relevant markets and reaching out to candidates who may not be actively looking

  • Identifying, sourcing and vetting talents on different channels to find top-tier active and passive candidates, and conduct initial screening interviews to assess technical and interpersonal-skills as well as cultural alignment

  • screening and interviewing candidates and helping managers design structured, relevant assessments

  • managing timelines, expectations and communication from intake through to offer

  • briefing and managing external search or recruitment partners when we use them

  • setting and ensuring a consistent standard for job ads, interviews, candidate communication and hiring documentation

  • building talent pipelines and market knowledge for recurring or difficult-to-fill profiles

  • using recruitment data to improve hiring quality, timeliness and cost-effectiveness, and demonstrate responsible use of recruitment resources in a state-owned organisation

  • improving our recruitment tools, templates and ways of working over time

  • ensuring that selection criteria, candidate assessments, approvals and hiring decisions are clearly documented and traceable, supporting public-sector governance, compliance with applicable rules and internal policies, and auditability under the Danish standards on public-sector auditing (SOR)

  • contributing to selected People & Culture projects alongside recruitment where it makes sense

  • training and guiding hiring managers on recruitment processes and guidelines to drive fair, consistent hiring decisions

We use Talentech as our applicant tracking system and CatalystOne as our HR system.

What a good first year looks like

After your first year, we would expect that:

  • Recruitment has a clear owner. Hiring managers know where to go for advice and support, and there is a consistent professional standard across the organisation.

  • Processes are stronger and more consistent. Roles are well defined, assessments are structured, and recruitment decisions are properly documented.

  • Hiring processes keeps moving. Managers receive relevant, well-screened candidate fields, and processes keep momentum on the factors within your control.

  • We rely less on who happens to apply. Direct sourcing is used actively where needed, and external search partners are brought in selectively and managed closely.

What we’re looking for

This role needs someone who is comfortable owning recruitment rather than simply coordinating it.

You will need to bring:

  • Solid experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment

  • strong direct-sourcing experience, including outreach to passive candidates

  • experience recruiting into a professional, knowledge-intensive environment

  • confidence advising senior and demanding hiring managers

  • the ability to keep recruitment processes moving and hold people to agreed timelines

  • experience screening and interviewing candidates, with good judgement about assessment quality

  • strong structure, follow-through and attention to the documentation behind hiring decisions

  • professional fluency in Danish and English

It would be useful, but is not essential, if you also have experience with one or more of the following:

  • recruiting investment or financial-services professionals

  • executive search or other senior professional recruitment

  • briefing and managing external search or recruitment partners

  • market mapping, talent intelligence or proactive pipeline building

  • using recruitment data and metrics to improve processes

  • international recruitment

Where the role sits

This is a Lead role with no direct reports. You will have full ownership of the recruitment lifecycle, meaning you should be comfortable balancing high-level strategy and manager coaching with hands-on execution, including the day-to-day administrative and coordination tasks, candidate care and operational execution.

You will be the main point of contact for recruitment across Impact Fund Denmark and the person responsible for how recruitment is run and for its quality.

Hiring managers remain accountable for who they hire. You bring the candidate market knowledge, recruitment expertise and process that help them make those decisions well.

That means being willing to challenge a brief when necessary, being realistic about the market, keeping a process moving when other priorities compete for attention, and making sure candidate experience does not become an afterthought.

For specialist searches, or during periods of particularly high hiring activity, you will also work with HRBP colleagues and external search partners. For periods of low activity you will build adjacent HR capabilities and part take in leadership development,....

Why join Impact Fund Denmark?

You will have the opportunity to shape how recruitment is done across the organisation rather than inherit a narrowly defined part of the process.

You will work closely with the Head of People & Culture and with senior leaders across the organisation, including our investment teams.

The role is unusually broad for an internal recruitment position. One search may be for an investment professional with a highly specialised background; the next may be for a corporate or functional expert.

And the work connects directly to Impact Fund Denmark's purpose. Every person you help bring into the organisation contributes, in some way, to investments in green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries.

Practical details

  • Location: Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø

  • Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

  • Hybrid working: Up to 20% of working time from home

  • Application deadline: 23 September 2026

  • Hybrid: We currently have up to 20% of working time from home starting after 6 months of employment. We believe being in office is important for successful onboarding and integration into team and organisation.

Please apply through our talent platform. Applications submitted outside the platform will not be considered.

We review applications on an ongoing basis.

Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. jobs.title: Seasonal Worker Wanted – Pumpkin Season 2026
jobs.description:
About Thorsbjerggaard

Thorsbjerggaard is a Danish farm specializing in the cultivation of edible pumpkins. Our products are supplied to many major Danish supermarkets and specialty stores. We also grow peas, squash, and watermelons.

All work is carried out on the farm, including cultivation, harvesting, washing, and packing.

A valid forklift certificate is an advantage and will be preferred.

The certificate must be valid for use in Europe.

Working Period

As soon as possible – end of March 2027

Working Hours

During warm periods, work usually starts at 5:00 a.m. and continues until around 12:00 noon. During busy periods, additional work in the afternoon may be required.

Working hours may vary depending on the weather and workload. Part-time work may occur. You will have at least one day off per week.

Language Requirements

You must be able to speak and understand English.

Wages

Monthly salary

Registered with the Danish tax authorities (SKAT)

Salary paid directly into your bank account, with a pay slip

Requirements

  • You must be at least 18 years old.

  • EU citizenship (a valid passport or national ID card is required).

  • Good physical condition, motivation, and a positive attitude.

  • Farm or harvesting experience is an advantage but not required.

  • A clean criminal record certificate from your home country.

We Expect You To

  • Be reliable and arrive on time.

  • Be flexible and willing to help wherever needed.

  • Work well as part of a team with people from different cultures.

  • Be able to communicate in English.

Accommodation

We have a campsite located on the farm, where you can rent a space in a caravan. Each caravan can accommodate up to four people.

Beds with mattresses are provided, but you must bring your own sleeping bag and bed linen.

The campsite offers access to toilets, showers, laundry facilities, shared cooking facilities (you prepare your own meals), and internet access.

The accommodation fee is all-inclusive.

The cost of accommodation in a caravan is DKK 70 per person per day. A refundable deposit of DKK 1,500 is required and will be returned if everything is left in the same condition as when you arrived.

Holiday Allowance

Holiday allowance will be transferred to FerieKonto and paid according to Danish holiday regulations.

Hygiene Rules

All hygiene regulations relating to the handling and harvesting of food products must be strictly followed. You will receive detailed instructions before starting work.

Failure to follow the hygiene rules may result in immediate dismissal without further warning.

What to Bring

  • Please remember to bring:

  • Sleeping bag

  • Warm clothing

  • Practical work clothes

  • Boots and waterproof clothing

  • Even in good weather, the plants can be very wet in the morning.

Important Documents

You must bring:

  • A valid national ID card (and passport, if possible)

  • A valid IBAN bank account in your own name

  • Documentation proving that you have health insurance in your home country

  • Tax Information 2026

  • You must bring documentation showing that you have a permanent address in your home country.

  • If you worked for us last year and have had other jobs since then, please bring documentation from your most recent employer.

  • If you are married, documentation of your marital status is required.

  • Please bring copies of all original documents, as well as English translations.

How to Apply

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@thorsbjerggaard.dk

If you do not hear from us within two weeks, please assume that your application was unsuccessful and that we are unable to offer you a position for 2026.

jobs.title: Animal Science Manager
jobs.description:
Alimetrics Research Oy is an established Finnish contract research organisation with 23 years of experience. We provide research and analysis services for international companies engaged in feed additive development. Since 2022, Alimetrics Research has been part of Associated British Foods. We employ 16 specialists, and our core scientific expertise is in the investigation and monitoring of gastrointestinal health indicators in production animals. Our administrative office and research laboratory are in Espoo. Additionally, we operate poultry and swine research farms in the Somero region.

Currently, our most important clients are companies developing health-promoting feed ingredients for production animals. In our typical assignments, we evaluate novel products using both proprietary laboratory models and controlled feeding trials in poultry and swine, study their modes of action, explore microbiological and immunological parameters related to health, and help our clients apply scientific information to their product development and marketing.

We are now seeking a highly capable Animal Science Manager to lead our feeding trial research activities and contribute to the continued growth of our business.

Education:

· An academic degree (preferably a PhD) in veterinary medicine, production animal science, animal nutrition, animal physiology, or a related field.

Key responsibilities:

· Leads the planning of poultry and swine feeding trials for clients.

· Schedules trials in accordance with agreed project plans.

· Designs experimental feed formulations for the trials.

· Leads scientific discussions with clients and drives sales of feeding trials.

· Takes responsibility for trial reporting to clients.

· Communicates with relevant authorities and applies for trial permits when required.

· Works closely with the Farm Manager.

· Collaborates with research institutes, universities, laboratories, industry partners, and internal technical teams.

Essential qualifications and characteristics:

· At least five years of relevant work experience and a strong understanding of production animals and diet formulation.

· Authorship of peer-reviewed scientific publications.

· Practical experience in handling live production animals.

· Good understanding of Finnish and EU regulations governing animal trials.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.description:
Main responsibilities
Lead, support, and develop a team of Network Engineers.
Organize the team’s workload and coordinate operational and project priorities.
Ensure the availability, performance, and resilience of network infrastructure across multiple data centres.
Act as the primary escalation point for complex network incidents.
Coordinate incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Review network configurations, planned changes, implementation procedures, and rollback plans.
Participate in network architecture, capacity planning, infrastructure expansion, and the deployment of new locations.
Establish technical standards and improve network-management procedures.
Promote the automation of repetitive configuration and operational tasks.
Monitor network performance, recurring incidents, operational risks, and service-quality indicators.
Coordinate maintenance activities with data centres, carriers, equipment vendors, and internal teams.
Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, configuration standards, and knowledge base materials.
Conduct one-to-one meetings, performance reviews, and technical-development planning.
Support recruitment, onboarding, mentoring, and knowledge sharing within the team.
Prepare operational reports and communicate technical risks and resource requirements to management.

Requirements
At least five years of professional experience in network engineering, telecommunications, hosting, or data-centre networking.
Previous experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring network engineers.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network redundancy.
Advanced understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Strong knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and other Layer 2 and high-availability technologies.
Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience managing network changes in business-critical production environments.
Ability to diagnose complex connectivity, routing, performance, and packet-loss issues.
Experience with network monitoring, configuration management, IPAM, and incident-management tools.
Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.
Ability to review technical solutions and make sound architectural decisions.
Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.

The ability to organize your work independently and manage several accounts and priorities at the same time.

Confident presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.

Fluent Russian for communication with customers and colleagues.
An interest in technology and the ability to understand and clearly present sophisticated technical services.

What we offer
All hardware and other equipment necessary to perform the role.
Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.
