Senior Behandelcoördinator Tandheelkunde
jobs.description:
De functie vereist ruime ervaring met het coördineren van complexe implantologische en restauratieve behandeltrajecten binnen een tandheelkundige omgeving. De kandidaat dient aantoonbare ervaring te hebben met het begeleiden van patiënten gedurende het volledige behandelproces, het afstemmen van behandelplannen met behandelaars, tandtechnische laboratoria en externe leveranciers, en het bewaken van de voortgang van complexe behandeltrajecten.

Daarnaast wordt ervaring verwacht met digitale behandelplanning, digitale tandheelkundige workflows, tandheelkundige apparatuur en instrumentarium. Praktische ervaring met het Rhein83-ecosysteem en de bijbehorende prothetische oplossingen, alsmede ervaring met het Navident Dynamic Navigation System en de toepassing daarvan binnen implantologische behandeltrajecten, is van groot belang voor het succesvol kunnen vervullen van de functie.

Gezien de internationale patiëntenpopulatie van de praktijk dient de kandidaat tevens aantoonbare ervaring te hebben met het communiceren met patiënten uit diverse culturele en taalkundige achtergronden. Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal is vereist. Daarnaast is ervaring met het begeleiden van Arabisch-, Russisch- en Oekraïenstalige patiënten gewenst, zodat complexe behandelopties en behandeltrajecten op een begrijpelijke wijze kunnen worden toegelicht en patiënten goed geïnformeerde keuzes kunnen maken.

Vanwege het specialistische karakter van de functie wordt gezocht naar een ervaren kandidaat die vanaf de start zelfstandig kan functioneren en slechts beperkte inwerkbegeleiding nodig heeft

Tandartspraktijk Grinberg is een moderne en groeiende tandartspraktijk met een sterke focus op implantologie, prothetische rehabilitatie en restauratieve tandheelkunde. Wij bedienen een diverse en internationale patiëntenpopulatie en streven ernaar hoogwaardige, innovatieve en toegankelijke mondzorg te bieden, ongeacht taal, culturele achtergrond of bekendheid met het Nederlandse zorgsysteem.

Voor onze praktijk zijn wij op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Behandelcoördinator Tandheelkunde. In deze functie vervul je een centrale rol binnen complexe behandeltrajecten en fungeer je als schakel tussen patiënten, behandelaars, tandtechnische laboratoria en leveranciers. Je bent betrokken bij de voorbereiding, coördinatie en opvolging van geavanceerde implantologische en restauratieve behandelingen en draagt bij aan een efficiënte en hoogwaardige uitvoering van zorg.

De functie combineert patiëntcommunicatie, behandelcoördinatie, technische ondersteuning en digitale werkprocessen. Je werkt nauw samen met behandelaars en externe partners en krijgt de mogelijkheid om een directe bijdrage te leveren aan de kwaliteit van zorg en de patiëntervaring.

Vanwege het specialistische karakter van de functie zoeken wij een ervaren kandidaat die vanaf de start zelfstandig kan functioneren en een actieve bijdrage kan leveren aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze praktijk.

Understanding how patterns of neural activity give rise to behavior is a central challenge in neuroscience. Most of what we know about this relationship comes from rodent experiments performed under tightly controlled laboratory conditions. While these approaches are essential for identifying neural mechanisms, they capture only a fraction of the behavioral repertoire animals display in more complex environments.
What are you going to do?
In this project, you will investigate how neural population activity relates to behavior across environments ranging from standardized laboratory assays to large outdoor enclosures. Using miniaturized calcium imaging, you will record the activity of large populations of neurons in freely behaving mice and determine how neural activity relates to moment-to-moment behavioral changes.
A major component of the project will make use of large outdoor mouse enclosures at the University of Groningen. jobs.description:
PhD Candidate Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
30 augustus 2026 Maastricht University
WO
limburg, Maastricht
Geplaatst 9 uur geleden
Welcome to Maastricht University!
Would you like to help detect health risks in herbal food supplements earlier, using data-driven approaches? Herbal supplements are often considered safe because they are natural. But how well do we actually understand their potential health effects? In this PhD project, you will develop a testing strategy to identify possible hazards earlier and contribute to safer use of herbal supplements.
PhD Candidate: Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
Herbal food supplements are widely used and often perceived as inherently safe because they are 'natural'. Yet these products can contain complex mixtures of bioactive compounds, and their composition may vary depending on the plant material, extraction method and production process. Contamination, adulteration and differences between batches add further uncertainty. Because these products are generally not tested before entering the market, potential adverse effects may only become apparent once they are already widely used.
That is why a robust and structured strategy is needed to better evaluate the safety of herbal supplements and reduce potential risks to human health. In this collaborative project, you will investigate the hepatotoxicity, nephrotoxicity, genotoxicity and endocrine-disrupting potential of diverse herbal extracts using human-relevant in vitro models and complementary bioassays. You will also examine how liver metabolism influences their toxicity. For selected extracts, you will use chemical analyses such as LC-MS/MS and GC-MS to help identify the compounds responsible for the observed effects. jobs.description:
Job Description & Summary
Meet your future team
Join the Central Data Office (CDO), the team responsible for implementing the Firm's Data Strategy, supporting users, fostering the adoption of Data Management best practices, and enabling data that is Trusted, Ready to use and Protected. In this role, you will be part of the Data Governance Operations team, working closely with the Data Governance Unit Leader, Data Owners, Data Stewards, and other stakeholders across the firm.
What your role will look like
As a Data Governance Analyst Associate, you will contribute to the firm's data transformation by helping strengthen Data Governance practices across the organisation. You will support the effective use, protection, quality, and management of data while ensuring Data Governance processes and activities are followed consistently.
• Support the Data Governance Unit Leader and the Data Governance Operations team with Data Governance analysis.
• Ensure the efficient follow-up of requests related to data use across the firm and contribute to the evolution of this activity.
• Oversee data issue management activities and data requirements, including Data Subject requests in collaboration with the Data Protection Office.
• Contribute to the analysis of Data Procedures and assess their impact on Data Governance rules and processes.
• Support the management of the community of Data Owners and Data Stewards and help maintain engagement across stakeholders.
• Perform Data Retention implementation campaigns, including database storage analysis to identify areas with the greatest impact.
• Maintain Data Governance documentation, guidelines and templates, while coordinating meetings, organising logistics, and maintaining accurate records as part of the audit trail.
Your growth and opportunities
You will build practical experience in Data Governance, Data Management practices, and data regulations while contributing to the implementation of the Firm's Data Strategy. The role provides exposure to multiple business domains and stakeholder groups across the firm, helping you broaden your understanding of how data supports decision-making and governance.
The skills you bring
• Master's degree in IT, Data Management, Business Management or Sciences.
• Working knowledge of business analysis and the ability to structure large amounts of information within a process framework.
• Keen to acquire knowledge of Data Management practices (DMBOK), Data Regulation rules (GDPR, RoPA and EU data regulations), and business domains.
• Basic knowledge of Data Architecture, data modelling and database design is considered valuable for the role.
• Fluent in French and English
Ways of working
• Analyse information in a structured way and use data and facts to support informed decisions.
• Collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders to achieve shared objectives and build trust.
• You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation.
Additional skills that would support your success
• Knowledge of Project Management methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Prince2).
• Knowledge of Product Management practices (ITIL).
The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.
Take your next step
Make a difference by contributing to the way data is governed, protected and used across the firm. Work with colleagues from different teams, build expertise in a growing field, and help shape trusted and reliable data practices. Grow your impact, expand your knowledge, and contribute to meaningful transformation across the organisation. Grow here. Go further.

Department:  ICT AND SECURITY RISK DEPARTMENT

The Risk Management Department is responsible for the risk control function of the Bank, encompassing both Financial Risk and Operational Risk matters.
The Risk Management Department monitors existing and emerging risks, assess them and report them to the Senior Management of the Bank. It supports the business in managing their risks, providing guidance to promote risk awareness continuously.

We are seeking an experienced Head of ICT & Security Risk Management on a permanent role to lead our digital operational resilience strategy and ensure full compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and relevant regulatory requirements.

Your main tasks will be to:

• You continuously learn, explore emerging technologies and actively apply new knowledge to improve delivery and create value;

Shape how organizations use data, analytics and AI to make better decisions and deliver meaningful transformation. Grow here. Go further.

jobs.title: Hausdame / Gouvernante (m/w/d) f. Liechtenstein gesucht A26/9821 Li (Hausdame/Housekeeper)
jobs.description:
Liechtenstein

Gesucht wird für einen gehobenen 2-Personen-Privathaushalt in einem stilvollen kleinen Familienschloss in Liechtenstein eine erfahrene und engagierte **Hausdame / Gouvernante (m/w/d).** Die private Residenz umfasst rund 15 Zimmer sowie ein parkähnliches Grundstück. Sie arbeiten in einem gepflegten, repräsentativen Umfeld gemeinsam mit weiteren Mitarbeitenden des Hauses und übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit hoher Eigenständigkeit.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Verantwortungsvolle Führung und Organisation des gehobenen Privathaushalts
- Sicherstellung einer tadellosen Sauberkeit, Ordnung und gepflegten Atmosphäre im gesamten Haus
- Reinigung und Pflege hochwertiger Oberflächen, Materialien und Einrichtungen
- Fachgerechte Wäschepflege, einschließlich Waschen, Bügeln, Falten und Versorgen anspruchsvoller Textilien
- Sicherer und sorgfältiger Umgang mit hochwertigen Stoffen, Antiquitäten, Kunstgegenständen und wertvollem Inventar
- Vorbereitung und Zubereitung kleiner Mahlzeiten, insbesondere des Frühstücks
- Aufmerksame Betreuung der Hausherren sowie professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Gästen
- Unterstützung bei Empfängen, Einladungen und besonderen Anlässen
- Koordination und Abstimmung mit den weiteren Mitarbeitenden des Hauses
- Konsequente Einhaltung und Kontrolle der geltenden Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards

Ihr Profil

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Hausdame, Gouvernante oder in einer vergleichbaren Position in einem gehobenen Privathaushalt
- Fundierte Vorkenntnisse aus der 4- oder 5-Sterne-Hotellerie
- Ausgeprägte Gastgeberqualität, Serviceorientierung und ein sicheres, kultiviertes Auftreten
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Pflege hochwertiger Wäsche und Textilien
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit Antiquitäten, Kunstobjekten und anspruchsvoller Einrichtung
- Selbstständige, strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
- Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Diskretion und Loyalität
- Flexibilität und Freude an der Arbeit in einem privaten, exklusiven Umfeld
- Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Gepflegte Erscheinung und ausgezeichnete Umgangsformen
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Arbeitszeiten am Wochenende
- Ausgezeichneter Leumund

Geboten wird

- Eine verantwortungsvolle und langfristig ausgerichtete Position in einem außergewöhnlichen privaten Umfeld
- Ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima in einem professionell geführten Haushalt
- Zusammenarbeit mit weiteren erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden in Haus und Garten
- Eine vielseitige, anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
- Ein überdurchschnittliches Gehalt, welches sich an Erfahrung und Qualifikation orientiert

Bei der Wohnungssuche ist die Familie gerne behilflich, es handelt sich hier um eine Vollzeit-Anstellung. Gebeten wird um vollständige Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Lebenslauf, Referenzen und Angaben zu Ihrer Verfügbarkeit. Die Position ist nach Absprache zu besetzen und wird ausnehmend gut vergütet.

jobs.description:
POMOĆNI RADNIK NA GRADILIŠTU – 2 IZVRŠITELJA

OPIS POSLOVA

Tražimo dva odgovorna i motivirana radnika za rad na gradilištima na poslovima izgradnje i postavljanja optičke infrastrukture.

Poslovi uključuju:

pomoćne građevinske i terenske radove, iskop i pripremu terena, polaganje i uvlačenje cijevi i optičkih kabela, pomoć pri izvođenju radova na optičkoj infrastrukturi, rukovanje osnovnim alatom i opremom, održavanje urednosti radnog mjesta, ostale pomoćne poslove prema potrebama projekta.

MJESTO RADA

Rad se trenutno odvija na području Duge Rese i Karlovca.

Ovisno o potrebama i lokaciji projekata, rad se može obavljati i na drugim lokacijama na području cijele Republike Hrvatske. Radnici trebaju biti spremni na terenski rad i boravak izvan mjesta prebivališta. Za radnike koji rade i borave na terenu poslodavac osigurava i plaća smještaj.

UVJETI

završena osnovna ili srednja škola, radno iskustvo nije uvjet, prednost imaju kandidati s iskustvom na građevinskim, zemljanim ili srodnim poslovima, spremnost na fizički rad i rad na otvorenom, spremnost na terenski rad, odgovornost, pouzdanost i spremnost na timski rad, vozačka dozvola B kategorije je prednost.

ŠTO NUDIMO

početnu bruto plaću od 1.155,00 €, uz mogućnost povećanja sukladno iskustvu, odgovornostima i ostvarenom učinku, dodatnu nagradu prema ostvarenom učinku, terenski dodatak prema uvjetima za ostvarivanje prava na terenski dodatak, osiguran i plaćen smještaj za vrijeme rada i boravka na terenu, rad u organiziranom timu, rad na kontinuiranim projektima, mogućnost dodatne zarade kroz ostvareni učinak, mogućnost nastavka radnog odnosa na neodređeno vrijeme za radnike koji se pokažu odgovornima, pouzdanima i kvalitetnima u radu.

NAGRADA PREMA UČINKU

Uz osnovnu plaću postoji mogućnost ostvarivanja dodatne nagrade prema ostvarenom radnom učinku. Nagrada se ostvaruje za rad iznad utvrđene norme, sukladno pravilima i evidenciji poslodavca. Visina nagrade ovisi o stvarno ostvarenom učinku.

Prijava i mjesto sjedišta poslodavca: Zagreb.

Tražimo osobe koje su zainteresirane za dugoročan rad, spremne na terenski rad i žele svojim zalaganjem ostvariti mogućnost dodatne zarade. Radnicima koji se pokažu odgovornima, pouzdanima i kvalitetnima u radu nudimo mogućnost nastavka radnog odnosa na neodređeno vrijeme.

Wir verstehen Dich. Seit 25 Jahren begleiten wir als erfolgreiche Vermittlungsagentur Menschen wie Dich dabei, den Arbeitsplatz zu finden, der nicht nur zum Lebenslauf, sondern perfekt zum Leben passt. Für eine renommierte Klinikgruppe in der malerischen Nordschweiz suchen wir genau jetzt Deine Expertise.
Schließe kurz die Augen und stell Dir vor, wie es sich anfühlt, in einem Umfeld zu arbeiten, in dem Deine Leistung täglich gesehen und honoriert wird. Wir haben aktuell 3 exklusive Vakanzen zu besetzen – eine davon wartet vermutlich genau auf Dich.

Du bist der Experte, der Bilder sprechend macht. In Deiner neuen Rolle verbindest Du technologische Präzision mit menschlicher Empathie:
High-End-Diagnostik im MRT: Du steuerst modernste MRT-Systeme und meisterst komplexe Fragestellungen mit Leichtigkeit.
Dynamik in der Angiologie: Bei interventionellen Eingriffen und Gefäßdarstellungen bist Du die unverzichtbare rechte Hand des Teams – ruhig, fokussiert und kompetent.
Patienten-Empathie: Du schenkst Menschen in Ausnahmesituationen Sicherheit und das Gefühl, in den besten Händen zu sein.

Eine Arbeitsaufnahme wäre ab sofort/laufend möglich - je nach direkter Vereinbarung mit Schweizer Arbeitgeber.

Wir sind eine private Personal- und Arbeitsvermittlung in der Region Stuttgart und suchen ständig für unsere Schweizer Partner/Auftraggeber gute und erfahrene Leute aus dem Bau- und Handwerksbereich, u.a. aus dem Holzbau

_____ ZIMMERERMANN – SCHREINER - BAUSCHREINER _____

Die Holzbaubranche bietet Ihnen ein breites Tätigkeitsfeld im Zimmerer- und Schreinerhandwerk – im Umgang mit dem Werkstoff Holz, in der Holzbearbeitung/-verarbeitung und bei Montagearbeiten auf der Baustelle. Holzarbeiten aller Art – im Neubau, Umbau oder Renovation.

In der Zimmerei können Sie in folgenden Bereichen zum Einsatz kommen:

- Herstellung von Holzkonstruktionen, Holzbauteilen oder Holzbauten aller Art

- Einsatz im Bereich Dachstühle, Dachausbau, Holzfassadenverkleidungen, Holzschalungen, Terrassenböden oder im allg. Innenausbau

In der Schreinerei können Sie in folgenden Bereichen zum Einsatz kommen:

- Fertigung und Montage von Bauelementen aus Holz oder Holzwerkstoffen, Tätigkeiten in der Holzbearbeitung und -verarbeitung
- Arbeiten im Einrichtungsbau, Möbel-/Küchenbau, Treppenbau – im Bereich Türen, Fenster, Böden
- Einsatz im Bereich Innenausbauten, Montagen

jobs.title: Vorrichter/Rohrschlosser (m/w/d) (Rohrvorrichter/in)
jobs.description:
Unsere Berufung ist die Planung, Herstellung, Lieferung, Montage und Inbetriebnahme von Dampfturbosätzen, mit denen wir den individuellen Kundenbedürfnissen vollumfänglich gerecht werden.

Wir kombinieren erstklassige Qualität mit effektiven und sicheren Prozessen und hinterfragen unser Denken und Handeln stets auf Nachhaltigkeit in Bezug auf unsere Produkte, die Umwelt sowie die Gesundheit und Entwicklung unserer Beschäftigten.

Als Arbeitgeber sind wir ein professionell agierender Mittelständler (mit derzeit ca.200 Mitarbeitern), der sich die Flexibilität und Handlungsschnelligkeit aus der Gründungszeit durch kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien beibehalten hat. In diesem Geist denken wir lösungsorientiert und pragmatisch, sind mutig und entscheidungsfreudig und können somit schnell und zielorientiert im Sinne des Kunden und der Mitarbeiter reagieren.

Da wir stetig wachsen, suchen wir als Verstärkung ab sofort eine(n)

Vorrichter/Rohrschlosser (m/w/d)

So passt du zu uns:

- Du übernimmst Verantwortung für dein Handeln gegenüber unseren Kunden und Kollegen.
- Du arbeitest gerne in einem Team, da du Spaß daran hast, vernetzt zu sein und über deinen Bereich hinaus zu denken.
- Dir ist eine gerade und direkte, aber auch respektvolle und anerkennende Kommunikation sehr wichtig.
- Du schätzt es, wenn ein Unternehmen nicht nur Loyalität von dir erwartet, sondern sich auch für seine Mitarbeiter einsetzt.
- Du bist authentisch und integer, lebst deine eigenen Wertvorstellungen und Überzeugungen und bringst dabei Ecken und Kanten mit.
- Du hast Spaß am Umgang mit internationalen Kunden, bist reisebereit und kannst Dich gut auf Deutsch und Englisch ausdrücken - vielleicht beherrscht Du sogar noch eine weitere Fremdsprache.
****
Das verantwortest du:
-  Du übernimmst bei der Montage unserer Dampfturbosätze die Vorrichtarbeiten für den Rohrleitungsbau.

Das erwarten wir von dir:

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Rohrschlosser oder im Bereich Metallbau, Schweißtechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Rohrleitungsbau
- Hohe Reisebereitschaft und Flexibilität (80% Außendienst).
- Sicherer Umgang mit den üblichen schweißtechnischen Dokumenten, eigenständiges Arbeiten nach Planungsunterlagen/Isometrien.
- Führerschein Klasse B.
- Technisches Verständnis.

Das bieten wir dir:

-  30 Tage Urlaub/Jahr
- Gleitzeitmöglichkeit zum Abbau von Überstunden
- Mitarbeiterangebote über Corporate Benefit Programm
- Fahrradleasing als geldwerter Vorteil
- Zuschuss zu Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft (nach 2-jähriger Zugehörigkeit)
- Zuschuss zu Betrieblicher Altersvorsorge oder VWL
- Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Unfallversicherung (auch für private Unfälle)

Auf unserer Homepage kannst du dich direkt über das Bewerbungsformular bewerben:
https://www.tgmkanis.com/karriere (https://www.tgmkanis.com/karriere)

jobs.title: Senior Automation Expert (f/m/d) IT/OT Security Platforms (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Together, we make the difference

Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.As an Automation Engineer (f/m/d) for IT/OT Security Platforms, you will play a key role in building, automating, and operating the technical foundation of these strategic services. You will work closely with service managers, solution architects, operations teams, and factories worldwide to deliver scalable, automated, and secure solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and industrial digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.
What we offer you

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

What part will you play?

- You design, implement, and maintain automation solutions for IT/OT Security Platforms (specifically but not exclusively SINEC Secure Connect, ensuring secure, scalable, and reliable service operations).- You develop and operate Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using modern automation frameworks and support the automated deployment of platforms and services across Siemens factory environments.- You build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, operational tooling, and automation workflows to improve service delivery, reduce manual effort, and increase operational efficiency.- You integrate platforms, tools, and services through APIs and automation frameworks to enable seamless operational processes and data flows.- You support the implementation and operation of Zero Trust connectivity solutions and contribute to the automation of policy management, provisioning, and operational workflows.- You collaborate with factories and project teams to integrate solutions into existing IT and OT environments while considering operational requirements and brownfield infrastructures.- You support troubleshooting, monitoring, and continuous service improvement activities and help ensure stable operations across global deployments.- You evaluate and leverage modern technologies such as AI-driven automation, analytics, and operational intelligence to continuously improve platform operations and deployment processes.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.

What you bring to the table

- You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Automation, or a comparable qualification.- You possess strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code and Platform Automation, including Terraform, Open Tofu, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, scripting, and automated deployment of connectivity and operations platforms (at least 3+ years of experience).- Scripting/programming skills with Python/Bash/Go.- Proven hands-on experience with Cloud (AWS) and containerized environments and microservices like Docker (at least 2+ years of experience).- You have experience with AI-driven DevOps, Operations and Automation, including the use of LLMs, GitHub Copilot, AIOps concepts, workflow automation, and analytics-driven operational improvements. - You bring hands-on experience in OpenZiti Development (optional) and API Integration (mandatory), including SDKs, REST APIs, policy automation, and custom tooling to integrate Zero Trust networking capabilities into applications and operational workflows. (1+ years of experience).- You have a solid understanding of OT Infrastructure and Industrial Protocols, including PLCs, HMIs, OPC UA, PROFINET, machine-to-machine communication, OT troubleshooting, and the secure integration of solutions into brownfield factory environments. You also understand the emerging role of AI agents in OT environments and the underlying connectivity, security, and operational requirements they introduce.- You possess knowledge of Cybersecurity, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, Active Directory, Single Sign-On (at least 1+ year of experience).- You are able to bridge IT and OT requirements and collaborate effectively with architects, factory engineers, operations teams, and business stakeholders.- You are passionate about automation, standardization, and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on reducing manual effort through scalable technical solutions.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

Aicinām pievienoties  starptautiskam, dinamiskam  uzņēmumam, kurā rūpējas par darbinieku drošību un izaugsmi! 

Dinex Grupa ir vadošais pasaules mēroga inovatīvu izplūdes sistēmu un emisijas produktu ražotājs un izplatītājs,  kas pārstāvēts 15 valstīs un nodarbina vairāk  nekā 1600 darbinieku.

-  Sociālās garantijas, veselības apdrošināšanu, daļēji subsidētu ēdināšanu;

-  Stabilu darbu starptautiskā uzņēmumā;

-  Konkurētspējīgu atalgojumu un labus darba apstākļus;

No kandidātiem sagaidām

-  Darba pieredzi metālapstādēs jomā;

-  Vēlmi paaugstināt kvalifikāciju un interesi par jaunākajām tehnoloģijām un to apgūšanu;

Galvenie darba pienākumi:

- nodrošināt siltumapgādes un citu tehnisko mezglu ikdienas uzraudzību;
- veikt iekšējo elektrotīklu, apkures, ūdensapgādes, kanalizācijas un signalizācijas sistēmu ikdienas apsekošanu;

- nodrošināt kvalitatīvu un savlaicīgu remontdarbu izpildi;
- sadarboties ar kolēģiem, ārējiem pakalpojumu sniedzējiem un tehniskajiem speciālistiem.

Prasības kandidātam:
- praktiska pieredze saimniecības vai tehniskās uzturēšanas darbos;
- izpratne par inženiertehniskajām sistēmām (elektrība, apkure, ūdensapgāde u.c.);

- tehniska domāšana un problēmu risināšanas prasmes;
-  B kategorijas autovadītāja apliecība.

- Darbs piemērots cilvēkam ar praktisku pieeju darbam, kurš spēj patstāvīgi pieņemt lēmumus un redzēt saimniecību kopumā.

Mēs piedāvājam:
- stabilu darbu augošā uzņēmumā;
- dinamisku darba vidi zirgu saimniecībā;
- konkurētspējīgu atalgojumu, kas tiek noteikts atbilstoši kandidāta pieredzei, zināšanām un kompetencēm. 
- iespēju realizēt savas idejas teritorijas un infrastruktūras uzlabošanā.

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer (smelting)
jobs.description:
On behalf of our customer, we are now looking for a Commissioning Engineer with previous work experience related to smelting plants. Headquartered in Espoo, Finland, our customer is providing sustainable technology, equipment, and services for the aggregates, minerals processing, and metals refining industries This position offers a vantage point in the company's deliveries within metals refining and opportunity for you to travel the world. You will take part in the construction, installation and start-up of a new scrap copper smelting plant in Gujarat, India. This is a long-term international assignment, expected to last at least one year, with the possibility of periodic trips home during the assignment. Accommodation and local transportation will, in most cases, be arranged by the customer.


Your responsibilities will include:

- Supervise and coordinate installation and commissioning activities.

- Work closely with the customer, employees, subcontractors and other stakeholders.

- Monitor progress, quality and site activities.

- Support problem-solving during installation and start-up.

- Ensure that work is carried out safely and according to project requirements.

- Coordinate activities between different disciplines when required.

- Report progress and identify potential issues to the project management team.

- Participate in commissioning, testing and start-up activities.

- Act as a practical link between the project team and the site.

What we expect from you:

The technical requirements are relatively broad. The most important qualification is practical experience from a smelting or metallurgical plant environment.

jobs.title: Site Engineers (Multiple Disciplines), Granlund
jobs.description:
**Are you ready to take an active role in site supervision across demanding international projects? We are now looking for Site Engineers across several technical disciplines to join Granlunds growing Site Services team.**

_Granlund is a rapidly growing expert organization in the real estate and construction sector. Together with our clients and stakeholders, we are building a sustainable and intelligent future. Our more than 1,600 professionals serve across 30 locations throughout Finland._

**Would you be one of our new Site Engineers?**

As a Site Engineer, you will be responsible for site supervision within your own technical discipline, whether your expertise lies in Civil, Structural, Architectural, Mechanical (HVAC), Electrical, ICT, Security, Automation, or Moisture Management. As the client's technical representative on site, you will play a key role in ensuring that technically demanding projects are executed according to approved plans, technical requirements, contractual obligations, and agreed quality standards.

In your daily work, you will monitor project progress, review installations, materials, and work phases, and ensure that execution aligns with approved plans and technical requirements. You will interpret technical drawings and project documentation, document your observations in digital systems, and help ensure that any quality issues or deviations are addressed appropriately. As a key link between the site and the wider project organization, you will provide accurate and up-to-date information on project progress and site activities.

The positions are full-time and permanent, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The work is strongly site-based, with projects located throughout Finland. The most suitable project location will be discussed during the recruitment process. The role requires regular presence at project sites and readiness to travel.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for professionals who enjoy working close to construction and industrial projects and want to take responsibility for quality and technical execution on site. You have experience in site supervision, quality control, or technical project environments, along with a relevant engineering degree and the ability to interpret technical drawings, plans, and project documentation.

Your background may, for example, be in Civil, Structural or Architectural Engineering, Mechanical (HVAC), Electrical Engineering, ICT, Security, Automation or Moisture Management. Regardless of your discipline, you have a few years of experience working on construction or industrial projects and are comfortable operating in a site-based environment.

Experience with Dalux or Autodesk Construction Cloud is considered an advantage. Fluent English are required, while Finnish language skills are considered an advantage. You will also need a valid driving licence and readiness to work regularly at project sites.

You are proactive, quality-conscious, and eager to develop your expertise. You take responsibility for your work, communicate effectively with different stakeholders, and are not afraid to raise concerns when quality, safety, or project requirements are at risk.

**Why join us?**

At Granlund, you will work in a company that has been a pioneer in Finnish building services engineering for decades. You will contribute to demanding and large-scale projects such as data centers and commercial environments, where your work truly matters. As one of the leading data center design and consulting companies in the Nordics, we offer long-term career opportunities in a rapidly growing field, where projects are becoming increasingly significant in scale and impact. You will have strong opportunities to grow and develop your expertise, with career paths that can be shaped around your strengths and interests.

We place real emphasis on employee well-being, continuous learning, and a supportive, professional work environment. You will be part of a collaborative and ambitious team where people take ownership, share knowledge, and work together toward common goals.

**Are you interested?**

Could you be our new colleague? Please submit your application via the link either in English or Finnish as soon as possible, but no later than 4.10.2026. We will begin interviews during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information, please contact Biisonis Recruitment Consultant Nea Repo (**nea.repo@biisoni.fi**).

jobs.title: Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner to shape St1's CRM approach and deliver the Salesforce-based solutions that support our sales, customer service, and business operations. This role sits where business needs meet technical delivery: you make sure what we build is scalable, secure, and actually adopted by the people who use it.

A big part of the role is partnering with business teams who are actively developing their digital ways of working. You act as a trusted advisor, drawing on experience from multiple Salesforce implementations to guide teams, introduce best practices, and drive real process change and adoption, not just deliver features.

You work closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and administrators, translating requirements into a prioritized backlog and actionable solutions. This is a hands-on role: it combines business analysis with real configuration work in Salesforce, so you are as comfortable writing a user story as you are building in the platform.

How youll help drive the change

Joining St1, youll be part of running and developing a profitable business that invests in long-term energy solutions. Together we achieve the extraordinary through everyday work. As a Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner, youll play a key role in

Product Strategy & Vision

Define and communicate the roadmap for Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud capabilities.

Align platform initiatives with business objectives and customer experience goals.

Continuously evaluate new Salesforce features and innovations for business value.

Backlog & Requirements Management

Own and maintain the Sales & Service product backlog.

Gather, analyze, and prioritize business and technical requirements.

Translate business needs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and keep backlog items well-defined and ready for development.

Technical Leadership

Provide technical guidance on Salesforce architecture, integrations, and configurations.

Partner with architects and developers to design scalable, secure solutions, and review designs against best practices and enterprise standards.

Configure Salesforce Sales and Service Cloud hands-on where needed.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Act as the primary liaison between business users, Business Technology, and external vendor teams.

Design and facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and process improvements that help business teams build confidence and capability.

Manage expectations and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies.

Partner with business leads to drive user adoption: coaching teams through change, addressing resistance, and building long-term ownership of new ways of working.

Share insights and best practices from prior implementations to help the business make informed decisions and avoid common pitfalls.

Platform Governance & Quality

Ensure compliance with security, data, and governance standards.

Promote best practices for development, documentation, and deployment.

What you bring to the team

Were looking for a colleague with the drive to challenge, collaborate and grow. To thrive in this role, you likely have:

5+ years of experience working with Salesforce platforms, including 3+ years in a Product Owner, Business Systems Analyst, or Technical Lead role.

Proven hands-on experience configuring Salesforce Sales and Service Cloud.

Strong understanding of CRM, sales operations, and customer service processes.

Demonstrated experience driving organizational change and process adoption in environments with varying levels of digital maturity.

Track record of delivering Salesforce implementations across multiple organizations, with the ability to bring cross-industry best practices to new contexts.

A bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Knowledge of Finnish or Swedish as a native speaker, and fluent written and spoken knowledge of English. Other Nordic languages are a plus.

Nice to have: Salesforce certifications (e.g. Administrator, Platform Developer, Sales/Service Cloud Consultant), experience with Einstein or Agentforce, and experience in large-scale, highly integrated environments.

Who are we looking for

We are looking for your passion, skills and drive. We're looking for those who recognize the St1 Spirit in themselves: Curious, Commercial, Committed and Caring. We value people who are curious, commercial, committed and caring, and who thrive in collaborative, fast-changing environments.

Why Join St1?

- Shape St1s CRM vision and create tangible impact across sales and customer service.
- Blend business insight with hands-on design and delivery.
- Influence how teams adopt modern digital ways of working.
- Develop into Salesforce architecture, AI-powered CRM, or product leadership.
- Helsinki or Stockholm base, with excellent social benefits.
- Work in a high-performing Nordic tech organisation built on trust and responsibility.

How we support your journey

At St1, your safety and wellbeing come first. We offer an open and inclusive workplace where youre respected and trusted to take initiative. In a hands-on, informal culture - and a business that never stands still - theres room to explore ideas and take on new challenges. We support your journey through learning and opportunities to grow across teams and countries.

jobs.title: People Analytics & Rewards Specialist
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
As Impact Fund Denmark continues to grow and professionalise, we want more of our people and organisational decisions to be grounded in evidence, data and a clear understanding of what drives behaviour and performance.

That is why we are creating a new role at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent.

You might already work in HR and be looking to build deeper analytical expertise. Or you may come from organisational psychology, economics, analytics or a related field and want to apply your skills in a People & Culture setting.

Either way, what matters most is that you are curious about how organisations work, comfortable working with data, and able to turn analysis into useful insights and practical recommendations and that you take pride in contributing and getting things to impact.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Your role is to help us understand our organisation better — and use that understanding to make better decisions.

Your work will span analytics, reward and talent. You will:

  • Analyse employee, performance, engagement, talent and compensation data

  • Turn data and research into clear conclusions and practical recommendations for People & Culture and management

  • Support compensation benchmarking and our annual salary and compensation processes

  • Contribute to the implementation of the EU Pay Transparency requirements, including the related analysis and reporting

  • Develop dashboards, recurring People reporting and metrics that help us focus on what matters

  • Analyse engagement survey results and help turn them into meaningful organisational actions

  • Support talent, succession and performance processes with analysis and insight

  • Bring relevant research from organisational psychology and behavioural science into the way we design and evaluate People initiatives

  • Challenge assumptions and help us understand whether our interventions are having the intended effect

  • Prepare clear presentations and decision material for colleagues and leadership

  • Contribute to selected organisational development and talent projects

YOUR FIRST YEAR

By the end of your first year, we would expect to see progress in five areas:

  • Data: our People reporting and analytics are clearer, more consistent and more useful

  • Reward: compensation processes are supported by reliable analysis and relevant market data

  • Listening: employee survey data is translated into meaningful insights rather than simply reported

  • Evidence: important People initiatives increasingly have a clear evidence base, purpose and intended outcome

  • Decision support: People & Culture and leadership receive concise, relevant analysis that helps them make better decisions

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This is what we need to see:

  • A relevant academic background, for example in psychology, organisational psychology, economics, business, HR, statistics or another analytical discipline

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills

  • A few years of relevant professional experience. We care more about the quality and relevance of your experience than an exact number of years

  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with data

  • The ability to move from data or research to a clear conclusion and a practical recommendation

  • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding why People practices work — rather than simply following established practice

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Professional fluency in English

These would be advantages, but they are not requirements:

  • Previous HR experience

  • Experience with Compensation & Benefits or Reward

  • Experience with People Analytics, employee surveys or HR reporting

  • Knowledge of statistics or research methodology

  • Experience with Power BI or similar visualisation tools

  • Experience applying organisational psychology or behavioural science in an organisational setting

  • Emotional intelligence, active listening and the ability to stay neutral under pressure

  • Courage to address uncomfortable issues, strong mediation and conflict-resolution capability

  • Professional fluency in Danish

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

This is an individual-contributor role within People & Culture.

You will work closely with the Head of People & Culture and with colleagues responsible for People Partnering, Operations and Recruitment.

Your role is to bring analytical depth and an evidence-based perspective to the areas where it can improve our decisions — particularly Reward, Talent, engagement and organisational development.

The scope is intentionally broad enough for you to grow and develop, but the professional core is clear: using data and evidence to improve people and organisational decisions.

WHY JOIN US

This is an opportunity to:

  • Help build a new capability at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent

  • Work closely with the Head of People & Culture and colleagues across the function

  • Apply data, research and behavioural science to real organisational questions

  • Build broad experience across compensation, talent, engagement and organisational development

  • Work in an organisation where the People agenda connects to a wider purpose: our colleagues support investments in green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries

PRACTICAL DETAILS

  • Location: Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø

  • Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

  • Hybrid: We currently have up to 20% of working time from home. We aim for first 6 months of employment to be in office for successful onboarding and integration into team and organisation.

  • Application deadline: 23 September 2026

Please apply through our talent platform. Applications submitted outside the platform will not be considered.

We review applications on an ongoing basis.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

jobs.title: Supporttekniker till Bedege
jobs.description:
Om rollen

Vi söker en 1st Line Supporttekniker till ett spännande bolag centralt i Stockholm! Är du den som alltid sätter kunden i fokus och gillar att hitta lösningar? Här blir du kundens första kontaktperson – den som skapar en trygg och positiv upplevelse redan från första mötet.

Här blir du en del av ett engagerat team på 18 personer där man stöttar varandra och hjälps åt. Teamet inkluderar både 1st Line och 2nd Line Support, vilket innebär att du arbetar nära kollegor genom hela supportflödet och snabbt får en bred teknisk kompetens. Kontoret ligger i Norrtull / Vasastan och arbetet sker till största del på plats på kontoret.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att innebära:

    

Ta emot, registrera och följa upp kundärenden via telefon och e-post, med tydlig dokumentation.

    

Felsöka, lösa och driva supportärenden framåt inom 1st Line samt eskalera vidare när det behövs.

    

Arbeta med teknisk felsökning inom bland annat applikationer, Windowsmiljöer, nätverk, kassasystem och kringutrustning samt utföra operativa rutiner och dokumenterade åtgärder.

    

Följa upp ärenden och säkerställa att kunder hålls uppdaterade.

    

Samarbeta med kollegor, dela kunskap och bidra till förbättringar i supportens arbetssätt.

Kvalifikationer

I rollen ser vi gärna att du har följande:

    

Erfarenhet av arbete med kundhantering, gärna via telefon.

    

God datorvana och stort IT-intresse.

    

Flytande i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.

Meriterande:

    

Något/Några års erfarenhet från 1st Line-support eller liknande teknisk roll.

    

Kunskap om POS-system, nätverk eller Windows-miljöer.

    

Tidigare arbete inom retail, service eller tekniska yrken.

    

Goda kunskaper inom norska.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är lösningsorienterad och som alltid sätter kunden i fokus. Du tycker om att arbeta direkt med kunder via telefon och har inga problem med att hantera ett stort inflöde av samtal. Då du i denna roll ofta möter stressade användare med varierad teknisk kunskap är det viktigt att du är tålmodig och pedagogisk. Samtidigt är du nyfiken, har lätt för att lära, söker gärna information och lösningar på egen hand och känner dig trygg med att fråga mer erfarna kollegor när det behövs. Vidare är du är proaktiv, samarbetsvillig och bidrar till en positiv laganda. Pålitlighet, punktlighet och en vilja att följa och utveckla rutiner kommer naturligt för dig och du strävar alltid efter att leverera hög kvalitet i allt du gör.

Mer om anställningen

    

Start: Så snart som möjligt

    

Anställningsform: Direktanställning hos Bedege

    

Arbetstid: Heltid, 37,5 timmar/vecka, måndag–söndag med varierande arbetstider mellan 06:00–22:00.

    

Kontoret ligger i Norrtull / Vasastan och arbetet sker för det mesta på plats på kontoret.

Låter det som du? Vi ser fram emot att ta emot din ansökan! Urvalet hanteras löpande, och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Om Bedege

Bedege är ett väletablerat bolag som levererar Microsoftbaserade affärs-och kassasystem till kedjor inom Retail, Hotell och Restaurang och till andra verksamheter som vill effektivisera processer och möta förändrade kundbeteenden- om och om igen. Kunderna är kända aktörer där Bedeges roll är att kunna erbjuda IT-support 365 dagar om året.

Bedege lägger stor vikt vid kompetensutveckling och vill att varje medarbetare ska känna att de utvecklas i sin roll. Här uppmuntras du att lära dig nytt, bygga vidare på dina kunskaper och växa – både tekniskt och i kundrelationen. Bolaget har ca 40 anställda och har en familjär stämning med ett öppet och inkluderande klimat.

Läs mer om Bedege här: https://bedege.se/

  The Place – Sveriges enda Worklife Partner

För dig som söker nytt jobb är The Place din trygga punkt. I just denna rekrytering sköter våra kompetenta rekryteringskonsulter processen, från intervju till anställningserbjudande. Sedan blir du anställd av kundföretaget. Vi är stolta över våra fina samarbeten med en stor mängd intressanta och spännande företag – och det innebär ju många karriärmöjligheter för dig!

jobs.description:

På fritiden tycker hon om att shoppa, promenera och titta på film. Vi söker dig som vill vara med och skapa en trygg, positiv och aktiv vardag tillsammans med henne.

jobs.title: Data Engineer med stark Pythonprofil - Futur pension
jobs.description:
Vill du kombinera avancerad Pythonutveckling med möjligheten att påverka hur moderna dataflöden byggs? På Futur Pension får du arbeta i en tekniskt ambitiös miljö med komplexa dataflöden, moderna tekniker och nära koppling mellan teknik och verksamhet. En roll för dig som vill arbeta nära tekniken, ta ansvar för dina lösningar och se dem skapa konkret värde för verksamheten.

OM TJÄNSTEN:

Som Data Engineer på Futur Pension blir du en viktig del av arbetet med att utveckla och modernisera bolagets analysplattform. Du bygger lösningar som hämtar data från försäkringssystemet, andra verksamhetssystem och externa API:er och förädlar den till kvalitetssäkrad och användbar information för analys, uppföljning och beslutsfattande.

Rollen har ett starkt fokus på Python och innebär att du arbetar genom hela dataflödet, från datakälla och modellering till test, driftsättning och förvaltning. I takt med att plattformen utvecklas får du också bidra till hur Pythonkod, datamodeller och dataflöden struktureras och byggs för att skapa robusta och återanvändbara lösningar.

ARBETSUPPGIFTER:

    Utveckla och underhålla ETL-flöden i Python.
    Hämta och integrera data från SQL-databaser, API:er och verksamhetssystem.
    Transformera, kvalitetssäkra och modellera data.
    Utveckla återanvändbara lösningar för nya datakällor.
    Paketera dataflöden med Docker och köra dem i Azure.
    Bygga in loggning, felhantering och tester.
    Vidareutveckla flöden för bygge och driftsättning i Azure DevOps.
    Samarbeta nära verksamheten och andra utvecklare.

VI SÖKER DIG SOM:

    Har en civilingenjörsutbildning inom relevant område
    Har minst tre års arbetslivserfarenhet av professionell utveckling i Python.
    Har goda kunskaper i SQL och relationsdatabaser.
    Har erfarenhet av att utveckla ETL- eller ELT-flöden.
    Har förståelse för datamodellering, datakvalitet och spårbarhet.
    Är van vid att utveckla kod som ska testas, driftsättas och förvaltas.
    Har erfarenhet av Git, kodgranskning och CI/CD.
    Har god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska eller engelska.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Azure SQL, Azure Container Apps, Azure Key Vault, Pandas, SQLAlchemy eller PyODBC. Erfarenhet av Docker, infrastruktur som kod, gärna Bicep – testautomatisering, övervakning av dataflöden eller visualiseringsverktyg som Streamlit, Plotly och Power BI är också värdefullt.

Du behöver inte ha tidigare erfarenhet av pension eller försäkring. Däremot ser vi gärna att du är nyfiken på verksamheten bakom datat och vill förstå hur informationen hänger ihop.

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du tycker om att arbeta i en tekniskt ambitiös miljö där utvecklingen går snabbt och där du får ta stort eget ansvar. Du gillar att gå på djupet i tekniska problem, skriva välstrukturerad kod och samtidigt förstå vilket värde datan skapar för verksamheten. Eftersom du kommer att samarbeta nära både utvecklare och verksamheten är det också viktigt att du uppskattar kunskapsutbyte och nära samarbete.

OM FUTUR PENSION:

Futur Pension arbetar inom pension och långsiktigt sparande med fokus på tjänstepension, kapitalförsäkring och sparlösningar. Bolaget har en ambitiös techorganisation där mycket av systemen utvecklas inhouse. Du blir en del av ett prestigelöst team med korta beslutsvägar, stort förtroende och nära samarbete med verksamheten. Analysplattformen befinner sig i en omstöpning, vilket ger dig möjlighet att vara med och påverka hur lösningarna byggs och struktureras framåt.

OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN:

Detta är en direktrekrytering, vilket innebär att Friday ansvarar för rekryteringsprocessen och att du därefter blir anställd direkt av Futur Pension.

ÖVRIG INFORMATION:

Omfattning: Heltid

Start: Enligt överenskommelse

Placering: Centrala Stockholm

Rekryteringsansvarig: Maja Dahlin (maja.dahlin@friday.se)

Lön: Fast månadslön

Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval och annonsen kan stängas innan tjänsten är tillsatt.

OM FRIDAY:

På Friday brinner vi för att hjälpa dig att ta nästa steg i din karriär inom IT och teknik, oavsett om du söker ditt första jobb eller redan har några års erfarenhet. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet. Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas. Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

Sökord: Data Engineer, Python, Pythonutvecklare, SQL, ETL, ELT, Azure, Azure SQL, Azure DevOps, Docker, Pandas, SQLAlchemy, PyODBC, CI/CD, Datamodellering, Data Engineering.

Operationskonsulterna är specialister på operationssjukvård, förlossningssjukvård, intensivvård och övriga specialistsjuksköterskeområden som tex ambulans, röntgen, distriktssjukvård, ögonsjukvård, akutmottagning mm. Företaget finns i hela Sverige och arbetet leds från vårt huvudkontor i Gamla Stan i Stockholm. Bolaget drivs av kliniskt verksamma specialistsjuksköterskor samt undersköterskor som är väl medvetna om vad som krävs av varje medarbetare för att kunna göra ett professionellt arbete. För dig som anställd är det en trygghet med en arbetsgivare som har stor erfarenhet av arbete inom specialistsjukvården med komplett försäkringsskydd.

jobs.title: President Machining, Sandvik Group
jobs.description:
We are looking for an exceptional business leader to join us as President of business area Machining at Sandvik. As President, you lead one of the world's most respected industrial businesses and play a pivotal role in delivering Sandvik's Advancing to 2030 strategy through growth, innovation, digitalization and operational excellence.

‍Business area Machining is the global leading manufacturer of tools and tooling systems for advanced industrial metal cutting, as well as metal powder. In 2025, sales were approximately SEK 44 billion with about 18,700 employees. Our portfolio includes market leading brands like Sandvik Coromant, Seco, Walter and Dormer Pramet. Together, these businesses combine industry-leading technology, deep application expertise and strong customer partnerships to help manufacturers improve productivity, efficiency and sustainability.

About the job

With overall responsibility for the business, you set the direction and lead the execution of business area Machining's strategy and performance agenda. Machining consists of a portfolio of leading divisions and businesses, each with its own market position, strategy and profit and loss responsibility. A key part of your role is to foster and strengthen Sandvik's decentralized model, empowering division presidents and leadership teams to drive performance, innovation and customer success while ensuring alignment with the overall strategic direction of business area Machining and Sandvik Group.

You are accountable for sustainable growth, profitability, innovation and customer success across the portfolio. Through strong leadership, disciplined execution and active portfolio management, you identify new growth opportunities, strengthen market positions and ensure that business area Machining remains at the forefront of manufacturing transformation.

As a member of Sandvik Group Executive Management, you work closely with colleagues across the Group to ensure long-term value creation for customers, shareholders and society. You report to the President and CEO of Sandvik Group.

Job responsibilities

    Drive profitable growth and strengthen market leadership across the portfolio.
    Accelerate digitalization, AI adoption and innovation initiatives.
    Develop and support strong division leadership teams with accountability for strategy execution and business performance.
    Foster an entrepreneurial and decentralized culture where decisions are made close to customers and markets.
    Deliver operational excellence and cost competitiveness while advancing sustainability and responsible business practices.
    Identify and execute acquisitions and other opportunities that support long-term growth and value creation.

Location

The position is based in Stockholm. International travel is an integral part of the position.

Your profile

You are a proven global business leader with a strong track record of delivering growth, transformation and financial performance in complex international environments. You combine strategic thinking with operational excellence and are comfortable leading through change in a rapidly evolving landscape shaped by technology, automation, AI and sustainability.

You bring:

    Extensive senior leadership experience with full P&L responsibility.
    Success in driving business growth, transformation and strategy execution.
    Experience from industrial, manufacturing and/or technology-intensive businesses.
    Strong commercial acumen and customer orientation, combined with a strong understanding of advanced technologies.
    Experience leading large, global and decentralized organizations through empowered leadership teams.
    Strong ability to set the strategic direction and inspire, develop and lead high-performing leaders and teams.
    Strong ability to simplify complexity.
    Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

It’s also meriting if you have prior experience engaging with boards of directors, investors, media and other external stakeholders.

Your leadership

You’re an authentic and inspiring leader who creates clarity, accountability and engagement. You believe that the best results are achieved through empowered teams, strong local ownership and clear accountability. You lead in accordance with Sandvik's core values of Winning Together, Curiosity, Responsibility and Customer Focus, building a culture where people, innovation and business performance thrive, along with maintaining the highest standards in safety, sustainability and business ethics.

Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. We invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.  

Application & Contact information

In this recruitment, Sandvik Group is cooperating with Alumni Global. Please use the application link provided to send us your application (CV only required). Apply as soon as possible and no later than September 27th, 2026.

For questions about this position, please contact Karin Hagelborn, Partner and Consultant at Alumni Global.

Read more about Alumni Global

Hiring Manager  

Stefan Widing, President and CEO

    Carl-Åke Jansson, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)70-699 63 47
    Peter Olsson-Andrée, Ledarna, +46 (0)70 222 48 55

We’ve already decided on what advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts.

Our recruitment process is open and fair – we welcome all applicants and evaluate every unique application in line with the specified requirements profile, to find the best match for the position. To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.

Sandvik is a global, industrial technology group providing solutions that enhance productivity, profitability and sustainability for the manufacturing, mining and infrastructure industries. We are at the forefront of digitalization and focus on optimizing our customers’ processes. In 2025 the Group had approximately 42,000 employees and revenues of about SEK 121 billion in more than 150 countries.

jobs.title: Sjuksköterska sökes till hösten/vintern!
jobs.description:
Är du legitimerad sjuksköterska och intresserad av ett nytt uppdrag i höst/vinter? (v.41-4 2027!)

Nu börjar våra kunder runt om i Sverige att planera höstens bemanning. Därför vill vi redan nu komma i kontakt med dig som är intresserad av nya möjligheter.

Du är varmt välkommen att lämna en intresseanmälan även om du ännu inte vet exakt hur mycket du kan arbeta. Kanske är du tillgänglig under några veckor, delar av hösten eller har särskilda önskemål kring ort och schema? Hör av dig ändå, så planerar vi tillsammans.

Som konsult hos oss får du stöd hela vägen, från första kontakt till avslutat uppdrag. Vi lyssnar på dina önskemål och planerar tillsammans ett upplägg som passar dig, så att du kan arbeta på dina villkor.

Vi har uppdrag över stora delar av Sverige och hjälper dig gärna att hitta rätt möjlighet utifrån dina önskemål och erfarenheter.
